150101.name: 4 Heroes of Palmyna
150101.desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 2 - The warriors head towards their decisive battle against Cardes! They must save Palmyna from the gods' invasion!

150502.name: 12 Guardians of the Gods
150502.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 3 - The Guardians face off against the demon Zorbadel. They must overcome this menace by working together!

8301399.name: [Farm] Scrapping Security
8301399.desc: With the antifield disabled, your powers return. You send Vektor and Galene away, and prepare for a night of scrapping.

8301372.name: [Hard] Battle For Everyone's Winter
8301372.desc: A reimagination of Krampus is somehow given life by some mysterious force. Banish Krampus once again, for good this time!

20001301.name: [Hard] Chilling Beauties
20001301.desc: Feel the full force of Hilda and Rene's subzero assault in this chilling challenge!

8301398.name: [Hard] Forced Shutdown
8301398.desc: Knowing that Vektor and Galene are safe for now, you decide to get to the bottom of the Corporation's sinister AI.

20002102.name: [Hard] Shadow of Memories
20002102.desc: This lost memory appears to be rather more intense than expected…

8301641.name: [Hard] The Curse Master
8301641.desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Elhaza seem to have blurred. The Curse Master might be stronger than you originally remembered…

25010002.name: [Hard] The Fighting Nun
25010002.desc: It's time to reload! Square off against the Fighting Nun and put your faith to the test!

8301711.name: [Hard] The Illusionist
8301711.desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Melfel seem to have blurred. The Illusionist might be stronger than you originally remembered…

20002202.name: [Hard] The Righteous Sheriff
20002202.desc: This town ain't big enough for the two of you! Engage Sheriff Gilbert once more in a sunset showdown!

8301561.name: [Hard] The Savage Lion
8301561.desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Baragan seem to have blurred. The Savage Lion might be stronger than you originally remembered…

20001601.name: [Hard] The Scorching Blade
20001601.desc: Turn up the heat in this all-out spar against the Scorching Blade!

20001501.name: [Hard] The Silver Knight
20001501.desc: Impressed with your prowess, the Silver Knight goes all out in this rematch for the ages!

8301651.name: [Hard] The Warmonger
8301651.desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Zaad seem to have blurred. The Warmonger might be stronger than you originally remembered…

8001722.name: A Band-it Party
8001722.desc: Look, bandits! Here to crash the party, it would seem. Or are they the entertainment?

604.name: A Blistering Exchange
604.desc: Two warriors, locked in combat since long ago, take a break from their intense fighting to block your way forward.

10742.name: A Bright Future
10742.desc: Sound reverberates in the cave just as light reflects. Your footsteps echo many times over, and it sounds almost like you're leading a small army.

10301.name: A City Ablaze
10301.desc: The city is burning. What could be the fuel of these flames, and when will they stop burning? Ishgria is truly a strange place.

454.name: A Dark God Emerges
454.desc: As you exit Edila you're able to see the entrance to Amdahl Castle, but suddenly, a figure consumed by darkness blocks your way forward.

8301103.name: A Dark Resurrection
8301103.desc: Death stalks the halls as you reach the center of this madness; the silence is overpowering. What insanity will you meet here?

10002.name: A Different Region
10002.desc: In the center of the ruins is a large circular plaza. Though the buildings are abandoned now, this seems to have been a prestigious place.

1222.name: A Fairy's Smile
1222.desc: Strange, this is the same path you took before. It seems that the forest is enchanted. You must find the source of this spell and eliminate it.

83016811.name: A Familiar Echo
83016811.desc: With wariness and trepidation, you step through a portal into a world you thought had long shattered…

645.name: A Familiar Opponent
645.desc: Despite the rumors they were the strongest around, those two never crossed swords. Perhaps they understood what it really meant to be strong.

703.name: A Feast for Humanoids
703.desc: If you look closely it is obvious this road wasn't made this way by nature alone. It seems a great battle took place in this area.

83016600.name: A Festive Mood
83016600.desc: The festive season is here in full force! Will you take a merry jaunt through the center of the village, or run wild with celebration in the nearby forest?

83016603.name: A Fiery Feast
83016603.desc: Put together a fabulous roast with the villagers! Do you have enough fire in your belly?

234.name: A Flash of Lightning
234.desc: A summoned thunder king is blocking the path at the end of the wasteland. You must defeat him before continuing.

21090.name: A Flourishing Place
21090.desc: You see something unexpected as you progress deep into the polar region. It's shocking to see a place so verdant in this snowbound world.

665.name: A Formidable Presence
665.desc: You feel a wicked pulse coming from deep within the Spirit World, but before you can reach it you must defeat a once legendary hero.

854.name: A Glorious Bloody End
854.desc: A pungent rusty metal odor pours into your nose. It's the smell of blood! The exit ought to be near, but there's no doubt something dreadful is waiting ahead.

8301134.name: A Grand Reception
8301134.desc: Turns out Elphelt was just looking for eternal love. It's a beautiful day for a wedding, and she looks lovely in her gown. Time to declare your love!

20063.name: A Guiding Star
20063.desc: Locked in the throes of battle, a strange sensation overcomes you momentarily. You don’t know what caused it, but you decide to track its source...

765.name: A Hero's Destiny
765.desc: You're close enough to the tower that you have to look up to see where it ends. It's odd appearance causes a lump in your throught.

5000014.name: A Maiden's Despair
5000014.desc: It began not long after Maxwell was defeated... Sera had always been serious, but she had begun to make odd statements to herself while lost in thought. Lin happened to overhear her while passing by and became fixated on the changes in Sera. Lin soon reached a conclusion, then invited Elise and the Summoner to follow Sera after work one day...

8301206.name: A New Beginning
8301206.desc: Almost there, Summoner! It's time for the performance of a lifetime! Miku, take it away!

8301202.name: A New Darkness Arises
8301202.desc: The man called Veritas of the Dark is growing stronger! You must fight back until the reinforcements from Summoners' Hall reach you!

150102.name: A New Hope
150102.desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 3 - The price paid to seal Cardes was a great one. All the heroes come to gather around a dormant Edea.

1440.name: A Painful Climb
1440.desc: The rough, shiny rock around shows traces of lightning. It seems it has been absorbing it during the endless storms. Pressing forward won't be easy.

20034.name: A Peaceful Courtyard
20034.desc: Danger awaits you in the great courtyard at the center of Valtan Fortress. Defeat whatever it is to complete Lugina's mission.

350.name: A Putrid Abyss
350.desc: In a complete change of scenery, you come across a dark, rancid cave. Pass through this, and St. Lamia Palace awaits.

409531.name: A Queen Grieves
409531.desc: Believing herself powerless to stop her father's death, Evgenia struggles against the demons of her past.

8301532.name: A Real Shocker
8301532.desc: Who knew taking other people's food could be such a hair-raising experience?

640.name: A Response to Devotion
640.desc: Grahdens's question planted a seed in its wake. However this is no time to get distracted. You must repay the goddess's favor.

8301131.name: A Revelating Survey
8301131.desc: You've been sent to check on the phenomena caused by newcomers from beyond the "Backyard." Are you ready for wild dragons and thunderstorms?

22012.name: A Rich Nation
22012.desc: You're going to help Suzune reclaim the country, but that will probably take more than civil discussions to achieve. Be ready to fight.

20041.name: A Roar from the Darkness
20041.desc: The roar of an ancient dragon reverberates inside the walls of the tower. Only those able to conquer their fear are worthy of scaling the tower’s heights.

409511.name: A Rousing Feast
409511.desc: Evgenia's idyllic childhood soon gives way to her new life as the princess of Elysia.

409551.name: A Royal Challenge
409551.desc: The young sorceress Evie challenges her father to a deceptively simple duel of might and magic.

8301101.name: A Scarlet Abyss
8301101.desc: Noel has sent you to investigate an anomaly near Randall. Meanwhile, a fiery warrior can be seen in the distance...

1151.name: A Seductive Trap
1151.desc: An oddly glowing crystal floats inside the darkened cave. Stare at it too long and you might find yourself under its spell.

8301353.name: A Shadowy Meeting
8301353.desc: A shadowy figure appears out of nowhere and strikes at the party! How will they resolve this?

1462.name: A Soldier's Tombstone
1462.desc: This part of the cemetery seems to be dedicated to soldiers fallen in battle. You can see that their tombstones have a sword symbol carved onto them.

8301481.name: A Stranger's Memories
8301481.desc: The Vessel of Death unleashes his powers upon the undead, while struggling with the unknown visions assailing him.

150041.name: A Swordsman's Anguish
150041.desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 2 - After acquiring the legendary sword of light, Urias, Atro becomes a master swordsman. However, many people begin appearing...

8320120.name: A Tear-Wrapped Reunion
8320120.desc: After much searching, Silvie finally catches up with Nick. However, how will Haido's interruption affect the party's delicate situation?

452.name: A Thirst for Blood
452.desc: Your senses suddenly heighten. Could it be this intense blood-thirsty presence you feel up ahead? It's already too late to turn back.

434.name: A Thunder God Strikes
434.desc: A sanctuary can be seen shining just beyond the mine. The exit seems to be within reach. All you have to do is defeat the enemies before you.

634.name: A Thunderous Attack
634.desc: The Heroes of Old longed for the life of a lone warrior, and if ever two of such warriors should meet their joy would rain down like lightning.

8301762.name: A Thunderous Ending
8301762.desc: It's time for the electrifying climax! Go for it and blow them away!

713.name: A Timeless Blaze
713.desc: There are now a lot of paths leading out. It looks like you'll be able to escape the mountains soon, however, you can feel something ahead, the presence of a strong enemy.

1001.name: A Torch in the Darkness
1001.desc: Who knows how long the simmering lava has been waiting in this cave for its chance to rise to the surface. Soon its pressure will force it out.

151402.name: A Trial for Heroes
151402.desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 3 - A demon suddenly appears in the city to test the Randall Guard. Are they truly worthy of being called heroes?

10633.name: A Tricky Bottleneck
10633.desc: You have gotten lost in the fortress. You need to focus on moving ahead after all, without getting distracted by pointless questions.

8301362.name: A Warm Reunion
8301362.desc: A reunion of Silvie and Haido, with Annette in tow! Can they convince Nick to their cause?

414.name: A Water God Appears
414.desc: It seems you must leave Amdahl if you are to defeat Cardes, but before that you need to escape the ghost ship.

813.name: A Wave of Blades
813.desc: You notice that the softly falling snow is starting to cover Karl's tracks. You must find him before you lose trace of him.

8301241.name: A Weightless Start
8301241.desc: Time to test your mettle against Ochaco Uraraka! Hope you know how to fly!

810.name: A White World
810.desc: All you see goes from steam to snow, and your once steaming hot body is instantly cooled. Worried about Karl, you continue after him.

8301492.name: A Wife's Pain
8301492.desc: Aesys relives the trauma of witnessing the death of her heart.

8301311.name: A Windy Fight
8301311.desc: Stumbling through a rift into Grand Gaia, the Sky Dragon Slayer Wendy lashes a gust of wind at you upon seeing you... Don't get blown off your feet!

150051.name: A Wish of Vengeance
150051.desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 2 - After his family's murder, an angry Magress spends his days in battle fueling the fire of vengeance within.

1000001.name: A Year's Trajectory
1000001.desc:
A mysterious area that suddenly appeared in the Vortex.
On orders from the Akras Summoners' Hall, hunters are being sent to investigate the area and rid it of monsters.

754.name: A Young Girl's Wish
754.desc: Burnt houses, crumbling churches. There must've been many residents in a city as large as this. You can't help but hope that the victims have found peace.

8301580.name: Abandoned Alleyway
8301580.desc: Calavera City is a bright and beautiful place, filled with nooks, crannies, and an abundance of abandoned alleyways to explore.

25590001.name: Abandoned Outpost
25590001.desc: Miell takes Phaedra to an abandoned outpost of the human incursion.

401.name: Abandoned Ruins
401.desc: Past the damaged houses lies nothing but fiery ruins. Could these flames be the work of monsters?

1552.name: Ability to Rule
1552.desc: Tilith seems completely at a loss about what Ark said regarding Lucius. It seems even she doesn't know everything about her master.

1100.name: Absolute Heat
1100.desc: The air is scolding hot above the boiling lava. Despite the surroundings, Paris's expression remains cool.

101800.name: Absolute Zero Lv. 3
101800.desc: The ice cold air pricks at your skin, but what awaits ahead is a sibyl said to have a glacial glare even colder than ice.

101801.name: Absolute Zero Lv. 4
101801.desc: A blade of ice that shines clear and bright thanks to the blood of the people it has fed on. Perhaps this is a symbol of her true pure nature.

21011.name: Abundant Monsters
21011.desc: Fearing attack by the Mystical Wolf's minions, the townsfolk keep their doors shut tight. And thus the town itself is overrun with monsters.

1310.name: Abyss of Sea Snakes
1310.desc: Indeed there are other gods besides the Four Fallen that reject the existence of humans. However, let's focus on the task at hand for now.

8360503.name: Abyss Rescue Lv. 3
8360503.desc: Follow Fang into Xie'Jing's abyss to search for Fei in order to rescue him...

8360504.name: Abyss Rescue Lv. 4
8360504.desc: Can you help Fang defeat Xie'Jing once and for all, and snatch Fei out of her clutches?

10430.name: Accumulating Wreckage
10430.desc: Mirfah challenges you to a duel to learn your true intentions. You cannot just ignore him, so prepare yourself and do the best you can.

931.name: Accumulation of Lightning
931.desc: The placement of enemies is no accident. They were planted with great precision to wear you down, serving you up on a platter for Mare.

1312.name: Across the Raging Sea
1312.desc: The solitude of the ice temple makes for a very relaxing atmosphere. However, with enemies incoming, you have no time to rest.

10544.name: Advent of Holy Light
10544.desc: It seems there's a passage that extends from the castle to the neighboring mountains, offering an exit. But it also appears to lead toward the giant.

101700.name: Affectionate Flames Lv. 3
101700.desc: The Six Sibyl Sisters were said to have rescued many people. Here lays a shrine dedicated to one of them. Why was it they reached out to save the people?

101701.name: Affectionate Flames Lv. 4
101701.desc: The Blaze Sibyl saved the people with an affectionate heart of mercy. However, that in turn led to her fighting her sisters. The sadness from that fight still lingers.

25010.name: Afterimages
25010.desc: Mel and Garrett are ready for a fight to the end. You can't avoid fighting, even if just to back them off. It's not the first time, but be careful!

20000909.name: Against the Darkness
20000909.desc: The enemy comes upon us again this day. Defend the Golden City!

10233.name: Alarming Squall
10233.desc: A violent squall almost sent you flying. Looks like this is yet another place where you can't let your guard down. Be careful.

743.name: All-Piercing Lightning
743.desc: A paralyzing presence inhabits the forest. You recognize this aura. It seems a warrior you've faced before awaits you once again.

8301520.name: All-You-Can-Eat
8301520.desc: Lydia brings an excitable Yin-Yin into Calavera City proper, but they get more than just sights and sounds.

8301253.name: All Might Fistfight
8301253.desc: Time for the battle's climax! Can you defeat the Symbol of Peace? Time to find out!

83016003.name: Amiable Acquaintance
83016003.desc: The girl you met earlier -Fuu- hasn't returned in some time. The woods whisper ominously; this is no place for the defenseless.

23010.name: Among Shadows
23010.desc: You hide from the magical puppets amid the shadows of the ruins. You don't know what the puppets were made for, but they seem to be combat-ready.

8301761.name: An Electrifying Appearance
8301761.desc: What a shock! Can you put an end to Knives' nefarious plans?

150050.name: An Empire & a Knight
150050.desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 1 - Magress, a knight of the Bariura Empire trains arduously every day in hopes of meeting the emperor's expectations.

1003.name: An Encounter with Flames
1003.desc: The scalding lava plunges at you all of a sudden. If it hits you, you'll suffer far more than fourth degree burns. However, worse dangers lie ahead...

8301201.name: An Explosive Disaster
8301201.desc: A powerful force has invaded Grand Gaia through the Vortex Gate. The Summoners' Hall has called upon you to investigate this "Veritas of the Dark."

10510.name: An Icy Gaze
10510.desc: Mora continues to use you. It might be time to start thinking about what she aims to achieve with all her plotting.

25570001.name: An Impromptu Adventure
25570001.desc: Maeri's first magical outing is about to start. Hopefully not with a bear.

20013.name: An Invisible Presence
20013.desc: The roar of the waterfall cascading around you drowns out the sound of approaching demons. They lurk in the water and shadows, waiting for their moment to pounce.

954.name: An Offer of Death
954.desc: Somehow, the cave exhibits signs of human civilization. Could there be manmade structures this far below the sea?

8301570.name: An Uneasy Reunion
8301570.desc: The Lady of Horizons meets the Goddess of Trickery. How will the long standing grudge between the two pan out?

23000.name: An Unexplored Land
23000.desc: The Abel Faction got here ahead of you, but supposedly you're among the first humans ever to set foot here. No one knows what to expect.

83015902.name: An Unruly Night
83015902.desc: The dark creatures seem to melt and strike from the shadows. Keep your eyes peeled!

8385130.name: An Unwalked Crossroads
8385130.desc: Behold the path of a story never told before - of a fallen knight, and his black return! Who will you face - Ciara, or her nemesis?

21080.name: Ancient Relics
21080.desc: Rene calls you deep underground, beneath the lake castle. Once inside, you experience a sense of deja vu recalling Bariura in Grand Gaia.

20703.name: Ancient Wings
20703.desc: You hear an unnatural sound that you recognize. It seems a formidable foe you've fought many times awaits you. Take up your weapon and move forward.

10131.name: Angel of the Heavens
10131.desc: Your body goes slightly numb after approaching an electrified crystal. Best be careful of your surroundings and keep some distance from the crystals.

8320061.name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 1
8320061.desc: A sunken piece of Athensphere that although filled with treasure & valuable history, still houses many dangers. Only the brave dare to traverse into the unknown depths.

8320062.name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 2
8320062.desc: In the quiet waters of the depths, a ferocious carnage still rages. No one is safe when diving into this unknown territory.

8320063.name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 3
8320063.desc: Can the echoes of mayhem and despair of the deep be finally eradicated? Will the lost treasures and history of Athensphere be finally retrieved?

10360.name: Arrogance
10360.desc: You don't mind being entrusted with Karl, but you want to discuss what's going on with him. Look for Karl as soon as you finish that demon.

10424.name: Artificial Nature
10424.desc: You're taken aback by the great tree in the middle of the garden. Could it be the great and otherworldly Alpha Tree?

10665.name: Ascended Dragon's Eye
10665.desc: Only the demon Barion remains. If you can't win here, it would be foolish to face Karna Masta. It's time to show your power!

83014230.name: Ascension
83014230.desc: Orochi's power, once sealed, has reawakened with the intent to destroy mankind. Choose your ally carefully?or regret the consequences. Ready? Go!

90.name: Asleep in the Ice
90.desc: There is a mountain range at the end of the Egor Plains where it is said an evil god who once destroyed several small nations slumbers.

20032.name: Assault from Above
20032.desc: You break through the frontal defenses only to find yourself ambushed yet again, but this time from above! Time to quiet this raging beast.

10030.name: At Mushroom Forest
10030.desc: You step foot into the thick forest in the valley. However, what surrounds you are giant mushrooms, not trees. You feel like a sort of dwarf...

10831.name: Atop the Wreckage
10831.desc: Karna Masta defeated even the Summoners of Old, but with the Oracle Maiden's power, you can challenge him. You must hold on to even the faintest hope.

3000250.name: Attack Drill
3000250.desc: A short trial program to test attacks. All foes will self-destruct in 3 turns, so try to inflict as much damage as possible on them before they do!

8301292.name: Attic
8301292.desc: The second floor hallway terminates in an attic. A thorough search through the cluttered boxes may uncover something.

10242.name: Aurora Boulevard
10242.desc: After passing numerous alleys on a hill, you finally find the main road. However, where could the inhabitants of such a great city have gone?

8301261.name: Autumn's Moonlight
8301261.desc: During the season of autumn, a Moon Fairy is known to masquerade as a mortal in these moonlit forests. Find her to seek her blessing!

83013330.name: Autumn Paradise
83013330.desc: This gateway to the heavens only opens once a day in the autumn season. A symphony of the frogs can be heard in the golden wheat field beyond...

10254.name: Awaiting the End
10254.desc: You can see the entrance to the castle. Once you clear the next wave of enemies, you should be able to go inside. That's where the real battle awaits.

10080.name: Awaiting War God
10080.desc: Shusui suddenly shows himself before you once again. Why is he after you now? Does it have to do with something from this land?

23070.name: Awakening Puppets
23070.desc: You were investigating a Sealed God signal with Grahdens when magical puppets emerged from the ground. You've got to break their encirclement!

1365.name: Back to the Roots
1365.desc: You exit into a room enveloped in tree roots. The next step should lead you to the heart of the castle, but a dark hero blocks your path.

921.name: Balance of Power
921.desc: An exquisite view fills your eyes, of geological formations you have never seen. Use extra caution as you proceed.

8301231.name: Balloon Mania
8301231.desc: Hello! Wow, what are these words? Ooh, that's pretty! Do you want to join my balloons, Summoner? Come on in!

22002.name: Bamboo Cacophony
22002.desc: Who were those people in black? They might attack again, so you need to get somewhere with better visibility.

8311002.name: Band of Thieves
8311002.desc: As Leon's influence grew, he gathered a band of thieves who shared the same ideals as his own. Help the weak, and crush the strong. Steal from the rich to aid the poor.

201.name: Bandit of the Desert
201.desc: The bandits in this burning desert have much stronger resolve that those in Mistral, and it seems they intend to block your way.

42.name: Bandit of the Forest
42.desc: It's said that bandits occupy this forest. They may be tough, but there's no way to avoid them.

8301741.name: Bandits, Bandits Everywhere
8301741.desc: Uh-oh! The bandits brought friends?… lots of them! Can you keep up?

1.name: Basics of Battle
1.desc: It's time to discuss basic combat techniques!

10812.name: Battle at the Geyser
10812.desc: The craggy ground is slick with mud, and dotted with sinkholes connected by fierce streams. This footing is every soldier's worst nightmare.

8301371.name: Battle For Everyone's Winter
8301371.desc: Krampus, a spirit of vengeance given life by Nick's despair, threatens to destroy everything he stood for. Banish Krampus and save everyone's Winter!

800.name: Battle in a New Land
800.desc: A thick fog hangs around you as the light stench of rotten eggs fills the air. Be careful as it would all be over if you fell in the hole from which the steam pours.

2100000.name: Battle No. 001
2100000.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

1210.name: Battle of the Coast
1210.desc: It looks like something's on Tilith's mind. If everyone said they trust her, then what could be wrong? It's a tad worrisome.

20101.name: Battle Playbook
20101.desc: Even surrounded by enemies, at least you were able to meet with Lugina's subordinate, Reda. Watch how she fights.

10604.name: Battle Tendency
10604.desc: You're almost clear of the land of burning winds. Your clothes smell a bit charred. You've got to hurry ahead before they catch fire.

20001201.name: Battlefield of Glory
20001201.desc: Ride into battle alongside the fierce conqueror and claim victory for the kingdom!

1010.name: Battling the Ice Dragon
1010.desc: Frozen winds rush at you. The fact that the black cave of molten lava exists so close to this snowfield reminds you that nature is a force to be reckoned with.

20001008.name: Beach Cleanup - Stage 1
20001008.desc: Beautiful sunny day, at a beautiful beach. Would've been the perfect getaway island if not for some very angry people living nearby…

20001009.name: Beach Cleanup - Stage 2
20001009.desc: One has got to respect the tenacity of the native folk. They just won't give up! Show them that you're no pushover!

25550009.name: Beach Paradise: Beach
25550009.desc: Accompany Tilith on a long walk along the beach.

25550012.name: Beach Paradise: Cliffs
25550012.desc: Tilith comes up to the side of a cliff after trawling the beaches.

25550008.name: Beach Paradise: Coast
25550008.desc: Sennie and Chryssa make sure the coasts are clear.

25550007.name: Beach Paradise: Hub
25550007.desc: Tilith has a fantastic idea for mapping out this mysteriously summery island.

25550010.name: Beach Paradise: Jungle
25550010.desc: Nyami and Faelan welcome the jungle.

25550013.name: Beach Paradise: Lake
25550013.desc: Right in the middle of Nyami and Faelan's jungle jaunt appears to be a lake.

25550011.name: Beach Paradise: Pools
25550011.desc: Sennie and Chryssa stumble upon some glittering pools on the far edge.

10361.name: Beacon of Opposition
10361.desc: The castle is in shambles. The passage of time, the influence of that rotting demon, and Owen's rage must have destroyed it. Time to find that demon.

10041.name: Beacon of Treason
10041.desc: An ominous red light emanates from the chained giant crystals that float midair. To think that you have to walk through such a place...

100900.name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 1
100900.desc: Rebelling against his heritage as a blacksmith in his younger days, it'd take a lot more than strong wits to gain this man's allegiance.
100900.area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
100900.dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

100901.name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 2
100901.desc: Creating his own path as a blacksmith, he has come to acknowledge the raw strength that others possess.
100901.area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
100901.dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

100902.name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 3
100902.desc: He soon came to be known as the God Arm, though this power he only showed to those he deemed worthy.
100902.area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
100902.dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

100903.name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 4
100903.desc: Smith Lord, people called him. For he forged an almighty weapon to fight against the gods' invasion.
100903.area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
100903.dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

409541.name: Bearer of the Torch
409541.desc: Despite all that has happened, Evgenia Marie Valen, last of House Valen, will face her future and be free from her shackled past.

1531.name: Bearing Ancient Times
1531.desc: You were only worried about were stepped, but now you've noticed a gigantic tower in the distance. It must be the so-called Tower of the Oracle.

614.name: Beast Above the Wall
614.desc: As you try to escape the castle, you come to a giant wall of ice. Worse than that, two daunting warriors are lying in wait for you.

8301393.name: Beating the System
8301393.desc: The door unlocks, indicating Galene is still active. You and Vektor head into the facility, hoping to get ahead of security.

21021.name: Beautiful Cruelty
21021.desc: Luciana believes the legends, and probably thinks the gods are still humanity's enemies. Liana seems terrified of Tilith, too.

1302.name: Becoming Cinders
1302.desc: The blazing sun is wearing you down, dehydrating you. You've crossed many scorching territories so far, but somehow never seem to grow used to them.

25570021.name: Before Dawn
25570021.desc: Tensions brew hot even in the coldest of blizzards. Will this tale have a happy ending?

1566.name: Before the Dawn
1566.desc: If only Lucius would reconsider his decision of destroying humanity, a battle could be avoided... Is this mentality perhaps too idealistic?

20004.name: Before the Flame Princess
20004.desc: A cold wind dries the sweat from your forehead. Could the exit be nearby? You spot a shaft of light, but it’s guarded by a formidable-looking foe...

20000901.name: Before the Gates
20000901.desc: Deimos awakens in the paradise of his old gods, but not everything is as it seems...

1414.name: Before the Sandstorm
1414.desc: A cloudless, blue firmament above, and scorching, yellow sand beneath. As you look behind you, everything grows darker. A sandstorm is on its way.

10811.name: Before the Storm
10811.desc: As Lugina suggests, the lack of resistance so far is perplexing. You should seize the chance to press forward.

23030.name: Before the Waterfall
23030.desc: Just as Reda said, the way past here seems rather difficult. Still, the magical puppets will catch you if you stop to complain.

20012.name: Behind the Waterfall
20012.desc: You pass behind the cascading waterfall and continue to the next area. Lugina’s warning plays in your mind, but you’re too curious to turn back now.

732.name: Beings from the Bush
732.desc: Monsters leap in attack from both the muddied water as well as the thick shrubs. You'd like to catch your breath, but it seems there's nowhere to rest.

10240.name: Beiorg Strikes Again
10240.desc: Beiorg shows himself before you again. Would it be wise to fight this enemy with a function that makes him stronger after every defeat?

25550004.name: Belly of the Beast
25550004.desc: It's up to you to rescue Tilith from a rampaging sea monster! But is that all there is to it...?

20062.name: Beneath Ebony Wings
20062.desc: As if drawn by the heat of battle, monsters from far and wide descend upon your position. You can’t afford to rest until Lugina has defeated Grantos!

20011.name: Beneath the Cascade
20011.desc: A monster ambush interrupts your reverie with the scenery. Dispose of them and continue with your investigation.

25530002.name: Best Kept Secret
25530002.desc: The palace hides a dark secret Harakhte is eager to uncover.

756.name: Between Sea and Sky
756.desc: Arriving at the outskirts of the city you see a shockingly massive bridge. Before you can get to it you must confront the huge dragon on your tail.

10652.name: Between the Threads
10652.desc: Lose your footing and you'll fall into the depths. It seems like there's water down there, but this is Ishgria. You won't come out unscathed.

8301397.name: Beyond Machine
8301397.desc: Vektor and Galene finally reunite, but the Corporation has them in its grip. Will they break through this unfeeling tyranny?

1263.name: Black Hole Plaza
1263.desc: You reach the top to find a large room. As if the same type of powerful enemy had been waiting for you all along, you're suddenly attacked.

1564.name: Black Knight Advances
1564.desc: A shadow lurks in the ridge below. This figure clad in jet black armor is perhaps the lone knight the Six Heroes mentioned. It's time for battle.

1032.name: Blade of the Heart
1032.desc: You proceed around the outskirts of the bog as the rain drenches you. The enemy attacks are as relentless as the storm, taking their toll on your stamina.

543.name: Blade of the Victor
543.desc: One's belonging to the light is not set in stone. This is because one can never be fully clear that their principles are just. One must prove their righteousness with their blade.

150202.name: Blades and Blossoms
150202.desc: Sefia & Kikuri (Continue Unavailable) - Red flowers are bound to bloom on the battlefield when these two opposing forces work together!

933.name: Blades of Lightning
933.desc: Mare's strategy must be working exactly as planned. Almost completely worn out, you are practically a sitting duck for her.

802.name: Blazing Earth
802.desc: It's hot. Some cold water would be nice, but there's nothing here but boiling water. You're drenched in sweat, might as well wash off while you're here.

1511.name: Blazing Sand Quake
1511.desc: The heat haze rising from the sand is as hot as fire itself. It even makes you wonder whether it is actually aflame.

1400.name: Blazing Transgression
1400.desc: A hair raising howling can be heard. It looks like many monsters seem to inhabit this town, so there seems to be no easy escape from here.

10664.name: Blinding Dragon Speed
10664.desc: You see Liomerg on the final incline before the peak. This is probably the end of the line. Get ready for a decisive battle!

10860.name: Blinding Fog
10860.desc: You have finally reached the place where the Holy Emperor Karna Masta was sealed. Make haste to find Ilia's power for the remaining Summoners of Old.

10200.name: Blistering March
10200.desc: The lava before you makes you falter a little. No matter how many trying places you've visited, you'll need resolve to get out of this one.

10760.name: Blockaded Gate
10760.desc: You proceed down the path that Lugina and Seria cleared as they went ahead. But then enemies appeared, as though they were waiting. It's an ambush.

10063.name: Blood's Shine
10063.desc: If you look closely, you can see signs of ancient battles having taken place here. You start to wonder what the exiled disciples' battles were like.

10000.name: Blooming New Land
10000.desc: The land of the sealed demons, Ishgria. Many different creatures from those in Elgaia can be found here.

10463.name: Blowing Wind
10463.desc: The more you think about it, the more Mordlim's plans sound terrifying. How would've things played out if you hadn't done anything about it?

151503.name: Blue Blooded Bond
151503.desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.4 - Times passes, and Karl arrives in the land of Ishgria as a Summoner. There he encounters a certain dragon clan warrior...

10113.name: Blue Sea Splash
10113.desc: Mora guides you through the Wetlands. Since it's Seria and Lugina, you know they are safe, but you can't help to worry a little.

25570011.name: Blue Streams
25570011.desc: Fluffy clouds the color of the ocean invite you to take a dive.

10512.name: Blue Tower of Ice
10512.desc: Mora said that it was impossible to comprehend Amu Yunos's thinking, but you have a feeling that the same is true of her and Shusui.

730.name: Boiling Muddy Water
730.desc: You've come to an odd smelling marshland. A strange fog hangs above the water's bubbling bottomless surface. There's no use sticking around here any longer.

83016000.name: Boisterous Beginnings
83016000.desc: While wandering around a foreign forest, Mugen stumbles upon strange mushrooms and stranger visions...

1434.name: Boisterous Trees
1434.desc: The sea of trees sways as the wind hits it. One could say that even these living beings feel anxious about the future fate of the world.

8341000.name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 1
8341000.desc: Being able to prophesize, the only way she could keep going despite the dreadful war was to smile and keep fighting.

8342000.name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 2
8342000.desc: Though she lost her memory, she didn't lose her spark and will to fight, her grin only widened as she got stronger.

8343000.name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 3
8343000.desc: A fortune-teller knows that there's no way to change fate. The only way to win is to laugh and make merry. Fight-oh!

10863.name: Bonds of Friendship
10863.desc: Were it not for the timely arrival of your companions, all would be lost. But now you must regain your strength. Believe in your friends.

952.name: Bound by Darkness
952.desc: The cave is even darker than the pitch black seafloor above it. Because of this, creatures of the dark have free reign.

20000904.name: Bound By Duty
20000904.desc: Deimos resolves to defend the Golden City, as is his divine duty.

10763.name: Bound Memories
10763.desc: The two Summoners of Old are here, as are Bertz and Liomerg. The key will probably be whoever finds Mora first.

3000230.name: Bound to Darkness
3000230.desc: A trial program exclusive to Dark Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000231.name: Bound to Darkness - End
3000231.desc: A trial program exclusive to Dark Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000200.name: Bound to Earth
3000200.desc: A trial program exclusive to Earth Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000201.name: Bound to Earth - End
3000201.desc: A trial program exclusive to Earth Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000180.name: Bound to Fire
3000180.desc: A trial program exclusive to Fire Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000181.name: Bound to Fire - End
3000181.desc: A trial program exclusive to Fire Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000220.name: Bound to Light
3000220.desc: A trial program exclusive to Light Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

3000221.name: Bound to Light - End
3000221.desc: A trial program exclusive to Light Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

3000210.name: Bound to Thunder
3000210.desc: A trial program exclusive to Thunder Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

3000211.name: Bound to Thunder - End
3000211.desc: A trial program exclusive to Thunder Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

3000190.name: Bound to Water
3000190.desc: A trial program exclusive to Water Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

3000191.name: Bound to Water - End
3000191.desc: A trial program exclusive to Water Units. How will you beat your foes under such conditions? Here, your summoning skills will be tested.

8301782.name: Bounty Hunter
8301782.desc: Want more awesome stuff? You'll have to pry it out of their hands!

8301781.name: Bounty Searcher
8301781.desc: Time to grab some sweet loot! Think you're up to the task?

83016002.name: Brash Bounty
83016002.desc: Brash and rude, Mugen breaks to his own beat, but with a big bounty on the line, the search is on.

764.name: Brave in the Face of Darkness
764.desc: Enemies continue attacking, allowing no room for rest. Could they be protecting the power that Paris said was hidden here?

1012.name: Brave through the Ice
1012.desc: Just as with Karl, you have faith that Grahdens is safe. But your loss of words to console Karl is regrettable.

22043.name: Breach Interruption
22043.desc: You come to a sudden stop when you sense a powerful foe. You may have been too hasty in this. You need to calm down and stay centered as you fight.

10504.name: Breaching Black Fires
10504.desc: An incandescent wind blows by. The lava road seems to have an exit ahead, where the heat is most intense. A formidable foe most likely awaits you.

10034.name: Breaker of Silence
10034.desc: It is so quiet that you think you can hear the sound of the spores floating around you. Suddenly though, a ferocious roar breaks the silence.

2000013.name: Breaking Barriers
2000013.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

25520004.name: Breaking Free
25520004.desc: The commander's office is sure to hold every plan and secret away from prying eyes; now, their crimes will be exposed.

20000903.name: Breakthrough
20000903.desc: The ranks are thinning out...for now. Keep up the defense!

30.name: Breath Freezing Snowfields
30.desc: You've emerged into a blizzard. It's so cold, watch out for enemies with water attacks.

10643.name: Bridge of Purity
10643.desc: Apparently, formidable foes await you on the bridge. You want to conserve your strength before fighting Liomerg, but that may be impossible.

752.name: Bright Flames, Bursting Light
752.desc: Despite how desolate these ruins are, there are no signs of weapons or human remains, and the air is fresh and clean.

10440.name: Brilliant Megalopolis
10440.desc: A bright light shines over the great metropolis. Its size and structure rival those of Randall. However, oddly enough, no one seems to live here.

1055.name: Broken Days
1055.desc: The smell of blood coming from near the gate opposite to the one you entered fills your nostrils. The tower is clos, but so is a very powerful enemy force.

20303.name: Broken Machines
20303.desc: Your target has stopped moving. However, you sense a powerful feeling of malice close by. You won't be able to avoid a difficult fight.

10432.name: Broken Order
10432.desc: There are pieces of machinery scattered all over the place. They are piled up so high that you fear they make come crashing down.

510.name: Broken Silence
510.desc: You cross over the ash covered hills to find a beautiful lakeside. However, before you can rest another horde of new monsters appear before you.

25011.name: Broken Woods
25011.desc: Neither Mel nor Garrett, nor even Bertz would listen to you. There really shouldn't have been any need for combat.

25590005.name: Brokenstone
25590005.desc: One of many early outposts during the incursion, the floor is now littered with chipped rock and steel.

10820.name: Budding Doubt
10820.desc: The end of summoning arts? With the final battle impending, you have no time to consider the ramifications. But, it remains at the back of your mind.

1433.name: Budding Earth
1433.desc: Breeze blows strongly through the trees, picking up old leaves, and fluttering new ones. This is the force that transforms the forest anew.

25550005.name: Buried Shinies
25550005.desc: Nyami and Faelan aren't going to pass up this opportunity to find the shiniest of shinies on a beach full of sparkling starsand!

20301.name: Buried Steel
20301.desc: The land around you is covered in broken machines, and the sharp debris makes for bad footing. You have to hurry or you'll lose sight of your goal.

10802.name: Burning Battlefield
10802.desc: Hellish flames roar all around. You must conserve your strength as you dispatch the approaching foes. The path looks longer than anticipated.

10104.name: Burning Claws & Tusks
10104.desc: A ferocious roar echoes through the cavern. At the same time, you feel a cool breeze waft in. It looks like the exit is near.

8301571.name: Burning Dread
8301571.desc: The Bringer of Chaos finally reveals himself.

8301104.name: Burning Electrocution
8301104.desc: Learn to harness the power of Fire and Thunder with a sparring match versus Mai and Benimaru! Are you ready for this?

107600.name: Burning Soul Lv. 1
107600.desc: You can see the great Royal Capital before you after crossing the gate. As you approach it with care, a huge arena catches your eye.

107601.name: Burning Soul Lv. 2
107601.desc: A blonde young man awaits in the otherworldly arena of the Royal Capital smiling fearlessly as he unsheathes his blade. Challenges seem to please him.

107602.name: Burning Soul Lv. 3
107602.desc: The many marks around the arena suggest men and beasts have fought here before. How many battles to the death has this place seen on a regular basis?

10402.name: Burning Splash
10402.desc: The heat of the lava intensifies the atmosphere around you. Fighting under these conditions makes it hard to breathe. Careful not to break something.

8311999.name: Burny & Friends UNLEASHED! Lv. 1
8311999.desc: Frustrated that they're always being picked on, Burny and friends set out on a rampage to create chaos. MWAHAHAHA!

8310212.name: Burny & Friends UNLEASHED! Lv. 2
8310212.desc: Seeing how much chaos he and his friends can cause, Nice Burny leads them on a rampage to cause greater chaos to whiny summoners. KEKEKEKEKEKE!

741.name: Bursts of Lightning
741.desc: Your ears begin ringing as lightning endlessly crashes down. The air is thick with the odor of a burnt tree which has been struck by lightning.

10601.name: Calamity's Howling
10601.desc: Disciple Liomerg addressed Karl respectfully. It seems that the demon in Karl's bloodline is the ruler of this land.

1166.name: Call of the Storm
1166.desc: You've reached the spiral staircase inside the tower of the castle. It isn't tall, but it's full of enemies, the strongest awaiting you at the end.

24010.name: Capability Confirmed
24010.desc: The gods of Grand Gaia were surprised you came to this world, and perhaps not so surprisingly, you don't seem to be welcome. Prepare for a fight...

25600008.name: Capricious Candy
25600008.desc: Help Carrol and Bonnie mop up the ferocious, oddly goopy beasts terrorizing the village!

10744.name: Captivating Lands
10744.desc: Your eyes are growing tired, possibly because of the shining cave. They're also dry, and your vision is blurry. Getting attacked now would be risky.

1464.name: Carved Slab
1464.desc: Reading the few words you can make out from the headstones, you gather that this was once one of the most important places in Atharva.

21000.name: Castle on the Lake
21000.desc: The old castle ringed with a half-frozen lake like a moat makes you think of scenes from Grand Gaia. Who could possibly live here?

521.name: Castle Winds
521.desc: The Sky Fort is still far off. A faint magical power lingers in the pleasantly windblown air within the old castle. What could it be?

20001.name: Cave-Dwelling Assassins
20001.desc: Beyond the huge gate unfolds a fiery cave. It doesn’t look like you’ll find anything worthy of investigation here, so keep moving forward.

20.name: Cave of Dancing Flames
20.desc: The magma flowing within this cave gives off an intense heat. The enemies in this cave have the power of fire.

110320.name: Celestial Garden
110320.desc: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside...

20704.name: Central Block
20704.desc: You've arrived at the central block. Find the being that protects Bectas, and your mission is complete. Yet you feel like you're forgetting something.

763.name: Challenge from the Underworld
763.desc: You've finally made it to the bridge's halfway point. As the enemies are growing stronger, it seems fighting through the second half will only be more difficult.

3000010.name: Challengers' Hall
3000010.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

3000015.name: Challengers' Hall - End
3000015.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

3000011.name: Challengers' Hall - Floor 2
3000011.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

3000012.name: Challengers' Hall - Floor 3
3000012.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

3000013.name: Challengers' Hall - Floor 4
3000013.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

3000014.name: Challengers' Hall - Floor 5
3000014.desc: A system Noel created in order to help Summoners train themselves. Strong opponents will attack any challenger that steps before them.

1477.name: Changing the World
1477.desc: Eriole's ideas are warped. The idea that a bloody revolution can bring about a peaceful future cannot possibly be true. He must be stopped.

1501.name: Chanting Spirits
1501.desc: After fighting away the dragons, you hear the voices of the deceased singing around you. It looks like the creatures of this forest mean to stop you.

150504.name: Chaos
150504.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 5 - Luly becomes the catalyst for the fight between Alyut's forces and Sodis's supporters.

22074.name: Chaos in Heaven
22074.desc: This should be your last fight in the castle. You can sense more power from the Mystical Phoenix than any other sealed god so far. Give it your all!

10503.name: Chaotic Fires
10503.desc: The enemies you face at every turn here are quite strong. However, you have built up ample power to defeat them. Move ahead boldly!

107300.name: Chariot of God Lv. 1
107300.desc: You stand before a temple of curious design. Not only is its appearance overbearing, but it also exudes an intense air of benevolence.

107301.name: Chariot of God Lv. 3
107301.desc: Inside the temple, a multitude of candles flicker in the darkness. You proceed with extreme caution atop the red carpet sprawled on the floor.

107302.name: Chariot of God Lv. 6
107302.desc: You hear haunting voices chanting from afar. Their amalgamation strikes a cord deep within you.

8301363.name: Chasing Shadows
8301363.desc: The party tries to cheer Nick up, but a shadow from the past pays them another unwanted visit…

8360061.name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 1
8360061.desc: As Athensphere was torn apart and condemned into the abyss of the Vortex, an eternal conflict continues beneath the fissure it once stood upon.

8360062.name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 2
8360062.desc: Though there is much to salvage of the once mighty lands, a ferocious creation wreaks havoc and kills anyone who dares enter the domain.

8360063.name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 3
8360063.desc: From above the chasm, screams and growls of victims and demons echo on below. Can anyone step up and bring the destruction to an end?

8301222.name: Cherry Blossom Concert
8301222.desc: Meanwhile, a concert is already underway in a forgotten forest. Miku presses on and soon realizes she isn't the only singer in this bizarre world...

20001300.name: Chilling Beauties
20001300.desc: Stand against the frigid assault from sisters Hilda and Rene, two Demonlords of Nogreth!

5200002.name: Choice for the Future
5200002.desc: The Akras Summoners' Hall has been notified of the appearance of a great god-like presence from another world, so the Summoner and Grahdens head towards it. There they run into Karl and Seria, who are protecting people who fight for humanity in their home world amidst a  war among multitudes of gods. The Summoners must now help these girls get back home.

10421.name: Circle of Life
10421.desc: Seemingly a clump of plants from afar, from up close one can see that a lot of care was put into planting these trees. This garden was man-made.

150802.name: Circling Strategy
150802.desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 3 - The Six Pillars are sealed in to pay for their betrayal. The one who survives this will be granted freedom, but...

10261.name: Circuit Courtyard
10261.desc: As you look at the lights that flash on the floors and walls, you feel as if you had been swallowed by a giant machine. Perhaps that's what happened?

10454.name: City of Shadows
10454.desc: There seems to be an even deeper darkness lurking ahead. Walking this underground city makes you feel like you've fallen into the underworld.

20000907.name: City Sentinel
20000907.desc: The intruders grow bolder and stronger with every assault. Destroy them before they breach the gates!

8301183.name: Clash
8301183.desc: Kitsu and Linlin are finally reunited! They have no time to catch up, though, as the fox, fairy and bear are quickly surrounded by Kitsu's pursuers.

10620.name: Clash of Powers
10620.desc: A beautiful view of the continent extends before you. Compared to some other places, it's actually quite scenic.

8301433.name: Clean-Up Crew
8301433.desc: As a one-woman Woodland Patrol, Feora is eager to lend her bat to the task. Help a girl out before she steps in another nest!

25580005.name: Cleaning Day
25580005.desc: That rattling sound in the basement doesn't bode well. Take a look?

10460.name: Clear Skies
10460.desc: It turns out Mordlim was just like the demons before it--an enemy of humanity. What Mora said still has you worried, but you must defeat this demon.

23040.name: Cliffs of Courage
23040.desc: You reunite with Grahdens and advance along a sheer cliffside route. It's still extremely dangerous, but much easier than the waterfall climb.

10762.name: Closed Doors
10762.desc: It's said that the demons fell into an era of chaotic war after their leader left. It would appear this castle's purpose was lost afterwards, as well.

10751.name: Closed Paths
10751.desc: A vicious, howling wind rolls over the side of the cliffs. Your body is stripped of all the warmth it accumulated within the cave in an instant.

409561.name: Coast Guard
409561.desc: Pirate activity has been reported along the coasts. Ensure the safety of the locals by standing guard!

5000002.name: Cobalt Spirit's Waking
5000002.desc:
Not long after defeating Zevalhua, one of the Four Fallen gods, Karl and Seria show up to ask the Summoner for help in defeating Graham, the demon they have been after for so many years.
As the three of them reach the region Graham oversees, many of his sly traps lie in waiting unbeknownst to them.

10750.name: Cold, Dark Places
10750.desc: Lugina said Karl's kindness was weakness. So what is strength? In all its grandeur, nature gives no answer.

20033.name: Cold-Hearted Sentries
20033.desc: Two monstrous birds, more ferocious than anything else you’ve encountered, lie in wait to stop the advance of any would-be intruders into their territory.

8320118.name: Cold Awakenings
8320118.desc: In the shattered remains of Nick's workshop, two very different creatures come to life. What could be the story behind their magical awakening?

8301143.name: Cold Cauldron
8301143.desc: Witness your final showdown with Natalame! Will you stand tall, or will you bite the desert dust? Ready! Steady! Go!

21002.name: Cold Winds
21002.desc: Did the culture of this world influence Grand Gaia just as the one on Bectas did? Or was it Grand Gaia that influenced this world?

1231.name: Collapse of the Beast
1231.desc: Water tainted red and a mysterious creature shining light by it. Out of all the places you've been to so far, this one feels the eeriest. Be careful.

10202.name: Color of Fire
10202.desc: It's so hot you want to resort to Lugina's rude vocabulary to describe the temperature. Your skin stings too, perhaps because you're a bit burnt?

8301415.name: Colored Gods
8301415.desc: Marianne needs your help to tame the Crystal Gods!

10844.name: Coming of the Light
10844.desc: As your eyes adjust to the light, you find your way outside the structure. The sudden plunge into blackness leaves you disoriented and vulnerable.

10501.name: Commander of Flames
10501.desc: It seems the demon that rules this land has hair a color unlike any you have seen thus far. You could say it's very demonic, or not demonic at all.

51.name: Commander of the Thunder
51.desc: It looks to be a vast wetland. The terrain may prove more troublesome than the thunder-wielding enemies hiding in it.

21020.name: Commence Pursuit
21020.desc: Luciana has moved ahead despite Liana's effort to stop her. It seems our presence has had negative effects. You have to catch up to her.

23023.name: Common Front
23023.desc: You agreed to work with the Abel Faction in order to defeat the magical puppets. The plan is to form three teams of two and surround the puppets.

151400.name: Comrades Assemble
151400.desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 1 - Humanity has found hope in the new land of Elgaia. However, a threat quickly approaches!

8301533.name: Concessions
8301533.desc: The mobs don't let up, prompting Lydia to propose a change in location...

25021.name: Conflagration of Woes
25021.desc: Mel is coming along complacently. You're glad you didn't have to restrain her, but her behavior seems a bit odd.

150505.name: Conflicting Beliefs
150505.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 6 - The final battle of the 12 Guardians draws near. They haven't even stopped to consider each other's feelings...

151002.name: Confronting a God
151002.desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 3 - The final battle between the Oracle Knight's Troop and Karna Masta, the god who seeks to destroy humanity, begins now!

10910.name: Conquer the Ashes
10910.desc: Amidst the falling ash, you eventually reach something like a town center. Many months and years of history lay in ruins all around you.

10853.name: Conquer the Dark
10853.desc: Lights flicker here and there, but only make it more difficult to peer into the shadows. Before your eyes can adjust, you press on ahead.

344.name: Conqueror of the Heavens
344.desc: The exit is in sight, but a giant entity can be seen swooping down from the heavens, possibly to deliver your final trial...

151301.name: Conspiracy in Motion
151301.desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 2 - Kulyuk sets out to meet the Holy Emperor, but this is just the beginning of the tragedy for him and his followers...

83014210.name: Contender Alpha
83014210.desc: Join Leona and Kula Diamond to defeat Mai Shiranui.

1550.name: Control Gate
1550.desc: Ark's words had a strong impact. What does Lucius plan to do with humanity now? There's no choice but to seek him and ask him directly.

3000000.name: Corridor of Memories
3000000.desc: Welcome to a special dungeon created in honor of Brave Frontier's 1 year anniversary. Tough enemies await you to help you remember the good 'ol days!

773.name: Corridor of Ruin
773.desc: The tower's shaking has grown stronger. The oppressive rythmic sound bears heavily on your chest. What is it that Paris saw here?

3000270.name: Courageous Assault
3000270.desc: A trial program exclusive to male Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000271.name: Courageous Assault - End
3000271.desc: A trial program exclusive to male Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

409521.name: Courting Enemies
409521.desc: An unexpected incident throws the burdens of the new king of Elysia and his family into stark relief.

10152.name: Crafty Shadow
10152.desc: A bad feeling once again. You've felt this countless times by now, this evil intent to kill. And combined with the miasma, chills run down your spine.

10022.name: Crashing Waves
10022.desc: To your surprise you find creatures resembling fish and small shrimp swimming in the acid. This place is definitely different from Elgaia.

1351.name: Crawling Toward Death
1351.desc: There are still many enemies left on the way to the castle. Surely Karl and the others will have to face even more of them as you move on ahead.

8301422.name: Crazy Gourmet [Daily]
8301422.desc: The climax of the battle has arrived! Will you see victory - or will you be gnawed on in the throes of defeat?

151501.name: Created Avengers
151501.desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.2 - As the head of the dragon clan's new wife, Mariela gained a child, but that gives rise to a new tragedy...

8301692.name: Creation God Odin
8301692.desc: As chief among the gods in Valhalla, Odin is a mighty warrior who protects Valhalla fiercely and as such, should not be taken lightly. Will you prevail in a trial against him?

1333.name: Creator of Ruin
1333.desc: A bright bolt of lightning tears the sky apart. After a second of waiting, a deafening sound hits your ears. Lighting struck dangerously close.

365.name: Creator of the World
365.desc: At last, you've reached Maxwell. The battle to save Tilith and destroy the first of the four fallen gods begins now...

8311010.name: Crimson Fields
8311010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields glow red from the emergence of Fire Bulbs, buzzed and excited.

1164.name: Crimson Waltz
1164.desc: Entering once again inside, your eyes spot a great fireplace glowing red. Nearby, in the dimly lit room, stands a chair made of leather.

24072.name: Critical Future
24072.desc: Rahnas is one step ahead of you. If your power is stolen, a painful battle most likely awaits you. You have to stop him before that can happen!

10733.name: Crossing Currents
10733.desc: While it's better than the plains or the woods, it's still cold here. It's so cold that you're almost eager to fight with Shusui already.

5008003.name: Crossing the Abyss
5008003.desc: The final journey into the heart of Fuindor begins. What foes will our intrepid heroes face?

1420.name: Crossing the River
1420.desc: After leaving the great the desert behind, you come across a river so big that the shore seems invisible. It will take a lot of effort to cross it.

8301582.name: Crossroad Slope
8301582.desc: The path diverges, and down these slopes you hear strange voices echoing all around the walls.

8301581.name: Crossroad Stairs
8301581.desc: The path diverges, and from a distance you see a glowing light up a set of stairs.

1480.name: Crucible of Confusion
1480.desc: You discover a cave dispersing an ominous miasma. There are traces of a strong seal at the entrance, but you seem to be able to come and go freely.

23011.name: Crumbling Masonry
23011.desc: The ruins nearby are obviously too large to have been for human use. But why are they half-destroyed? Was there a battle here?

10132.name: Crushing Flash
10132.desc: You feel something ominous. A frightfully strong enemy is bound to show itself at any minute, but there seems to be no way to escape.

1212.name: Crystal Love Song
1212.desc: The sounds of waves mix with a voice in song. They sing the magical song of a water spirit. The enemy isn't strong, but don't let it slow you down.

10470.name: Curious Lesser Gods
10470.desc: There is a secret sky garden behind the botanical garden. You're pretty sure you will encounter the demon Mordlim there, though she's been defeated.

530.name: Curse of the Ravine
530.desc: There is a rumor about a monster that lives in this ravine that turns everything it sees into stone. There are few who view this widely known ghost story as being true.

1401.name: Cursed Singing Voice
1401.desc: A beautiful singing voice lingers in the air. Could this be the work of a demon as well? And why have so many monsters gathered in this ghost town?

10251.name: Curtain of Night
10251.desc: The stairs keep going up, and up. You start to worry about Owen, but according to what Seria and Lugina said, you just have to trust he's fine.

331.name: Cyclops of Lightning
331.desc: Mt. Wistorea is the steepest in the area, but its calm weather makes it the most comfortable environment so far.

20001010.name: Daily Tan
20001010.desc: This odd group of natives show up daily to get a nice suntan. And like the other natives, they do not seem to appreciate you taking up their favourite spot.

1060.name: Dance in the Clouds
1060.desc: You finally reach the tower atop the cape. Head for its top for your showdown against Zevalhua. Defeat the Fallen God so you can save Grahdens!

1163.name: Dance of Ice
1163.desc: This seems to be the courtyard. It is lined with beautiful sculptures, and the pond is filled with clean water. However, enemies still lurk nearby.

262.name: Dance of Lightning Flames
262.desc: Is this only the halfway point? You can still hear the cries from the fierce battle raging below... It's time to hurry.

20044.name: Dance of the Knight
20044.desc: Countless monsters appear as if to drive the intruders from their hallowed tower. But what are they protecting? Part of Cordelica's past, or some other hidden truth?

1502.name: Dance of the Pixies
1502.desc: You get the eerie feeling that someone's watching you. Could it be Ark? No, this stare is from the beings dwelling in the forest.

10521.name: Dancing Greenery
10521.desc: As you head to the ruins that the forest has enveloped, you catch unsettling glimpses of what seems to be a giant through the trees.

1162.name: Dancing Light Blades
1162.desc: You exit into a grand space decorated with swords. The countless scars that adorn the walls and pillars show the intense battle that took place here.

10413.name: Dancing Lights
10413.desc: Though this shiny water is strange, it is beautiful in its own way. If there were no danger lurking about, it would be the perfect place for a stroll.

1103.name: Dancing Sparks
1103.desc: The cave ceiling is higher here. The surrounding flames are different in this area. What manner of flame waits ahead?

10120.name: Dangerous Imps
10120.desc: The power of a person similar to Karl has been awakened? What could it mean? You hope Karl is safe as you wonder what this is all about.

10003.name: Dangerous Resources
10003.desc: You still feel no presence of menacing demons around you. It was wrong to think that they would be running rampant here, but don't get careless.

10223.name: Dangerous Scent
10223.desc: A very misplaced and dense floral aroma drifts in the air. You still don't know much about Ishgria's nature, so you would do well to be cautious.

1465.name: Dangerous Territory
1465.desc: You feel something cold run down your spine. Feeling an evil presence, you look around you. Darkness is closing in, the enemy's coming!

10230.name: Dangerous Wind
10230.desc: As something fearsome drops from the heavens and comes after you, you realize there is no room to talk. The battle has already started.

1442.name: Dark Clouds Await
1442.desc: The thunder and lightning that falls here is absorbed by the mountain. It has accumulated so much after the years that it might burst any minute now.

10153.name: Dark Echoing Song
10153.desc: When you look behind you, it seems as if all the land were illuminated by lightning. Perhaps it's the dragon's suffering. A long bridge stands ahead.

10161.name: Dark God's Trap
10161.desc: Crossing the great bridge with Lugina reminds you of your time in Lizeria. With that in mind you wonder how your relationship has made it this far.

1223.name: Dark Green Concerto
1223.desc: Exiting to an open space lit by the sun, the birds shriek. A hero with a weapon from another world, and another with a magic lance, stand before you.

100613.name: Dark Metal Parade
100613.desc: A grand procession featuring Dark Metal monsters with loads of Dark experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

10551.name: Dark Necromancy
10551.desc: You sense an almost-familiar presence. It could be that Shusui has caught up with you. Time to hurry.

451.name: Dark Night Requiem
451.desc: The remains of a city thought to have at one time prided itself on its extravagance. It seems someone is controlling the spirits who would otherwise be at rest here.

10554.name: Dark Phantom Aura
10554.desc: You have reached the giant's feet. You should be able to walk to Amu Yunos's tower from here. You must be prepared for anything.

8360506.name: Dark Shadows
8360506.desc: A young girl searching for her parents meets a dashing male amidst the shadows. Is this what they call fate?

463.name: Dark Surge
463.desc: There is light and darkness wherever you go. But still, where did the darkness in the Amdahl Empire come from? There's probably no longer anyone around that knows.

83016605.name: Dark Tales
83016605.desc: Mysteries and myths abound in these dark tales of men and monsters alike.

10854.name: Darkest Night
10854.desc: On the outskirts of town, you feel a familiar air of destitution and desperation. You suppose the bad areas are not much different in any world.

24064.name: Darkness's Inducement
24064.desc: You have the uneasy feeling you're being watched from the darkness. To get through the cave, probably your only option is to defeat a powerful foe.

21061.name: Darkness a Step Ahead
21061.desc: The Abel Faction was ahead of you in this world, too. How much information are they getting before the Summoners' Hall does?

22010.name: Darkness Amid Light
22010.desc: You've heard of warriors called shinobi. Does that mean someone from Ohbanahara became a Grand Gaian hero?

8301148.name: Darkness Within
8301148.desc: Near the gate, a shadowy figure appears. Who is he, and just what are his intentions?

10443.name: Dashing Ray of Light
10443.desc: Though you're wondering why the demon of this land has not sought you out, don't forget that a certain persistent demon may come seeking a fight.

20501.name: Data Overload
20501.desc: You've gotten used to fighting for yourself alongside Summoning. You feel like you've grown to understand why Karl and Seria fight this way.

8360507.name: Dawn Breaking
8360507.desc: The darkest hour is just before the dawn. To be able to see the light, one must face their darkest demons!

24002.name: Day/Night Divide
24002.desc: Looking up at the stars under a blue sky is also something you feel you could get used to. You may come back for stargazing once everything's done.

1045.name: Daylight behind Her
1045.desc: You avoided the god of destruction, but now you must face the warrior with eight blades on her back. This is a crucial stage--your enemies have no plans to rest.

22001.name: Daylight Shadows
22001.desc: You see a band of people in black chasing a woman. You don't understand the situation, but she's clearly in danger!

21012.name: Days of Collapse
21012.desc: The Mystical Wolf's change is probably related to this land's sealed god. If so, your survey will probably also help to save this world's people.

22044.name: Dazzling Flames
22044.desc: As expected, you've run into a skilled warrior. But why does this warrior know about the sealed god? You'll have to fight to find out.

10630.name: Deadly Gatekeeper
10630.desc: There's nothing you can say to Paris in her distress. You just have to believe she'll find an answer for herself.

20042.name: Deadly Melody
20042.desc: The higher you climb, the tougher the monsters seem to get. Amid all the chaos, the sound of a beautiful and bewitching singing voice beckons you ever higher.

503.name: Death and Rebirth
503.desc: Fire has both the power to incinerate everything and to restore life. Harnessing these powers, fallen gods continue to roam these lands as they always have.

10074.name: Death God's Purgatory
10074.desc: You can feel a great power ahead, but it doesn't belong to a demon. Could it be Shusui's last trial? Better prepare yourself before proceeding.

1251.name: Death God of Darkness
1251.desc: This eerie place makes it feel like ghosts could appear at any moment. Proceed with caution. You're getting closer to enemy territory now.

20603.name: Death or Creation
20603.desc: You feel something unpleasant, but it's not malice. Is it a premonition? Watch for dangerous enemies near the building as you advance.

10252.name: Decaying Corpses
10252.desc: Even though there seems to be no end to this staircase, the enemies don't find it a problem to attack you. Be careful not to miss your step and fall.

107000.name: Deceiving Blade Lv. 6
107000.desc: A spy from the Randall Empire had infiltrated the Elgaia Federation. He fought alone to discover the truth behind the Ishgria Expedition.

107001.name: Deceiving Blade Lv. 7
107001.desc: With no way to return home, he continued his investigation. Even now, his soul seeks a path home, to give his final report.

524.name: Deception of the Spirit World
524.desc: An otherworldly warrior with some tricks up his sleeve blocks your exit from the old castle. He attacks with an indiscriminate barrage of gunfire!

25580006.name: Deep Clean
25580006.desc: Basements shouldn't house this many suspiciously aggressive creatures, but this one does.

1122.name: Deep in the Green
1122.desc: The heroes who block your path are the same ones who once opposed the gods. Now summoned by those same gods, what could they be thinking?

24061.name: Deepest Dark Night
24061.desc: If Rahnas gains true Summoning power, what does he intend to do with it? Bertz said he wanted to protect Elgaia, but...

24041.name: Deepest Green
24041.desc: Like the lake, this forest also makes you introspective. It's clear what you need to do now. Stop thinking about unnecessary things.

150702.name: Defeat & the Future
150702.desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 3 - The fight against Vishra begins changing everyone individually, including Vishra himself...

10603.name: Defense and Counters
10603.desc: It might be your imagination, but it seems like the enemies here are much more self-aware than any before, and that their attacks are more strategic.

1224.name: Defense at Any Cost
1224.desc: A mountain made of stone suddenly appears before you. Just when you thought it was in your way, it swings at you. It's a puppet controlled by magic!

10500.name: Defiant Flames
10500.desc: Having passed through lava belts all across the land, you should be used to places like this. Avoid taking risks, and watch your step.

10532.name: Defiant Thunder
10532.desc: Lightning flashes, illuminating the sky. You hear an earsplitting roar and a suspicious shadow passes high above. It seems you have airborne enemies.

21074.name: Defiled Soul
21074.desc: It seems the Mystical Wolf's minions have surrounded the area, but you can't let yourself lose for Luciana and Liana's sakes!

25041.name: Defiled Square
25041.desc: Bertz's desire to prevent another such tragedy is pure. For all that's happened, you can probably still reach an understanding with him.

25020.name: Delaying Tactics
25020.desc: You can't allow the demon to go free. You have to get Mel to stop standing in your way somehow, and hurry after Garrett!

1455.name: Demanding Justice
1455.desc: Could this garden have been made by human hands? How could it have remained so beautiful without any people left to care for it?

8381130.name: Demented Trails
8381130.desc: Evil descends into the darkened lands, haunting the timid and assaulting the unwary.

8361000.name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 1
8361000.desc: The half-demon daughter of a dark lord is always seeking a thrill by feeding her restless blood. Battle Maidens? Sounds like fun.

8362000.name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 2
8362000.desc: Nothing bores her more than incompetent, weak fighters. The demon in her is telling her to fight to survive, and devour to succeed.

8363000.name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 3
8363000.desc: She doesn't care if a human, god, or demon stands in her way. Her demon blade will only stop for someone who excites her...but only for brief while.

10351.name: Demon Crystal Cave
10351.desc: Crystals that sparkle amidst the darkness are beautiful. They are lovely to look at, but could they really be as dangerous as that man claims?

10010.name: Demon Invasion
10010.desc: A demon appears before you and suddenly attacks. There is no escape. Especially now that you'll serve as a sacrifice for the goddess!

1252.name: Demon King's Reign
1252.desc: A feeling of uneasiness lingers in the air, but you travel lightly on your feet. Knowing you must defeat the Fallen God, there's no time to waste.

107100.name: Demon Lord Lv. 1
107100.desc: You've crossed the Vortex gate and find yourself in a luxurious room. You proceed with caution, though you seem to always end up in the same place...

107101.name: Demon Lord Lv. 3
107101.desc: You keep wandering inside the lavish palace. Its internal structure seems improbable, and you begin noticing that you can't really move forth.

107102.name: Demon Lord Lv. 6
107102.desc: Walking around the extravagant palace, you come across a terrible presence in its depths. Chills run through you as a giant door stands before you.

10151.name: Demon People
10151.desc: The black rocks and red lava remind you of the first caverns you passed through. It's not that hot here, but you're thrown off by the ominous miasma.

762.name: Demon Sword's Flash
762.desc: The closer you get to the tower, the more hightened your fear becomes. It's as if the tower itself was infused with some sort of evil energy.

5000000.name: Demonic Agitation
5000000.desc:
Shortly after defeating Maxwell, one of the Four Fallen Gods, Karl suddenly appears to ask the Summoner's help in defeating a dragon.
Not only is this dragon quite strong, but it is said to flee the second it senses danger.
The Summoner and Karl plan a strategy to prevent the dragon from running away, when suddenly...

8383130.name: Demonic Vindication
8383130.desc: Are you ready to face your fears and conquer the hellborn itself? Assist Ciara & Semira in defeating it!

409571.name: Den Delving
409571.desc: A sweep into the pirate dens at the Howling Break should serve as ample deterrent to their pillaging ways.

761.name: Denial of Death's Curse
761.desc: Turning back, you see the ruins. Compared to that desolate yet pure place, the bridge is soaked in an ominous miasma. What could be waiting ahead?

25053.name: Denouement
25053.desc: You face the demon after it absorbs Garrett's life energy, but you have no fear. You're not fighting for the past. This is for the future.

25040.name: Departed Sanctuary
25040.desc: You were shocked to learn that Lugina and Bertz were born in this region. Both probably have terrifying memories of the demon that destroyed it.

20705.name: Departing
20705.desc: Lugina breaks through a wall and appears. You don't have time to ask questions. For now, defeat the massive automaton he called the "Divine Machine"!

441.name: Descending Force
441.desc: A warrior carrying a massive sword appears before you as you're searching for information on the Four Heroes. He swings at you as he approaches.

1300.name: Desert Hound
1300.desc: You look far into the distance and notice the shadow of an eerie castle. They say that it is the last form Afla Dilith morphed into...

10770.name: Desire to be the Best
10770.desc: Face Seria's feelings, and give this battle your all. It will help your friend find her own path.

25052.name: Desires Bearing Fruit
25052.desc: You sense a repulsive presence. It's definitely distinct from the other demons you've faced. You're probably close to where it's sealed; keep moving.

8301263.name: Desirous Mochi
8301263.desc: The rabbits were enticed by a mysterious girl making what seems to be fluffy rice cakes. With a giggle, she playfully requests that you play a game with her!
