8313104.name: Destination: Forest Frolic
8313104.desc: New on the list, the mysterious North has opened up for an exclusive look at the Vale! A faery fun opportunity for all ages!

8313100.name: Destination: Sandy Jaunt
8313100.desc: This summer's most popular trip takes you to the wonderful Southern beaches! Sunscreen and monster repellant sold separately.

10270.name: Destroyed God
10270.desc: Behind the castle and down the cliff lies a forest of dry trees. Will another demonic shadow show itself here? No more demons should be around, but...

25022.name: Devastated Plains
25022.desc: Perhaps it's because you weren't a great student, but you've never heard about any demons appearing here. The information may have been suppressed.

8301585.name: Devilish Darkness
8301585.desc: Dark motes dance before you, dipping into the shadows like an inkwell.

83016608.name: Dimming Light
83016608.desc: As the land begins to dim from the setting sun, the snowscape is awash in glittering orange hues.

502.name: Dinner for Watchdogs
502.desc: You can hear the cry of not one beast but many coming from the fiery hills. Who could possibly command such fearful roars?

23053.name: Discerning Eyes
23053.desc: This temple is clearly split into bright and dark locations, and it seems this was deliberate. Who, or what, could've built this place?

150300.name: Disciple of Ruin
150300.desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 1 - A white presence suddenly appears, destroying all in its path. Elsewhere, a suspicious dark presence awakens as well.

322.name: Discord of the Earth
322.desc: You continue deeper into the crimson forest. Suddenly, drops as red as blood fall down on you from the trees above.

10621.name: Dividing Walls
10621.desc: Circle around a cliff, climb a slope, look for a path, and climb back down, again and again. But you caught sight of something like a waterfall ahead.

107200.name: Divine Powers Lv. 1
107200.desc: You take in the strange scenery before you. Overwhelmed by the divine atmosphere of the place, you watch as a so-called angel begins his descent.

107201.name: Divine Powers Lv. 3
107201.desc: While enjoying the magnificent atmosphere of the place, you see countless angels floating above you. Their beautiful formation moves you.

107202.name: Divine Powers Lv. 6
107202.desc: The otherworldly beings in the room are immersed in keeping their order, which makes you want to do the same. Make sure not to lose yourself as well.

8301471.name: Divine Resonance
8301471.desc: Hetepheres imbues herself with incredible nimbleness in the fight against the inexplicable undead.

1554.name: Divine Sword's Anger
1554.desc: The curse of Karna Masta... Summoning was believed to be a power granted by Lucius, but things seem more complicated than that.

21070.name: Divine Territory
21070.desc: Cold air...no, a presence so tense it hurts. This alone tells you the immense power of the sealed god. Just what is this sealed god?

8301132.name: Dizzying Golden Locks
8301132.desc: More newcomers have arrived, including a strange two-winged girl, and her blond companion. They claim to be looking for a friend in a wedding gown...

10624.name: Do-or-Die Resolve
10624.desc: You can faintly hear what seems to be rushing water. That dam-like structure must be close. The enemies are fighting harder, as well.

8301524.name: Double Up!
8301524.desc: The fiery spirit has a little proposition to double the odds for a rematch.

412.name: Dragon's Roar
412.desc: You can hear a water dragon's roar even from inside the ship. Is this howl meant to get rid of those who disturb the souls of the dead crew members?

804.name: Dragon Captain's Roadblock
804.desc: A wind blows in from outside. It's fresh feel invigorates you. However, you sense a powerful thirst coming from where the wind is blowing. It's likely a strong foe.

10600.name: Dragon Disciple Raid
10600.desc: An individual with the head of a dragon suddenly attacks. He identifies himself as a follower of the land's demon ruler, and you must fight back.

1211.name: Dragon in the Abyss
1211.desc: Surprised by the sounds of footsteps, they turn out to be only small crabs. Walking on the rocky area washed by the waves, you feel like you'll slip.

8301321.name: Dragon of Destruction
8301321.desc: The great black dragon Acnologia suddenly appears from the rift! Put an end to his rampage before he destroys Grand Gaia with his overwhelming power!

24000.name: Dragon Paradise
24000.desc: Look up and you'll see a myriad of stars twinkling in the blue sky even in the daytime, reflecting the many dragons flying overhead.

10662.name: Dragon Scale Defense
10662.desc: You approach the midpoint of the mountain trail. Ahead, at the peak, you can sense a presence so powerful it stifles your spirit. Is it a dragon?

10660.name: Dragon Talon Breaker
10660.desc: As expected, it's difficult to talk with demons. But they might be more cooperative if you demonstrate your power?

10001.name: Dragons & People
10001.desc: A large and strangely designed stone structure stands before you. Obviously from a different culture, it draws both curiosity and fear.

151502.name: Dragons Versus Lions
151502.desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.3 - Desires violently collide as Lyonesse seeks to protect the child of the dragon clan's chief from Sonia and Serge.

722.name: Dragoon in the Shade
722.desc: Step after shaky step, you cross the surface of the frozen lake. Looking back, you realize you've made it exactly halfway. How long will the ice hold?

25570009.name: Dreamy Distractions
25570009.desc: Take a leisurely, lucid stroll through the Dream World. What will you find there?

651.name: Dregs of Battle
651.desc: A spirit possessed by the thrill of battle, and the one who pursues it. As long as their fight continues, they will never disappear.

1062.name: Drenched in Crimson
1062.desc: A hero from another world is waiting for you on this floor. Though it will not be an easy fight, it should be a fair one since you made it this far.

766.name: Duel on the Bridge
766.desc: Not much longer to the tower. Lugina still hasn't shown up yet so it's highly likely he's waiting somewhere around here. Proceed with caution.

8323001.name: Duo of Virtue
8323001.desc: Defeated but finally freed, the couple wonders if their bond is still as strong as it was in the past.

100800.name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 1
100800.desc: Living among the shadows, his pride as a ninja warrants him little contact with others. Few are harder to pin down than he.

100801.name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 2
100801.desc: Acting under the cover of night, there's no objective he can't achieve. Who knows what it'd take to capture such a man.

100802.name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 3
100802.desc: Enveloped in a burning red darkness, only the strongest could even stir this man, whose training has cleansed him of all desire.

100803.name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 4
100803.desc: A man whose soul that is one with the darkness and mastered total discipline within. To see a red glow in the shadows would deem one's certain death.

1120.name: Dweller in the Depths
1120.desc: This forest was once home to a prosperous city, the ruins of which can be seen periodically through the undergrowth. What could've happened to it?

352.name: Dwelling of the Souls
352.desc: There is a nagging chill in the air, though it isn't necessarily cold. Could it be this malicious air that surrounds you?

100610.name: Earth Metal Parade
100610.desc: A grand procession featuring Earth Metal monsters with loads of Earth experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

1033.name: Earth Shattering Lightning Storm
1033.desc: The cacophony of thunder threatens to burst your eardrums. Each time the lightning strikes, so do your enemies' swords, raising the hair on the back of your soaked neck.

20000210.name: East Hall: Bronze
20000210.desc: Behind a locked door in the East Hall, an ancient tome patiently awaits its next guest.

20000212.name: East Hall: Gold
20000212.desc: The East Hall's final?and perhaps even fatal?challenge looms before Renatus and Nimrah.

20000211.name: East Hall: Silver
20000211.desc: The false wall in the East Hall's secret room reveals another chamber...

8350404.name: Easter Fanfare Lv.4
8350404.desc: Celebrate the joy of spring time with even more furry creatures than before!

8350401.name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 1
8350401.desc: As the spring solstice approaches, furry creatures come out to play.

8350402.name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 2
8350402.desc: Furry creatures bear gifts and little surprises for travelers from distant lands.

8350403.name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 3
8350403.desc: Gifts and surprises don't come with ease, furry creatures live to tease.

10852.name: Eerie Shadows
10852.desc: The cities filled with otherworldly technology you have seen before were filled with light, but this place becomes darker with each step.

25600007.name: Elbow Grease
25600007.desc: The deeper the lab runs, the more dangerous the abandoned security is...and the more valuable the parts!

8301521.name: Electric Boogaloo
8301521.desc: The crackling specters return with a vengeance.

1330.name: Electric Eyes
1330.desc: The fate of the future... What Paris told you is starting to make sense. However, you must first focus on defeating the last Fallen God.

10730.name: Electrified Gates
10730.desc: There is a gate of appropriate size for the immense valley it blocks off built across the precipice. It seems to be mechanical.

2.name: Element & Skill
2.desc: Memorize the strengths and weaknesses of each elements and how to trigger the Brave Burst!

10070.name: Elementary Steps
10070.desc: The gigantic tower might as well be a skyscraper piercing the sea of clouds. Could its candle-like branches be the stronghold of a demon?

1534.name: Embraced by the Ruins
1534.desc: In the outskirts of the village lies a small shrine. As you go past it, you lay your eyes upon the tower standing ahead. Ark awaits you.

10062.name: Empty Heart
10062.desc: A building in ruins sleeps within the forest. Completely broken down and in shambles, it resembles the bones of a dead gigantic creature.

1320.name: Enchanted Fairy Grove
1320.desc: An ancient forest that few have visited before. There seem to be no natural paths. You'll have to use your sense of direction to get out of this one.

20404.name: Encounter the Unknown
20404.desc: Leaving Mersas, you're finally almost at the Information Tower. It would be nice if you could get there without trouble, but...

104010.name: Encountering Fire Lv. 1
104010.desc: A strange airship shaped like a dragon suddenly appeared over the skies of Grand Gaia. Apparently, an otherworldly warrior of fire rides inside it.

104001.name: Encountering Fire Lv. 2
104001.desc: The otherworldly warrior riding the airship wields a very particular sword. In fact, it is rumored that the blade has a will of its own.

104002.name: Encountering Fire Lv. 3
104002.desc: Aboard the airship, the otherworldly warrior has combined his swordsmanship with the power of fire to create the ultimate attack. Best steer clear.

21050.name: Encroaching Threats
21050.desc: The sealed god of this land appears from nowhere. Beat it and you'll complete your mission here. All you can do now is fight with all you have!

8301394.name: End-of-Life
8301394.desc: Galene, a highly specialized military android, recalls the last few months of her "life" prior to dismantlement…

562.name: Endless Barrage
562.desc: The monsters' aggression grows stronger as if they're trying to buy time for Zebra to recover from the wounds he was dealt during his battle with Tilith.

3000268.name: Endless Corridor
3000268.desc: This trial will test your limits until you use the last of your strength. Adapt to every situation thrown at you and use your most formidable defense!

10404.name: Endless Fire
10404.desc: A wind that could burn your skin comes blasting in. This doesn't seem to be a part of the factory, but of a strong enemy waiting ahead.

1430.name: Endless Foliage
1430.desc: As you walk through the thick forest, you get lost. The path to a free future... You'll have to make your own way to get there.

10711.name: Endless White
10711.desc: You must assemble demonic powers to face Karna Masta. That means that if Mora wasn't lying, you'll need her help.

731.name: Endless Wisdom and Vitality
731.desc: A stomach-turning stench fills the moist humid air. Even when the bad smell breaks, you're left with the choking fragrance of vegetation.

1360.name: Ends & Beginnings
1360.desc: Tilith, Karl, everyone... You're worried about the friends you left behind fighting. However, there's no turning back now. You must press forward.

10564.name: Ends Yet Unseen
10564.desc: Before you knew it, the top floor was but a few steps away. It's dangerous to fight while distracted. Make sure to keep yourself together.

8301586.name: Energetic Earth
8301586.desc: All around you, clumps of earth rise and fall as if responding to the arcane.

5008002.name: Eneroth: Genesis
5008002.desc: The tracks of the mysterious kidnapper have led Avani to Ostagoth, capital city of the Morokai. Just what do they have planned for Ezra?

431.name: Enlightenment of the Ages
431.desc: It seems the demon Graham who escaped from Mistral has shown up around here. Could this strong presence coming from ahead be him? Or maybe...

10462.name: Enshrouding Clouds
10462.desc: Perhaps if Elgaia had the power this tower possesses, there wouldn't be a need for humanity to fight the demons.

20020.name: Entering the Foliage
20020.desc: On the other side of the huge waterfall a vast forest stretches as far as the eye can see. According to Lugina, the monsters here are the most dangerous you’ve faced.

102200.name: Enthralled by the Moon Lv. 3
102200.desc: The shrine sparkles like a star scattered sky. Just like the night sky it is breathtaking yet terrifying, awakening one's primal fear of the dark.

102201.name: Enthralled by the Moon Lv. 4
102201.desc: She was too engrossed in pursuing her ideals which is why she couldn't forgive anything. Regardless the passage of time, this never changed.

150902.name: Entrusted Future
150902.desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 3 - Priscilla and Arus land in another world. The demon who had plotted it all finally reveals his existence to them.

5000013.name: Entrusted Will
5000013.desc: The 7 leaders of the Akras Summoners' Hall Demon Slayers--Griff, Iris, Kafka, Rhoa, Libera, Krantz, and Mirfah--head to the world of Ishgria to survey the land. However, they face an enormous demon soon after arriving. Their leader, Griff, goes after the demon alone. As acting commander, Krantz leads the rest to where the return gate should be, but...

20700.name: Epicenter Survey
20700.desc: As expected, the building was full of machines. It also seems to be full of enemies. Be careful, you don't know what else awaits you.

10221.name: Eroded by the Forest
10221.desc: The ruins turned laboratory are being swallowed by the forest. You can feel great vitality coming from the plants growing along the walls.

23031.name: Eroding Continent
23031.desc: You attempt the challenging climb carefully. You don't sense anyone ahead of you. Did those two from the Abel Faction find another route?

560.name: Escape the Sky Fort
560.desc: Escape the Sky Fort for the sake of the wounded Tilith and those who stand guard over her! Mow down any who stand in your way!

10150.name: Escaping the Enemy
10150.desc: After being apart for such a long time, you reunite with Seria and Lugina. Now you must begin all preparations necessary to face Mora once again.

22042.name: Established Borders
22042.desc: Genba's minions are in position on the bridge, and it won't be easy to get across. You need to hurry and push through it.

1474.name: Establishing Order
1474.desc: Light pierces the walls, and countless arrows begin to rain down. The enemy is strong, but you still have morale. Hurry and make your way through!

3000364.name: Eternal Crusade
3000364.desc: A system created to test your limits and endurance. Do the best you can against the never-ending hordes of foes coming your way!

23012.name: Eternal Darkness
23012.desc: The temperature is still nice, but it's very dark inside the massive ruins. It feels even darker given the light outside, and your eyes won't adapt.

561.name: Evade the Oncoming Hordes
561.desc: Hordes of monsters are blocking your path. Defeat them all as you advance forth! You've nearly made your way to Zebra!

5008008.name: Everlasting Embrace
5008008.desc: Aimyhr is in peril. Ensa-Taya has sent her Voidborn to devour every last being on this world. Forced to ally with the human kingdoms against a common enemy,  Zeruiah bestows Faefire upon their delegate, Baelfyr.

844.name: Evil Conviction
844.desc: The cave is wide open before you. You should be able to get to the tower through here. You'd better prepare yourself for surprise attacks.

25050.name: Evil in Bloom
25050.desc: Mel says she intends to obey Garrett when he speaks of Rahnas's wishes. Did she choose to do so of her own accord?

10550.name: Evil in the Darkness
10550.desc: You sensed something from Mora that wasn't there before; something like confusion. You feel like you understand Seria's concern a little better.

865.name: Exceeding Defiance
865.desc: A sudden surge of blood curdling power seeping down from the floor above stops you in your tracks. Prepare yourself and head up to where your two foes await.

150200.name: Exorcist Blade
150200.desc: Sefia - Foes manifesting from another world are invading Elgaia. She will exert divine justice upon them with her eight sacred blades!

500002.name: Experience Training Lv.3
500002.desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Defeat all foes standing in your way and develop your battle strength!

500000.name: Experience Training Lv. 1
500000.desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Crush every enemy you encounter to increase your innermost potential!

500001.name: Experience Training Lv. 2
500001.desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Defeat incoming enemies to see your innermost potential soar!

1200.name: Exploding Volcano
1200.desc: It seems that Zurg's words are still bothering Tilith. Keep moving forward to bring her spirits back up, never looking back.

8301133.name: Explosive Brawl
8301133.desc: Two more deadly beauties have arrived. Is it heaven, or hell? Only one thing's for sure--your heart might just be Overdrived into an Instant Kill!

8301252.name: Explosive Matchup
8301252.desc: Kaboom! Can you keep up with Katsuki Bakugo and his special moves?

775.name: Extermination Barrier
775.desc: This could be the final floor. However, you feel the presence of the Four Heroes coming from behind the door leading to the roof. You must defeat them to advance.

20601.name: Extreme Development
20601.desc: This wasteland is wildly different from the rest of Bectas. Is this an area they've extracted ores from in order to make machines?

20000908.name: Eye of the Storm
20000908.desc: A powerful darkness ripples out of the distortion in space. Ready your weapons!

24031.name: Eyes in the Mirror
24031.desc: Not a ripple stirs on the surface, and the view of the surrounding scenery reflected in the water is tranquility itself.

252.name: Face of a Saint
252.desc: You've come to a plaza in the middle of the ruins. An enormous church embodies the former power of this devastated city.

83015903.name: Facing Darkness
83015903.desc: Slipping in between shadowed trees, you come upon the foreboding lair of Vohu, yazata of the wilds…

1577.name: Facing the Sealed God
1577.desc: Tilith has led you all the way here. That was Lucius's will. However, now you must fight with your own will in mind!

10841.name: Fading Light
10841.desc: You have never seen such a peaceful expression as on Ark's face. You silently gaze upon the gentle, yet sad countenance.

8313103.name: Fae-rly Terrifying
8313103.desc: As the girls settle down near the Vale, tales of the old beasts come to the fore as they settle down for the night…

1563.name: Faint Tremors
1563.desc: How many moons have passed since this mountain lost its original purpose? The darkness that lingers in these mountain paths is quite dense.

522.name: Fairy Royalty
522.desc: One can feel the history of Castle Avenia in all its elegance. After its original lord perished, a new royal family settled in.

83015912.name: Faith and Fire
83015912.desc: With no small amount of effort, the dying embers of Atar, the Eternal Flame, are found in the throes of a great evil…

662.name: Faith in Comrades
662.desc: The Spirit World grows unstable as the seal nears its breaking point. Uncertain of where Cardes may be, you must believe in your comrades and move forth!

833.name: Fall of the Lightning Fortress
833.desc: It seems these ruins were once used as a fortress. There are armories lined with spears, though each one of them is covered with rust.

10352.name: Falling Shadow
10352.desc: You've heard many legends that tell of beautiful crystals which can grant demonic powers. Could these be the same crystals of lore?

8301572.name: Fates In Our Hands
8301572.desc: Gathering their remaining strength, the Vessels prepare to defy the fate that was ordained by the God-King.

5008009.name: Fates of the Fallen
5008009.desc: Three years after the Crystalline Spire, memories of the Voidborn still linger in the minds of men. Tensions begin to run high as Fae and Naga activity increase. "The stars have aligned," the wise say. "Our fates are coming to a close."

10154.name: Fear Filled Darkness
10154.desc: After climbing down a steep hill, you grow closer to the great bridge. The miasma around you makes everything creepier as it points towards the enemy.

20102.name: Feeling Resistance
20102.desc: This is what it is to fight for yourself, feeling the resistance through your weapons. You can see how much you've depended on Summoning until now.

150500.name: Ferocious  Fire
150500.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 1 - Before Sodis's rebellion, Farlon takes his fellow Guardians on many different missions.

8301583.name: Fickle Fire
8301583.desc: A line of floating fires surround you, darting about as if daring you to catch them.

24040.name: Fickle Wind
24040.desc: What Bertz was after...and Rahnas's past. There's no point dwelling on it. Your first priority is to prevent Rahnas from getting hold of power.

1355.name: Fighting Death
1355.desc: You can see the last hoard of enemies in front of the gate. If you can get past them, you will finally be inside Afla Dilith!

8301203.name: Fighting for the Light
8301203.desc: This is it! The combined effort of every hero is needed to defeat the enemy. With your help (and a little luck), victory will come soon enough!

1504.name: Fighting Goddesses
1504.desc: After the flock of birds has gone, you encounter a group of fighting goddesses. They study you as if trying to gauge your power.

24080.name: Figure of Readiness
24080.desc: The two gods who were cooperative until now have challenged you to a fight. Best to just comply with whatever is necessary for them to move forward.

10052.name: Filled with Light
10052.desc: As you contemplate the Light Tower you begin to wonder about the demon civilization. Do they all have different roles to play as humans do?

409593.name: Final Hour
409593.desc: Almost there. Then we can leave this whole mess behind. ...Well, one of us, at least.

10870.name: Final Seal
10870.desc: The Holy Emperor's physical form has been annihilated. However, two seals remain. As the Summoner searches for the secret, who should appear but...

711.name: Fire Breath, Thunder Fangs
711.desc: Though not hot enough to burn the skin, the air here is hot. In addition, it is also very thin. Do your best to retain consciousness.

10201.name: Fire Dragon's Nest
10201.desc: The air carries the fiery breath of a dragon. There's no doubt that a group of them is nearby. Best move quietly to avoid any confrontations.

1202.name: Fire Drake Cry
1202.desc: The cries of the drake echo through the mountains, but this is no foe to fear now. Make your way through the scorching path ahead as fast as you can.

10011.name: Fire God's Roar
10011.desc: You never thought that the demon who controls this land would show itself so quickly. Keep your eyes peeled for traps ahead.

902.name: Fire Maiden's Table
902.desc: Lugina told your enemies to do their worst, but they are fiercer than you anticipated. Their spirit of kinship and heroism permeates the air.

100608.name: Fire Metal Parade
100608.desc: A grand procession featuring Fire Metal monsters with loads of Fire experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

1553.name: Fire of Knowledge
1553.desc: A tension in the air is putting everything on edge. Is this the wrath of the heroes? Ark's figure is slowly becoming visible.

409586.name: First Hour
409586.desc: Weird. The lights are out...and my cell door is open. Let's move cautiously.

150301.name: Five Color Light
150301.desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 2 - Michele and Crabby set off on a journey to face the Ten Winged Destroyer, making some strange friends along the way.

3000322.name: Flame of Darkness
3000322.desc: A trial program where you fight to the end using only Fire and Dark type Units. Choose wisely and get as far as you can!

107700.name: Flame of Virtue Lv.1
107700.desc: Swallowed by the vortex, the Summoner lands in a wasteland world. A Suddenly, a swarm of outlaws begin surrounding the area...

107701.name: Flame of Virtue Lv.2
107701.desc: One man stands among the swarm exuding an air of wildness, and roaring loudly. "The 300,000 World Dollars on your head...they're mine."

107702.name: Flame of Virtue Lv.3
107702.desc: "Tsch, looks like I've been played" he said, as if he'd been fooled by someone. "Don't worry, I'll pay every hit of yours back with some of my own."

712.name: Flames in the Night
712.desc: No matter where you look there's nothing but dried up trees, ash, and rocks. This place has no hopes of ever seeing water. You must get out of hear quickly.

8311000.name: Flames of Justice Lv. 1
8311000.desc: There is nothing more worth fighting for than justice. She will not hesitate to launch her missiles at anything she deems unrighteous.

8312000.name: Flames of Justice Lv. 2
8312000.desc: When she is angered, only destruction awaits. Stand in her way and be prepared to get blown away.

8313000.name: Flames of Justice Lv. 3
8313000.desc: Sparks fly as her war rockets blow her enemies away. Her passion for justice burns stronger than ever.

3000312.name: Flash of Lightning
3000312.desc: A trial program where you fight to the end using only Thunder and Light type Units. Choose wisely and get as far as you can!

860.name: Fletchings of Anticipation
860.desc: Running alongside a white wall, you chase after the dragon that injured Tilith. Following its trail should lead you to where Karl is.

1510.name: Flickering Heat Haze
1510.desc: The combination of Seria's excessively threatening attitude and all your memories of Tilith leave you in silence. You best follow the Goddess anyway.

10343.name: Flickering Past
10343.desc: What could have happened to Owen and that man? Owen would never fall for the traps lying around these parts, but...

332.name: Float Like a Butterfly
332.desc: Hold off the hordes of giants as you move forward. You can't waste time with Tilith's current condition.

23020.name: Flooded Ruins
23020.desc: You managed to escape from the puppets and arrived at a flooded sector. This section of the ruins looks even more degraded than the others.

750.name: Flourishing Afterglow
750.desc: You've arrived at the ruins of the La Veda Republic. As ravaged as it is, there are still traces in the rubble of the people who used to live here.

101000.name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 1
101000.desc: A pirate as brutal as she is beautiful. Many have tried, and failed, to thaw her impenetrable icy heart...

101001.name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 2
101001.desc: Her ferocity and coldness of character are notorious throughout the seas. Rumor has it that even the Sea King was unable to dent her frosty exterior.

101002.name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 3
101002.desc: Her attacks and insults freeze the hearts of both enemies and allies alike. Captain of a huge fleet of pirate ships, she has no time for any but the strongest of individuals.

101003.name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 4
101003.desc: Frost forms on the ground she treads, fierce gales and icy blizzards tear through her foes. Her frozen wrath challenging the gods.

10122.name: Flower of Starvation
10122.desc: Another bad feeling. That's the third time since you arrived to Lem. Without a doubt, an enemy with great power approaches. Brace yourself.

1451.name: Flowers Bloom Proudly
1451.desc: Beautiful flower beds are arranged next to each other in the garden. These amazing flowers couldn't have bloomed without lots of care, and yet...

1523.name: Flowing Crimson Tide
1523.desc: The red current looks just like blood. If humans were to be destroyed once again, the landscape would probably resemble an image like this one.

10400.name: Flowing Heat
10400.desc: Lava flows systematically around this place, creating black smoke. According to Mora, this place is based on a factory from another world.

104310.name: Flying Broom Lv. 1
104310.desc: A girl has been spotted in the forest. Witnesses claim she wears her long pink hair in a ponytail.

104301.name: Flying Broom Lv. 2
104301.desc: The girl who had been spotted in the forest was seen once again. This time, witnesses claim she was riding a flying broom across the sky.

104302.name: Flying Broom Lv. 3
104302.desc: Deep within the forest, a girl with the knowledge of many types of magic is said to lurk. Rumor has it she even knows forbidden spells.

10663.name: Flying Dragon Dance
10663.desc: A gate capable of moving Karna Masta, seal and all... But you're worried that a power on that level just might break the seal.

10222.name: Foliage Valley
10222.desc: Even though the facility has been eroded by the forest, a part of it still seems to be alive. The science behind it was indeed efficient.

20001202.name: For the People
20001202.desc: Defend the people from monsters and restore order, vigilante style!

10764.name: Forbidden Hopes
10764.desc: Apparently, this castle's original master had un-demonly dreams of eliminating conflict. Mora said she was taking up that quest, but...

340.name: Forbidden Sacred Grounds
340.desc: You come across a clearing bathed in a dazzling light, but as Tilith's curse is growing stronger there is no time to enjoy it.

100663.name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 5
100663.desc: You who seek the luminous tablets, open the door if you have prepared your heart and mind. A trial unlike any you have faced before awaits.

100664.name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 7
100664.desc: These valuable tablets with their unusual powers are not easily obtained. Only those with immense power and rare luck are granted a chance at them.

100665.name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 10
100665.desc: Only those who are prepared to die may proceed. Unfathomable despair and the ultimate power granted only to the chosen one await you.

10040.name: Forbidden Wisdom
10040.desc: Your eyes had just gotten used to the darkness, when a flash of lightning blinds you. The view you see before you includes giant floating crystals.

10523.name: Forest Boundaries
10523.desc: The trees around you began to rustle. A wind is blowing past, deeper into the forest. It seems someone is inviting you in. Be prepared for battle.

10124.name: Forest Bud
10124.desc: The giant trees have cleared out. Now you can probably make it out of the forest quicker. The possibilities of encountering enemies are high though.

83016602.name: Forest Celebration
83016602.desc: The forests here are decked out in a lavish coat of snow, glittering in the last light of day. What a great place to run about!

1220.name: Forest of Illusion
1220.desc: What could be the truth Zurg keeps mentioning? Regardless of how reliable his testimony may be, it still gets the imagination going.

10061.name: Forest of Shells
10061.desc: Though you've encountered various creatures in the previous terrains, this one is awfully quiet. Is as if all life here has died out.

623.name: Forest of the Nymphs
623.desc: Proceeding along a lightly foggy path, you come across the rulers of the forest. The ruler of trees and the master of fairies now stand before you.

440.name: Forest Sanctuary
440.desc: According to a mysterious old man, this sanctuary holds information on the Four Heroes of Old. Take a quick detour and check it out.

10524.name: Forested Battle Lines
10524.desc: When you think about it, you haven't seen Shusui for a while. Could he have given up? If so, you shouldn't need to worry about him, but...

1250.name: Fortress of Ignorance
1250.desc: Tilith seems to be feeling better, which is a relief. No one else is hung up on Zurg's words either. With a unified front, head towards Adan's Tower.

1556.name: Foundation of Dignity
1556.desc: Tilith said she became Lucius's disciple after the great war with the gods. There may be even more things Tilith doesn't know than initially thought.

5000009.name: Four Heroes of Palmyna
5000009.desc: After a fierce battle, Edea and her friends succeed in sealing Cardes away. However, the price paid to accomplish this was far too high, as Princess Edea has fallen into a deep slumber. Having been scattered in different directions by Edea's powers, her friends begin regrouping in order to save her. The three believe there is still hope.

10423.name: Fragrance of Nature
10423.desc: Taking a closer look, you notice there are also plants from Elgaia in this garden. Scientists could potentially make great discoveries in this place.

321.name: Frail Spirit of the Forests
321.desc: A sea of red surrounds you as you walk through this forest. The grass, the flowers, everythings red. What's the meaning of this?

10651.name: Frayed Threads
10651.desc: You're advancing across a gigantic spider's web. The thick threads are stable, but watch your step. Especially since you're up against Lugina.

10464.name: Freedom
10464.desc: You can feel that the demon has a powerful foes awaiting you. A great foe climbs its way to the top, while another descends from above. This is it.

862.name: Freezing Stillness
862.desc: Hurry up the ivory stone steps. Who knows what kind of traps Mare set up ahead. Aim for the top, and proceed calmly, but quickly.

10712.name: Freezing Wrath
10712.desc: A raging wind chills you to the bone, and drowns out the sound of your footsteps. All you can see is white, and you still have a long way to go.

655.name: Frenzied Ballet
655.desc: You're now at the entrance to the Spirit World, but your way is blocked by two dark soldiers. Overflowing with power, their eyes brim with madness.

103200.name: Friend Power Lv. 5
103200.desc: The youngster who planned the escape from Grand Gaia to Elgaia. Once he makes use of his brilliant intellect once again, how will it affect this era?

103201.name: Friend Power Lv. 6
103201.desc: The eyes of the youngster who used his intellect to help his dear friends now stare at you silently. A strong will lies deep within them.

612.name: Frigid Breath
612.desc: A brisk wind blows upon you as you continue investigating the castle grounds.  The cool breeze feels like an invitation to death...

422.name: From Forest's Shadow
422.desc: You've come to a prairie covered in trees and shrubs, but what is that lurking in the shadows, seemingly ready to strike...

99999001.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 1
99999001.desc: Lin: Summoners, can you hear me? I'll be providing backup support! Don't forget to take your sanctioned supplies!

99999002.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 2
99999002.desc: Lin: Those monsters you've encountered... We've identified them as phantom monsters.

99999003.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 3
99999003.desc: Lin: How did these phantom monsters materialize? Why do they take such familiar forms? It's so eerie...

99999004.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 4
99999004.desc: Lin: Keep going, Summoners! Our reconnaissance shows plenty of Sectors ahead!

99999005.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 5
99999005.desc: Lin: Huh? The design of the Spire has changed... Be on the lookout for anything strange!

99999006.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 6
99999006.desc: Lin: Hmm... We still can't draw a conclusion with the data we have so far...

99999007.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 7
99999007.desc: Lin: But according to the Survey Office's estimates, you're reaching the midpoint of the Spire!

99999008.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 8
99999008.desc: Lin: How are you holding up? Keep up the good work, Summoners!

99999009.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 9
99999009.desc: Lin: You're just past the halfway mark! I'm detecting stronger phantoms ahead, so please be careful!

99999010.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 10
99999010.desc: Lin: This is great data! We'll be able to work better with this information. Please continue your exploration!

99999011.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 11
99999011.desc: Lin: H-Hello? Summoners? It seems that our communications are running into sporadic interference...

99999012.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 12
99999012.desc: Lin: If it gets… [bzzt]… dangerous… <static>… safety first!

99999014.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 14
99999014.desc: Lin: Be careful! We are detecting… [static]…!

99999017.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 17
99999017.desc: A terrible screeching sound hurts your ears when you try to tune in.

99999019.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 19
99999019.desc: Lin: Summoners! Thank goodness that we managed to establish communication again!

99999020.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 20
99999020.desc: Lin: Thanks to the data you've collected, we've managed to make some sense of the situation!

99999021.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 21
99999021.desc: Lin: While the origins of the Spire remain a mystery, it seems that the phantoms you've encountered...

99999022.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 22
99999022.desc: Lin: ...are manifestations of past experiences you and other Summoners have gone through.

99999023.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 23
99999023.desc: Lin: They're solid enough to be mistaken for the real thing, but they're just that - Phantoms.

99999024.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 24
99999024.desc: Lin: At this point we're still not sure why or how the Spire is able to do this…

99999025.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 25
99999025.desc: Lin: Regardless, it's imperative that you keep yourself on high alert at all times!

99999026.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 26
99999026.desc: Lin: There's no telling what kind of phantoms the Spire will conjure up next!

99999027.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 27
99999027.desc: Lin: Looks like you're almost at the top of the Spire! Do your best!

99999028.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 28
99999028.desc: Lin: Oh, and Giselle was the one who re-established communications. Something about "psychic dissonance...

99999029.name: Frontier Spire: Sector 29
99999029.desc: Lin: We'll be waiting for your safe return! Good luck, Summoners!

80000001.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 1
80000001.desc: Lin: Summoners, can you hear me? I'll be providing backup support! Don't forget to take your sanctioned supplies!

80000002.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 2
80000002.desc: Lin: Those monsters you've encountered... We've identified them as phantom monsters.

80000003.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 3
80000003.desc: Lin: How did these phantom monsters materialize? Why do they take such familiar forms? It's so eerie...

80000004.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 4
80000004.desc: Lin: Keep going, Summoners! Our reconnaissance shows plenty of Sectors ahead!

80000005.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 5
80000005.desc: Lin: Huh? The design of the Spire has changed... Be on the lookout for anything strange!

80000006.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 6
80000006.desc: Lin: Hmm... We still can't draw a conclusion with the data we have so far...

80000007.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 7
80000007.desc: Lin: But according to the Survey Office's estimates, you're reaching the midpoint of the Spire!

80000008.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 8
80000008.desc: Lin: How are you holding up? Keep up the good work, Summoners!

80000009.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 9
80000009.desc: Lin: You're just past the halfway mark! I'm detecting stronger phantoms ahead, so please be careful!

80000010.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 10
80000010.desc: Lin: This is great data! We'll be able to work better with this information. Please continue your exploration!

80000011.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 11
80000011.desc: Lin: H-Hello? Summoners? It seems that our communications are running into sporadic interference...

80000012.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 12
80000012.desc: Lin: If it gets… [bzzt]… dangerous… <static>… safety first!

80000014.name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 14
80000014.desc: Lin: Be careful! We are detecting… [static]…!

8320112.name: Frost Blitz Lv. 2
8320112.desc: In the snowy outlands, something stirs the emotions of man and beasts alike.

8320113.name: Frost Blitz Lv. 3
8320113.desc: The ice and snow glister with a soft mystic light from the sun. The glades seem a little unusual this year.

8320114.name: Frost Blitz Lv. 4
8320114.desc: The harsh cold air gets stronger, the snow gets thicker. Your curious heart wanders deeper.

413.name: Frozen Blades
413.desc: As you try to escape the ghost ship to investigate, a frigid swordsman appears before you, along with his sword techniques which can turn anything to ice.

8320115.name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 2
8320115.desc: In a distant land, bright lights glimmer and melodious jingling fills the air.

8320116.name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 3
8320116.desc: A sudden snowstorm picks up as you trudge your way towards a nearby castle. Curiously, it seems to be nudging you forward.

8320117.name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 4
8320117.desc: As you approach the arctic castle, a shadowy figure watches over you from the top of one of its towers. What surprises await ahead?

1522.name: Frozen Faith
1522.desc: The red splash is freezing. You have now seen this omen of the strong opponents ahead a number of times. Beware of your surroundings and get ready.

10021.name: Frozen Flower's Dew
10021.desc: This place full of so much dangerous acid makes you wonder if a lot of Ishgria's terrain is similar to this one. It's a bit disconcerting.

611.name: Frozen Halls
611.desc: The castle grounds are silent, and Tilith is nowhere to be found. There's nothing but frozen hallways leading in each direction.

21003.name: Frozen History
21003.desc: The gate is right ahead of you. You can tell now that you're close. You're pretty sure you've seen extremely similar architecture on Grand Gaia...

724.name: Frozen Lake's Trap
724.desc: The shore is in view, you can finally get off the ice. Hurry up and get to the shore where there's no chance of slipping.

21030.name: Frozen Lake Waters
21030.desc: The three of you proceed along the lake's shore. The lake is frozen in patches, and it seems like a person could walk out onto the ice in some places.

10761.name: Frozen Past
10761.desc: This former stronghold of a demon leader is as elegant and impressive as you would expect. Even long years later, that hasn't changed.

10720.name: Frozen Pines
10720.desc: You were finally released from the blizzard's abuse thanks to your arrival in the frozen woods. But the cold is unchanged, and your hands are numb.

83016200.name: Full Moon Duel
83016200.desc: All evidence points back to a mysterious adversary from the past, long thought slain under a bridge...

83016201.name: Full Moon Duel EX
83016201.desc: Shoryu's mastery over ki will put your sword to the test. Are you ready for the Tsujigiri?

8313999.name: Full Moon Gathering Lv. 2
8313999.desc: As the moon reaches its fullest in the night sky, a mysterious gathering has begun. All manner of creatures are drawn to the beauty in the sky.

1463.name: Funeral Candles
1463.desc: If a civil war breaks in Elgaia, many lives will be lost. This must be prevented at all costs.

24011.name: Funeral Fire
24011.desc: The seal of Alza Masta...the role of the Sealed Gods... Too many things have become obvious. It might pay to reassess all the information.

101900.name: Gaia's Voice Lv. 3
101900.desc: The land that was once covered with beautiful blossoming flowers now exists as a dark, cold place, just like the memories of the young Rose Sibyl.

101901.name: Gaia's Voice Lv. 4
101901.desc: The young Rose Sibyl was best known for her sweet childlike smile. But do not underestimate her, for pure innocence and pure ruthlessness are two sides of the same coin.

263.name: Gale of the Ice Tree
263.desc: Past the halfway point, warriors summoned by Maxwell and Abaddon block the path. There's no turning back now.

10232.name: Gale Path
10232.desc: The strong wind may be somewhat depressing, but at least it's neither too hot nor too cold. There's no apparent danger in sight either.

110340.name: Garden of Elgifs
110340.desc: You can only enter the Garden of Elgifs once a day. There you will find the legendary guardians protecting their precious tablets...

100102.name: Garden of Idols
100102.desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some super rare Evolution Material Units!

110330.name: Garden of Imps
110330.desc: You can only enter the Garden of Imps once a day. Little creatures are calling for a host to fuse with...

100100.name: Garden of Nymphs
100100.desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some Evolution Material Units!

100101.name: Garden of Spirits
100101.desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some rare Evolution Material Units!

1472.name: Garden of Truth
1472.desc: A fist cracks the floor open, and a lance tries to pierce you as you counterattack. Strong enemies have gathered here, but you must press on!

10264.name: Gate of Driving Force
10264.desc: By the way, where did Beiorg run off to? If this place is as important as Mora claims, then he should be here to protect it, and yet...

1260.name: Gate of Invitation
1260.desc: The surroundings are overflowing with the presence of the enemy. Head for the top while Karl serves as a distraction. The real battle draws near.

770.name: Gate of Rejection
770.desc: There is a thick steel door at the entrance to the tower. Although it is open, you must defeat the monsters around you before going inside.

20000906.name: Gate Sentry
20000906.desc: Patrol the City's boundaries and dispatch any vile intruders attempting to breach the gate.

1471.name: Gate to a New Era
1471.desc: A cold steel blade strikes at you, and fiery claws rush towards you. No matter who the enemy may be, you must not falter!

5000008.name: Gathering Hope
5000008.desc: During the great war with the gods, Palmyna suffers an invasion from the troops led by Cardes the Malevolent. With the kingdom facing a terrible danger, Princess Edea dons the enchanted armor Lafdranya and sets off on a journey to meet companions Lorand, Loch, and Dean. Together they join the rest of the royal army and head towards the last battle.

107900.name: Gathering of World Heroes
107900.desc: A celebration full of heroes from all over the world that's just begun! As they talk amongst themselves, could they be sending us a message too...?

107901.name: Gathering of World Heroes (EN)
107901.desc: A celebration full of heroes from all over the world that's just begun! As they talk amongst themselves, could they be sending us a message too...?

10765.name: Gathering Powers
10765.desc: Alongside Seria, you challenge Mora. Having absorbed the other demons, Mora is much stronger than ever before. Don't hold back!

100650.name: Jewel Parade!
100650.desc: A big parade of Jewel monsters full of Zel is coming your way! The hunt for riches is on!

2000015.name: Genius's Challenge
2000015.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

104210.name: Genius Mage Lv. 1
104210.desc: In an otherworldly city where magical devices are studied, a girl immerses herself in her research. Some say she's quite strange...

104201.name: Genius Mage Lv. 2
104201.desc: Although the girl is usually cool and collected, she lost control of herself when a particular Summoner asked about the Blastia she studies.

104202.name: Genius Mage Lv. 3
104202.desc: The genius girl from the Blastia research facility is an elite mage who can draw her battle tactics to life, and use them against her opponents.

22000.name: Gentle Winds
22000.desc: The sun is warm, and the winds are gentle. The climate near here seems nice. Even the leaves make a pleasant sound.

22021.name: Ghastly Scars
22021.desc: Broken swords, shattered armor... You should probably stop looking so closely at the things around you. Suzune's looking pale, too.

25520002.name: Ghosts in the Castle
25520002.desc: Some ghost stories are real; and like monsters, some of them are human.

8301441.name: Ghoul
8301441.desc: Do you know what a Chinese Red-headed Centipede can do? You'll find out soon enough.

8301461.name: Ghoul [Daily]
8301461.desc: Do you know what a Chinese Red-headed Centipede can do? You'll find out soon enough.

10320.name: Giant Miasma Flowers
10320.desc: The giant flowers which gave this region its name finally come into sight. The miasma they release is so strong, it can be seen with the naked eye...

22013.name: Glistening Fields
22013.desc: The watery fields around you are apparently called paddies, and they're strangely beautiful when they glisten in the sunlight.

1422.name: Glistening Riverside
1422.desc: Halfway up the river you hear a creaking noise and see that the surface of the river has begun to freeze. It seems the enemy is here.

25550006.name: Glittering Gold
25550006.desc: The dynamic duo are at it again! What greater treasures will they uncover this time?

21042.name: Glittering Snowfall
21042.desc: You can see far across the vast snowfields, but the enemies hide in the snow and ambush you at times. Stay alert for their presence as you advance.

10800.name: God Sealing Gate
10800.desc: It seems Kalon knows who lies ahead. But no matter what foe awaits, you must defeat the Holy Emperor with Tilith.

150012.name: Goddess of Ice
150012.desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 3 - As the gods begin their attack, the people unite as one, and the legend of the Ice Goddess begins.

1432.name: Godspeed Gale
1432.desc: A strong wind blows in the forest. As the leaves brush upon each other they sound like the waves of the ocean. It's a sea of trees indeed.

100500.name: Gold Valley Lv. 1
100500.desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters made of Zel, the currency of this world..

100501.name: Gold Valley Lv. 2
100501.desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters packed full of Zel, the currency of this world.

100502.name: Gold Valley Lv. 3
100502.desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters bursting full of Zel, the currency of this world.

25570012.name: Golden Fields
25570012.desc: Streams of lazy golden clouds float by gently, like a flock of sheep.

25520007.name: Good Hunting
25520007.desc: The misty night makes good cover for a young wolf on the hunt.

8301421.name: Gourmet
8301421.desc: In the depths of an abandoned church, a Gourmet hungers for more than victory...

3000280.name: Graceful Assault
3000280.desc: A trial program exclusive to female Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000281.name: Graceful Assault - End
3000281.desc: A trial program exclusive to female Units. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

8301381.name: Grand Gaia Trivia ft. Rizky
8301381.desc: Test the extent of your knowledge of Grand Gaia, hosted by Rizky! Expect many lore related questions!

8301382.name: Grand Gaia Trivia ft. Shaly
8301382.desc: How well do you know Grand Gaia? Sit down, join the challenge and let Shaly be the judge of that!

8301105.name: Granite Undertow
8301105.desc: Learn to harness the forces of Water and Earth with a sparring match against Kula and Terry! Are you going to be okay?

23002.name: Grassland Trek
23002.desc: Despite the excellent visibility, the footing is poor. It's not a great place to fight, but at least the climate is better than some you've endured.

8301530.name: Grave Hopping
8301530.desc: Every year, spirits return to the living world to partake in offerings, but a anomalous visitor raises some concerns.

1461.name: Graveyard Banquet
1461.desc: Tesla said Paris was useless to them now. If Eriole truly feels that way, then just what could he be after...?

1411.name: Great Desert Path
1411.desc: You confirm the sun's location to avoid losing your way. Short on patience and with your body almost boiling, beads of sweat fall from your forehead.

1520.name: Great Scarlet Stream
1520.desc: A red river flows ahead. It reminds you of a red forest from your previous exploits. Just like during those hard times, Tilith is still by your side.

104110.name: Greedy Witch Lv. 1
104110.desc: A temple said to be the center of a certain religious group. There, a lively female warrior seeks the precious otherworldly objects known as "Lenses."

104101.name: Greedy Witch Lv. 2
104101.desc: The otherworldly warrioress in the depths of the temple is obsessed with money, and rumors say that she takes all visiting Summoners' possessions.

104102.name: Greedy Witch Lv. 3
104102.desc: No Summoner can handle this greedy and otherworldly warrioress. She toys with them using her skills with the sword and powers from another world.

8301531.name: Green with Gorging
8301531.desc: Having "rescued" the strange corpse-girl, Lydia has to deal with the aftermath of her gorging…

10722.name: Grove of Flurries
10722.desc: Snow falls through the gaps between trees. Sometimes, a clump falls from the branches noisily, startling you by sounding like an enemy's approach.

702.name: Grove of Suspicion
702.desc: How many years have passed since someone last walked this path? Surely this was a beautiful road back when it was taken care of.

10420.name: Growing Power
10420.desc: Karl's secrecy has you very upset. But it doesn't seem like he has changed at the core, so that relieves you somewhat.

83016812.name: Growing Tensions
83016812.desc: As Azius attempts to return to hiding, a familiar figure interferes with his plans and brings grim news…

83015910.name: Grudging Alliance
83015910.desc: Their accusations against each other placated for the time being, you turn your attention to tracking the culprit…

10051.name: Guardian of Splendor
10051.desc: You fight your enemies while a pillar shaped light gleams before you. How does this structure work? A terrible demonic aura surrounds this place.

242.name: Guardian of the Light
242.desc: You've nearly reached the middle of the temple. You can imagine the days when many would gather at this impressive alter.

10830.name: Guardian of the Seal
10830.desc: The demon Kalon has watched over the seals of many lands. This must be a trial to gauge your worthiness. Show your strength!

100660.name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 3
100660.desc: Strange creatures called Elgifs have been found in the Vortex. The curious glyphs written on their otherworldly tablets hide great powers within.

100661.name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 5
100661.desc: Elgifs are very rare creatures who seldom show themselves to humans. So if you spot one, it is a good omen of the things to come.

100662.name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 7
100662.desc: Only those blessed with luck can obtain the rarest of the tablets. However, the gods alone seem to know where the mysterious Elgifs dwell.

12.name: Guardians of the Prairie
12.desc: You can see a rocky mountain faintly on the horizon. Tilith is waiting at the "Cave of Flames" just beyond here.

10162.name: Guide to Calamity
10162.desc: Thanks to Paris and Lugina's help, you won't face many traps along the way. But the demons Mora has sent come at you one after another.

103000.name: Guiding Knight Lv. 5
103000.desc: A knight who once led a refugee escape from Grand Gaia to Elgaia. What could he be thinking now that he has shown himself once again?

103001.name: Guiding Knight Lv. 6
103001.desc: The sword that once protected people during the war with the gods is now pointed in your direction. And with it, stern eyes that seem to test you.

904.name: Guiding Light
904.desc: You have reached the opposite gate. Though there are no signs of Mare, you can sense a sinister heat approaching.

10530.name: Guiding Thunder
10530.desc: The sky is filled with black clouds that flash with never-ending lightning. All there is to see around you is an expanse of barren earth.

10330.name: Gushing Power
10330.desc: Who could that creepy man have been? He looked human enough, but...does he live in Ishgria? He can't be trusted.

8301392.name: Hacking for Her
8301392.desc: Vektor takes you along to infiltrate the Corporation's headquarters to rescue the android Galene from destruction.

443.name: Hades Blast
443.desc: A gunshot suddenly echoes through the solemn sanctuary interior. As startled as you are, you see a shining marksman before you.

83014231.name: Hakkesshu
83014231.desc: Assist Iori Yagami to seal away Orochi.

150400.name: Half Human, Half Demon
150400.desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 1 - A girl born of two races never meant to be together looks for a fight alongside the enchanted doll her father left her.

20001004.name: Halfway There - Stage 1
20001004.desc: Who would've thought? A second golem… Here we go again!

20001005.name: Halfway There - Stage 2
20001005.desc: Driven back time and again, but they won't stop coming back! Keep the natives away!

20001006.name: Halfway There - Stage 3
20001006.desc: Just a little longer. Hopefully this golem doesn't go wild like the last one did.

771.name: Hall of Annihilation
771.desc: Entering inside you notice the entire tower is slightly trembling. You must shake off this bad feeling and focus on the enemy in front of you.

83016822.name: Hand of Salvation
83016822.desc: The mystery deepens as The Queen probes at your mind, beckoning and enticing you...

8310304.name: Happiness Shrine Lv4
8310304.desc: A new dawn awaits the those who face the sun and allow the wings of destiny to carry them to greater heights.

8360505.name: Haunting Dreams
8360505.desc: A past adversary, a terrible memory. Will they be able to finally exorcise this vile foe?

23052.name: Head Hung Low
23052.desc: Since they're ahead of you, the Abel Faction has probably already reached this temple. Be careful, attacks could come from any direction.

25051.name: Healthy Curiosity
25051.desc: Garrett laid his trap meticulously. All you can say is that you're impressed, given how badly injured he was when he set it up.

1353.name: Heaps of Corpses
1353.desc: The enemies in your path continue getting stronger. It can only mean that your last target is drawing near. The castle's gates should be just ahead.

23062.name: Heart of Anguish
23062.desc: Mel and Garrett are attempting to hold you back, and combat seems unavoidable. You have to eliminate them both and catch up with Rahnas right away!

24043.name: Heart of Jade
24043.desc: This forest doesn't have an especially strange atmosphere, yet it feels like you've come to a very faraway place...

10842.name: Heart of Radiance
10842.desc: You have at last reached the heart of the brilliantly shining structure. This area is also heavily damaged, leaving you to wonder what it once was.

10634.name: Heart of The Citadel
10634.desc: You arrived at the fortress's dam control room. According to the map found in the room, you should be able to get out from here.

25570005.name: Heart of the Mountain
25570005.desc: The cavern holds all manners of not-so-sleepy, and not-so-nice creatures.

1361.name: Heaven & Earth Divide
1361.desc: Looking inside the castle, nothing really seems out of place. Although without Tilith's protective barrier, you might have fallen prey to Afla Dilith.

842.name: Heavenly Intent
842.desc: The air is invigorating here. It'd be nice to stop here and take a deep breath. The view is so beautiful, maybe you can return here after Karl is rescued.

10231.name: Heavenly Wind
10231.desc: The strong wind doesn't cease blowing. The wood of the gigantic and heavy windmill towering over you makes a loud creaking noise as it turns.

7000000.name: HEAVY DAY Lv.1
7000000.desc: "I wanted to see you fight for real" says the man with the blunt weapon. "I'll give you this sword if you win. Is that motivation enough to fight?"

7000010.name: HEAVY DAY Lv.2
7000010.desc: The enemy is knocked down in body, but not in spirit. The Summoner shudders in trepidation at the "heavy" explosion that wells forth from within.

10804.name: Hellfire Whirlwind
10804.desc: Enemy resistance has subsided. One last group blocks your way. Dispatch them, and you can finally escape the influence of the Eight Sealed Gods' Gate.

21062.name: Hellish Avalanche
21062.desc: You can't tell how deep the cracks in the massive ice blocks go. All you can do is take extreme care in where you step as you advance.

8384130.name: Hellish Possession
8384130.desc: Demonspawn have come out to play! Free Ciara & Semira from their control, if they are even the real deal that is?

1340.name: Herd of Pegasus
1340.desc: It's still a long way to Afla Dilith, but everyone keeps talking about what will come after that. Let's not worry about those things for now.

106700.name: Heretic Researcher Lv. 6
106700.desc: A brilliant Federation researcher obsessed with otherworldly technology. Could it be the master's own mad spirit that inhabits his precious automaton?

106701.name: Heretic Researcher Lv. 7
106701.desc: It's said that his beloved automaton was further augmented to battle against demons. Its crazed spirit still seeks new targets to destroy.

8311006.name: Hero of Agni Lv. 1
8311006.desc: Hero of the Agni Empire, Vargas' strength and blazing sword lit the flame in the people's hearts to believe that they had a chance against the gods.

8312006.name: Hero of Agni Lv. 2
8312006.desc: His immense powers were feared even by the gods. Even long after he left the empire, he was remembered by its people as the legendary swordsman of Agni.

8341006.name: Hero of Atharva Lv. 1
8341006.desc: Eze trained and fought hard as a  warrior and was rewarded with the Thunder Sword Batootha, which gave him the destructive power of thunder.

8342006.name: Hero of Atharva Lv. 2
8342006.desc: Eze tore down the gods with his Thunder Sword Batootha and his superior speed, rescuing Goddess Emilia and the masses during the great war.

8361006.name: Hero of Bariura Lv. 1
8361006.desc: As a cavalry leader's son, Magress was a talented young knight. Triggered by his defeat to his father, he honed his skills and soon became the strongest in Bariura.

8362006.name: Hero of Bariura Lv. 2
8362006.desc: Wielding a gigantic lance, he could effortlessly pierce through the thickest of armor. Even the gods couldn't stand in his way.

8351006.name: Hero of La Veda Lv. 1
8351006.desc: Gifted with extraordinary skills, Atro was known as the "Sword Saint" for his brilliant technique with the legendary Light Sword Urias.

8352006.name: Hero of La Veda Lv. 2
8352006.desc: When the gods destroyed the monastery he grew up in, he drew his sword and unleashed the unearthly powers of Urias, going all out against the gods.

8331006.name: Hero of Vriksha Lv. 1
8331006.desc: Picking up the Sacred Pike Drevas, Lance gave up his roots as a noble of the Principality of Vriksha to pursue greater skill and power.

8332006.name: Hero of Vriksha Lv. 2
8332006.desc: Lance stood up against the gods, but he was not alone. He had his awakened Demon Pike Drevas, which now held the powers of World Tree Altro.

8321006.name: Heroine of Sama Lv. 1
8321006.desc: Beautiful yet strong, Selena was admired by many for leading the Savat people of the Sama Kingdom to countless victorious battles.

8322006.name: Heroine of Sama Lv. 2
8322006.desc: Refusing the call from her kingdom, Selena instead wielded her treasured sword Lexida and cut down god after god to rescue the masses.

150040.name: Hidden Talent
150040.desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 1 - After driving a bandit away with a tree branch, Atro's hidden talent leads him to begin training in La Veda fencing.

23032.name: High, Long, and Loud
23032.desc: You stretch out to grab a stone, then search for footing amid the waterfall's spray. It's slippery, and you watch each other as you climb.

24021.name: High Peak Tusk
24021.desc: Amidst the flashes of light and resounding thunder, in this place you're no longer able to think of anything other than the Dragon's Flame Tomb.

1443.name: Higher than the Sky
1443.desc: You've reached the Mt. Granakia's highest peak, where you can see the whole of Atharva. You see a giant castle in the distance. Is that Eriole's base?

8313101.name: Hitting the Beach
8313101.desc: Sennie and Chryssa, two residents at water's edge, decide to explore inland where no sea-dweller has gone before…

25600002.name: Holding the Fort
25600002.desc: Lleva and Buck meet a familiar face from the past in the middle of a warzone.

10350.name: Hole of Darkness
10350.desc: What could have that man meant to say? He said he resents the Summoners of Old...so could he be a Summoner himself?

105900.name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 1
105900.desc: As you come across a beautiful castle, an intimidating air overcomes you. Before you awaits the warrioress dubbed the "Holy Knight of Glamour."

105901.name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 2
105901.desc: The gallant and dazzling knight seems to grow even brighter with each battle. Her mere presence encourages her men, who also come after you.

105902.name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 3
105902.desc: The knight smiles without a hint of hesitation. Proud of her soldiers, who gave their all in battle, she attacks one last time seeking victory.

103300.name: Holy Revelation Lv. 5
103300.desc: A young magician who guided the people after receiving a divine revelation from the gods. Could the will of the gods have brought her back as well?

103301.name: Holy Revelation Lv. 6
103301.desc: The childhood friends that once fought by her side are no longer present. And yet she looks forward, believing in the dawn of a new era.

25032.name: Honor Above All
25032.desc: If the demon is revived, more places like this town will come to be. And in Elgaia, it will affect so many people!

5000011.name: Hopes & Regrets
5000011.desc: Not long after Maxwell's defeat, Noah and the Summoner decide to accept a new Raid mission. However, since Elise has taken the day off from her duties as the receptionist, she's not there. Owen then suddenly appears to report that a demon has appeared on the mountain where Elise and her friends are having a picnic. She must be saved as soon as possible...

8301430.name: Hornet's Nest
8301430.desc: Feora takes a walk on the wild side, but where nature is concerned, it's best not to kick things at random.

10013.name: Hot Current's Blade
10013.desc: Thanks to the rising hot vapors your throat has dried up, and your head feels like it's boiling. Even Paris can't hide the fact that she's struggling.

20003.name: Hot Gale’s Caress
20003.desc: There’s no respite from the scalding heat. A gust of hot wind blasting through the maze of caverns.

1303.name: Hot Sand's Furnace
1303.desc: As the sparkling sand reflects the sunlight, your feet grow hotter and hotter. At this rate they'll end up well-done while they roast...

900.name: Hotatsu Dance
900.desc: The city is enormous, befitting the once prosperous capital of an empire. Though it's smaller than Randall, make sure you don't get lost.

10570.name: Hour of Agreement
10570.desc: When you step into the glistening crystal cave, it seems there is a demon deep within. Amu Yunos's Shadow likely awaits you.

10565.name: Hour of Disaster
10565.desc: Amu Yunos is a demon you must face to save Tilith. That's all the reason you need to fight. Prepare for battle.

8313102.name: How To Ruin A Day
8313102.desc: The once lively Central Province is now little more than dust and ruin -- but surely there's something to see regardless.

10513.name: Howl of the Icy Sea
10513.desc: Suddenly, you can smell the salty breeze from a familiar sea. You should assume that this kind of change indicates a strong enemy is on its way.

21072.name: Howling Wolf Spirit
21072.desc: You restored the power of Summoning on Bectas by fighting the sealed god. Will that happen again if you fight the mystical wolf?

20045.name: Howls and Gunshots
20045.desc: As the fight continues to escalate, the sound of gunfire mixed in with the roar of monsters hints at even more danger to come. Could Lugina have found something?

20052.name: Howls in the Void
20052.desc: The dark mineshaft continues to beckon weary travelers deeper inside its murky maw. Monsters can smell fear, so whatever you do, beware your sweet scent.

43.name: Hunter from the Forest
43.desc: Dangerous hunters wielding longbows inhabit the depths of this forest, and they attack anyone who dares enter.

1020.name: Hunter in the Green
1020.desc: The verdant ocean of trees lives up to its name. Wherever you look, the sun's rays are blocked by lush greenery. Under your feet, the ground is covered in grass and moss.

20055.name: Hunter of Death
20055.desc: A glimmer of hope crosses your mind as you feel the route slowly ascending, though the air of death continues to loom about in the shadows around you.

8350012.name: Hymn of Dawn
8350012.desc: The melodies of Earth, Thunder and Darkness echo down the great halls of the infinite abyss.

8350011.name: Hymn of Dusk
8350011.desc: The melodies of Fire, Water and Light echo down the great halls of the infinite abyss.

10060.name: Hymn of Respite
10060.desc: After exiting the Light Tower, you come across some sparkling trees. Unlike the mushroom forest, these look like real trees, only made of stone.

10514.name: Ice Battle Dance
10514.desc: You can see a dense forest ahead of you. It seems you will need to pass through it to reach the tower. Proceed down this beach just a little further.

106600.name: Ice Blade's Wisdom Lv. 6
106600.desc: Long ago, the Elgaia Federation formed a secret Ishgria Expeditionary Force with convicts. What sort of officer could lead this unlikely team?

106601.name: Ice Blade's Wisdom Lv. 7
106601.desc: Betrayed by the Federation and abandoned in a demon-ravaged land, the souls of the Ishgria Expeditionary Force wander even now...

10710.name: Ice Fissures
10710.desc: Your allies seem alright. Rescue can wait; focus on fighting Mora. Your fate was to face her. Hopefully this will be the last time for it, though.

1114.name: Ice Walled Fortress
1114.desc: You can see a massive object blocking the exit from the Sea Capital. There's no mistake, it's the legendary freezing weapon.

1402.name: Idle Gossip
1402.desc: How strange. No matter how much you advance, you keep finding yourself back where you started. It's like being in the fairies' grove all over again.

25570017.name: Ill Stars
25570017.desc: Blinded by the Great Spirit, Luro contemplates his next steps.

10741.name: Illuminated Path
10741.desc: You're inside a cave, but its walls of transparent ice let the outside light shine in. It reflects off every surface, eliminating all shadows.

10753.name: Impartial Clarity
10753.desc: You should arrive at the castle where Mora awaits once you make it up this cliff. Looking up or down is terrifying, but you just have to keep going.

1043.name: Impending Radiance
1043.desc: The rocky stretch under took some getting used to. But now that you have your feet planted, it's the perfect fighting ground.

2000010.name: Imperial Ambition
2000010.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

1341.name: Imperial Guard Honor
1341.desc: The herd of Pegasus was just frightened, but something more alarming soars the skies. War goddesses spread their wings to prepare for battle.

25570007.name: Impish Implications
25570007.desc: Not every dream is a sweet one. Help Maeri fend off the dream imps, bent on ruining the dream world!

404.name: In Comes a Fire God
404.desc: A figure watches you from the shadows as you attempt to leave the village. It seems all the intense fighting has attracted the attention of a fire god.

1423.name: In Order to Flow
1423.desc: As you admire the grandeur of this river, you reminisce of battle. Even though you have defeated the Four Fallen Gods, other battles still lie ahead.

10053.name: In Pursuit of Light
10053.desc: A demon named Shusui is said to rule these lands. Is it due to his orders that other demons refuse to show themselves?

25570004.name: In Search of Spring
25570004.desc: Glaes and Maeri travel to the heart of the mountain where the dragon sleeps.

150031.name: In Shining Shadows
150031.desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 2 - Aware of his own weaknesses, he immerses himself in training. That is when he finds his partner for life.

8301490.name: In Sickness and In Death
8301490.desc: Aesys has followed the horde of undead to a besieged city, in hopes of finding the Vessel of her late husband.

8301482.name: In the Face of Darkness
8301482.desc: Rahotep encounters a darkness that promises to answer his existential questions... and he confronts it without a shadow of fear.

25590007.name: In the Giant's Wake
25590007.desc: The heavy presence of the walker in the wood does not go unnoticed.

102000.name: In the Name of Thunder Lv. 3
102000.desc: The sisters once chatted joyfully in the land of thunder. Now, not a trace of their happiness can be found.

102001.name: In the Name of Thunder Lv. 4
102001.desc: Do these bolts of lightning represent the rage of a sibyl of destruction, or are they her tears, shed over the battle with her sisters? The truth will never be known.

620.name: In the Sunlight
620.desc: After parting from Seria and Karl, you head toward the place where Cardes is sealed away, vanquishing enemies who appear from the silent forest.

25570019.name: In Trouble's Wake
25570019.desc: Something troubles the forests other than a harsh blizzard...

203.name: Incarnation of Flames
203.desc: You've reached the desert's mid point. An incarnation of flames blocks the way, further scorching the land around it.

253.name: Incarnation of the Dark
253.desc: Leaving the church, you continue through the ruins. The temple was so beautifully preserved, what could've happened here?

223.name: Incarnation of the Forest
223.desc: It's hard telling which trees are just trees and not just monsters in hiding. If only you could escape this forest...

243.name: Incarnation of the Light
243.desc: You can feel the enemies growing stronger the deeper you go. Unfortunately, the only way to the Tower of Morgan is forward.

233.name: Incarnation of Thunder
233.desc: There's a temple barely visible in the distance. There's no sign of Karl, what has happened to him...

213.name: Incarnation of Water
213.desc: The end of the coastline is now in view. A Water Spirit is said to appear around here. How strong could it be?

10810.name: Incessant Heat
10810.desc: Boiling water gushes from deep within the earth, and falls on you like scalding rain. But you must focus on the enemies at hand.

20202.name: Incoming Iron
20202.desc: You've gotten used to fighting without Summoning. Even so, it might not go well if you run into a powerful enemy as you are now.

10851.name: Incomprehensible Path
10851.desc: Cutting through a maze of alleys, you find yourself indoors, then underground. You wonder how the inhabitants avoided losing their way.

10265.name: Indestructible Arms
10265.desc: As you wander around the silent castle, you hear a strange sound echo through its halls. It seems like Beiorg is on his way to you after all!

20602.name: Indifferent Lands
20602.desc: You can see a building past the wasteland. That's probably your destination. What is the being that protects this world? Does this world have gods?

20000.name: Inferno Gate
20000.desc: Welcome to the newly discovered realm of Cordelica. A huge gate towers above you, as if it were beckoning Summoners inside...

10012.name: Infinite Heat
10012.desc: Bridges have been built over the hot vapors that rise from below. One wrong step, and it's all over. You will need a lot of courage to pass through.

1304.name: Infinite Valor
1304.desc: Your thirst and the sun aren't your only enemies. Afla Dilith has dispatched assassins who are closing in on you. The end of the desert isn't far now.

150011.name: Inherited Purpose
150011.desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 2 - Upon inheriting the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her leadership, Selena ventures to many lands under her new title.

10520.name: Insatiable Forest
10520.desc: It's good you were able to ask Karl's opinion. Even if your objectives are different, Karl wants to help Tilith just as much as you do.

24022.name: Instantaneous Flash
24022.desc: As usual it was impossible to know what Bertz was thinking. It may be your imagination, but there looked to be benevolence in his eyes.

1454.name: Instrumental Trio
1454.desc: The floral aroma, the chirping of the birds, and the beauty of the trimmed hedges... Looking at it now, this is a beautiful, if not perfect, garden.

10622.name: Insurmountable Rise
10622.desc: On cresting a particularly high hill, you realized that the waterfall was actually a structure damming the river. You will need to get through it.

1131.name: Intersecting Light
1131.desc: Passing the castle walls, you venture through a watch tower to find another wall. The roar of lightning around you holds the power of a massive army.

25600001.name: Into the Breach
25600001.desc: Worlds collide as a long-unfunctional portal whirs to life between Paskua and Grand Gaia…

20050.name: Into the Darkness
20050.desc: A mine shaft winds its way in the direction of the Giant's Ruins. Monsters fond of the dank conditions lurk in the shadows, their fangs occasionally glinting in the darkness.

10823.name: Into the Deep Green
10823.desc: Amidst the deep green, you exhale deeply. At your side are Tilith and your companions. Lament will only sap your resolve. It's time to move on.

25570018.name: Into the Night
25570018.desc: Seeking an opportunity, the dark owl watches the beleaguered wolves.

25520005.name: Into the Wild
25520005.desc: This is not the time to rest on one's laurels?not when word of this new, otherworldly threat has begun to spread.

10563.name: Intoxicating Stars
10563.desc: You need to defeat the demons to save Tilith. But if you do that, the seal on Karna Masta will break...

8340061.name: Invasion Apex - Battle 1
8340061.desc: The skies thunder with fury as the augmentation wars carry on through the forsaken lands of Athensphere.

8340062.name: Invasion Apex - Battle 2
8340062.desc: The defense forces push forward upon the high grounds as Gazia and his iron army concentrate at the peak.

8340063.name: Invasion Apex - Battle 3
8340063.desc: The final frontier looms ever closer as the defensive forces of Athensphere clash with the enemy in an electrified fury.

643.name: Invitation to Heaven
643.desc: A brightly shining gun-wielding warrior stands before you. You must fight against this force which threatens to rip away your very soul.

8301312.name: Iron Covered Skies
