8301312.desc: Gajeel and Wendy have decided to challenge you together! Will you be able to withstand this fearsome combination of iron and sky magic?

20302.name: Iron Mountains
20302.desc: Your target has slowed down. You're almost there. You've grown confident in your fighting skills, so now it's time to close the gap.

10244.name: Ivory Castle
10244.desc: You have reached the outer wall of the old city. It may be due to the materials it's made of, but it's still somehow untarnished and pearly white.

8301522.name: Jaunting Forth
8301522.desc: Yin-Yin jumps into the fray, but the corpse-girl has a better use for that nose of hers.

1203.name: Joint Wings Ablaze
1203.desc: As if answering to your fighting spirit, strong warriors await ahead. Enveloped in wings of flames, these two swordsmen are swelling with energy.

10541.name: Judgment of the Light
10541.desc: This castle seems to be quite old, but it doesn't look weathered at all. Actually, it seems in excellent condition. Is someone maintaining it?

10422.name: Jumping Plants
10422.desc: The glass ceiling lets a strange light shine in. This light and the temperature are both regulated, making the perfect environment for these plants.

107500.name: Just Nojima Quest
107500.desc: A Quest designed by Mr. Just Nojima, head of Famitsu App's Brave Frontier. Knowing his usual gimmicks is the key to clearing this dungeon!

1143.name: Justice's Obstruction
1143.desc: The lit path you walk suddenly opens up into a large plaza. You're awaited by a just swordsman and the roar of a dragon.

1144.name: Keeper of Order
1144.desc: You spot a white figure in front of the gate leading from the town. Is it the legendary Keeper of Order? All you can do is fight your way through.

852.name: King of the World Below
852.desc: Thanks to the torch you can see ahead of you, but the ground is still dark. The flickering torch seems to make the darkness appear thicker.

25520006.name: Kinsblood
25520006.desc: Leopold has one final test for his ambitious grandson before he makes his fateful choice.

8301272.name: Kitchen
8301272.desc: This kitchen has once seen a lot of use, but now lays forgotten from neglect. Pots and utensils are strewn everywhere.

8301181.name: Kitsu's Wandering
8301181.desc: After he sacrificed his luck and saved a child, Kitsu has been constantly on the run. He is so tired…

10654.name: Knife-Edged Battle
10654.desc: You see Lugina laughing as though he's invincible. He has the advantage no matter where you approach from. Be careful, and give it your all!

753.name: Knight of the Holy City
753.desc: Continuing your search of the ruins, an overwhelming presence stops you in your tracks. Up ahead, a knight of the La Veda Republic lies in wait.

342.name: Knight of the Light
342.desc: Without provocation, hordes of shining demons swoop down on you. These demons must've been called upon by Maxwell...

212.name: Knight of the Ripples
212.desc: The beautiful view continues, as do the number of enemies you encounter. Prepare yourself for a water assault.

20021.name: Labyrinth of Trees
20021.desc: The overgrown foliage deep inside the forest is maze-like in its complexity. What lies on the other side?

8301173.name: Lady Domina
8301173.desc: Within the dark forest, sweet laughter danced above the cries of despair…

24030.name: Lake of Tranquility
24030.desc: A fantastic light is being reflected off the peaceful surface of the lake. This is a place where you want to take your time and enjoy the scenery.

83016005.name: Lakeside Lullaby
83016005.desc: A splash of water catches Jin's attention. With night falling fast, a still lake could be a dangerous pitfall.

24074.name: Land of Soul Revival
24074.desc: The story of the Summoner who continued to fight alongside a goddess gives people hope. You can't let them down in this battle!

240.name: Land of the Light
240.desc: There is a temple bathed in light. Despite it being thousands of years old, it's as beautiful as the day it was built.

10004.name: Large Mallet Snake
10004.desc: From the top of the ruins you see a fantastic view of the land. However, when you remember you have to travel it on foot, your motivation fades.

20061.name: Last Light of the Ruins
20061.desc: You follow Lugina’s orders and launch yourself into the path of the marauding monsters. You have to give it all you've got on the front lines!

25590006.name: Last Watch
25590006.desc: Aptly named for the humans' last stand, this part of the ruins hosts a nest of rusting steel and lurking predators.

409501.name: Last Winter in Eiros
409501.desc: Evgenia reminisces her childhood in Eiros with her beloved father, Gortius.

10204.name: Lava Pool
10204.desc: This hell-like lava path seems to be almost over. However, menacing presences still lurk about. Could this be the demon's assassins?

10100.name: Lava Rock Furnace
10100.desc: The burning light of the lava inside the caverns tans your skin. The overwhelming black and red colors blind your vision. Don't let your guard down.

10220.name: Leftover Mark
10220.desc: Seria was right. This place really doesn't resemble a laboratory. However, if you look closely you'll see a lot of strange equipment.

83014213.name: Legacy of Kagura Lv. 1
83014213.desc: Help the Kagura family reclaim their dominance.

83014214.name: Legacy of Kagura Lv. 2
83014214.desc: Help the Kagura family reclaim their dominance.

8301751.name: Legato Bluesummers
8301751.desc: Your focus will be tested against this heartless man. Time to buckle up!

8701600.name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 3
8701600.desc: Legend has it that there was once a knight who came into his own kingdom. He would name it after a mythical land from tales of old...

8701601.name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 4
8701601.desc: Arthur devoted his life to protecting NeoAvalon, but lost everything he held dear in the process. Will he continue to walk the path of the righteous?

8701602.name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 5
8701602.desc: Not even kings may escape the cruelty of fate. Lost in the darkness of his own fury, Arthur crosses blades with a traveling soldier named Lancelot.

8701603.name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 6
8701603.desc: Having tested each other's strength, the two warriors join forces to hunt down a mysterious and powerful artifact. Will their alliance last?

8301145.name: Let There Be Light
8301145.desc: Be careful! Lucy and Erza have joined the battle, and it looks like they're siding with the others. When will this misunderstanding end?!

8309980.name: Level 1: Game on
8309980.desc: Our favorite friends are back for a new challenge! Are you down for it?

8309981.name: Level 2: Unusual Adventure
8309981.desc: This time our favorite friends bring their own guards for the challenge!

8309982.name: Level 3: Refined Deception
8309982.desc: What is going on? Nothing works against Grind Burny!

409601.name: Level II Acess
409601.desc: Looks like all the survivors have congregated at the lower levels! Gonna be a trial to clear them out.

409599.name: Level IV Access
409599.desc: The inmates have flown into a panicked rampage. Better get a move on...

1142.name: Light's Oppression
1142.desc: It seems the cave just outside the city could be your way to Alnakeid Castle. Surely, incredibly powerful foes await you there.

10005.name: Light's Winged Blade
10005.desc: You've felt no demonic presences until now. It looks like finding the demons in charge of this land will prove harder than you initially thought.

1161.name: Light & Dark Concerto
1161.desc: Leaving the hall, you come across a pair of foes harvesting the powers of light and dark. Defeat the minions before taking on these two.

664.name: Light and Darkness Intersect
664.desc: The unstable seal reveals a being of dark and light from within it. However, an unexpected opponent has set their sights on you!

10103.name: Light Beyond Truth
10103.desc: You follow a hot trail. The ground, walls, and even the ceiling is scorching hot. Your feet feel like they're burning through the soles of your shoes.

1044.name: Light from Above
1044.desc: At this time of day, you must pay attention to your position in battle. When your enemies stand between you and the sun, their movements are hard to read.

444.name: Light God's Progression
444.desc: There doesn't seem to be any particularly important information in the sanctuary. It's time to end your detour and set your sites back on Amdahl Castle.

1000204.name: Light Lost in Darkness
1000204.desc: An area that can only be entered with special Units prepared by the Survey Office. What could be the powerful beings awaiting in its depths...?

100612.name: Light Metal Parade
100612.desc: A grand procession featuring Light Metal monsters with loads of Light experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

10540.name: Light of Annihilation
10540.desc: You have learned what the Akras Summoners' Hall was truly after. And you think it might tie into saving Tilith. There's no room for hesitation now.

464.name: Light Pulse
464.desc: The end of Amdahl, the first island in the Palmyna Archipelago, is within sight. However, there are still some rather troublesome enemies about...

103400.name: Light the Way Lv. 5
103400.desc: A heavily armored knight who saved many people during the escape to Elgaia. The white armor that once protected many now obstructs your path.

103401.name: Light the Way Lv. 6
103401.desc: A strong soul that aided those who led the escape to Elgaia. One to look towards the future, his past remains a mystery. What path will he show you?

24020.name: Lightning Applause
24020.desc: Lugina appeared to be a little stressed. Perhaps he can see ahead to what will happen if he can't stop Bertz.

1130.name: Lightning Blockade
1130.desc: Just past the bridge is Alnakeid Castle. You must defeat the wicked presence there to proceed to Vriksha, as far off as it may still be.

1233.name: Lightning Feast
1233.desc: As the thunder clouds roar in the sky, rain starts to fall. At the same time, two heroes appear and obstruct your path. You sense a fight is imminent.

433.name: Lightning Quick Attack
433.desc: The center of the mine is full of traps. Blades are also quickly flashing about. Eliminate those who stand in your way and advance!

10332.name: Lightning Run
10332.desc: The bridge is very high up, and falling would send you head-first into the red water below. Your chances of surviving such a fall are slim though...

10732.name: Lightning Speed
10732.desc: There's something weird and mechanical on the path. Could it be a device for transferring power generated at the oil well?

1030.name: Lightning Strikes
1030.desc: Leave Lugina and Seria to their own devices for now. Around this bog are the lingering traces of civilization, as if it was once someone's home.

1040.name: Lightning to the Heart
1040.desc: The sun starts to dye the sky a blood orange hue. Though you can't see the tower Tilith spoke of, it mustn't be far. Keep going.

1332.name: Like a Lighting Flash
1332.desc: You can tell that in Aldahlia the buildings soaked in rainwater have been eroding away. You start to wonder how long this rain will keep falling.

5008011.name: Liminal End
5008011.desc: Come find me, if you need me.

5000005.name: Lin's Long Day
5000005.desc: Shortly after defeating Maxwell, one of the Four Fallen Gods, the Summoner receives a mission from Lin. She wants to use her mechanical tools to survey a territory that seems to be connected to Grand Gaia, and wants the Summoner to act as her bodyguard. Thus, the two leave together on their journey, unexpectedly running into many monsters along the way...

1054.name: Lingering in the Ruins
1054.desc: Something unusual stands before you amidst the rubble. Made of metal, it appears to be a summoned hero. Proceed slowly.

8301182.name: Linlin and Bjorn's Search
8301182.desc: Linlin and Bjorn has been looking for Kitsu for a long time. Will they find him before he succumbs to fatigue?

951.name: Living for Battle
951.desc: The cave connected to the tomb seems to extend even further below the sea. The damp air makes you shiver as it tickles the back of your neck.

624.name: Living with Might
624.desc: Those with great power are often overcome by it. However, legend speaks of one mighty warrior who succeeded in gaining control.

8301291.name: Loft
8301291.desc: The loft on the second floor is littered with glass shards and broken frames. Two rooms and a hallway lead from here.

24042.name: Long, Dark Road
24042.desc: Going along this dark trail for some reason makes you recall the paths you've traveled so far. When you think about it, you've traveled many places.

150901.name: Long Awaited Rematch
150901.desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 2 - Shera and Belfura join Priscilla and Arus to confront the ancient dragon once again.

542.name: Long Blade Warrior
542.desc: You progress through the Alman Mausoleum, keeping your eye on the Sky Fort. Sensing a strong presence, you turn to find a warrior waving a large sword.

8310303.name: Longevity Scuffle Lv. 3
8310303.desc: The short lifespan of man is but a rush of aroma and color. Only those of ripest age can be said to have enjoyed the fruits of life.

104500.name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 1
104500.desc: A young lady was seen in an otherworldly research facility. She has dubbed herself the Lord of Spirits, and seeks to protect both humans and spirits.

104501.name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 2
104501.desc: A young lady was spotted in an otherworldly research facility. Not only is she skilled with the sword, but apparently she can also manipulate spirits.

104502.name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 3
104502.desc: The young lady seen at the otherworldly research facility is said to be a formidable warrior and sorceress. However, she dreads any loss of life.

10365.name: Losing Oneself
10365.desc: Melord, Lucius's former disciple, now lives as a demon corrupted by the miasma and demon crystals. Make sure you're in top shape for this fight.

25031.name: Lost City
25031.desc: You've seen countless ruins throughout Grand Gaia. Though it seems to have been a while since this place was destroyed, it still feels lively.

8301204.name: Lost in Transition
8301204.desc: Oh no! Snow Miku's lost her way! Good thing you're here to help, Summoner! But be careful not to hit her, okay? Aim only for the bad guys!

8322001.name: Lost Innocence
8322001.desc: In the following months after escaping the gods, they survived and adapted to danger, slowly forging a special relationship against all odds that lay before them.

10341.name: Luminous Tower
10341.desc: The fluids of demons lie scattered around everywhere, making you feel sick. Mora claimed it was because of the flowers' miasma, but...

10901.name: Luxurious Ruins
10901.desc: Mildran, the former home of great royalty. The ruins still visible in the thin fog remind you of those long-gone days of luxury.

8301588.name: Lyrical Light
8301588.desc: The lilting hum of light motes draws you toward this open space.

8400000.name: Magic Research Lv. 1
8400000.desc: As you investigate a magical laboratory, you feel a burning gaze on you. Behind you appears a mysterious figure out of thin air.

8400001.name: Magic Research Lv. 2
8400001.desc: The experienced and beautiful lady of the mage's guild is both dominant and seasoned. She attacks you as if teasing you, testing your capabilities.

8400002.name: Magic Research Lv. 3
8400002.desc: The mage laughs of someone who holds many secrets. Knowing there are more yet to be found, she prepares a unique spell for this special occasion.

10140.name: Magic Square of Light
10140.desc: You're surprised by Paris's course of action. You had vaguely noticed a change, but now it's clear that this Paris is more free spirited than before.

10502.name: Magician's Blaze
10502.desc: The air here pulses with the heat. It is so intense that your sweat evaporates in an instant. Stay hydrated, and always be prepared for combat.

323.name: Maiden of the Trees
323.desc: You feel your senses numbing as you're enveloped in a sea of red. It's probably not a good idea to stick around here.

8301271.name: Main Hall
8301271.desc: The Main Hall is dusty from abandonment, and a few doors lead to the rest of this forbidding manor. Your search begins here.

8301276.name: Main Stairway
8301276.desc: At the top of the stairwell stands a shadowy silhouette, though it does not seem to have noticed your presence...yet.

465.name: Malevolent Ceremony
465.desc: You sense a strikingly ominous presence coming from the path ahead. What awaits you isn't a god like before, but some being with a strong resentment toward humans.

71.name: Manipulator of the Dark
71.desc: Light energy is strong against dark, but it's also its weakness. You must plan your strategy here carefully.

31.name: Manipulator of the Water
31.desc: You are making progress, but the end of the snowscape still isn't visible. Don't forget to plan for water enemies.

103100.name: Martial Artist Lv. 5
103100.desc: A martial artist from the Toltya Dojo that protected those headed to Elgaia. Having regained his many secret techniques, now he stands in your way.

103101.name: Martial Artist Lv. 6
103101.desc: The secret techniques of the Toltya Dojo defeated countless gods during the great escape. This master's eyes look towards the future, ready to battle.

20200.name: Mass-Production
20200.desc: A bizarre scene of machines making machines unfolds before you. They make machines in Elgaia, too, but there is no comparison in scale.

8301301.name: Master Bedroom
8301301.desc: Having explored the rest of the manor, only the bedroom remains. Laughter punctuated by choked sobs fills the eerie air.

10465.name: Master of Creation
10465.desc: Unbeknownst to anyone, Mordlim had continued with her sinister plans. If you don't stop her now, the future of humankind could be lost forever!

20024.name: Master of Lomass
20024.desc: A massive tree stretches into the heavens from the center of the forest. There's no chance of passing through the forest's twisting maze without its blessing.

10071.name: Matchless Pair
10071.desc: As thunder rumbles behind you, you enter the mysterious tower. Before you stands a tough enemy whose plans remain unclear. No choice but to continue.

10260.name: Mechanized Fortress
10260.desc: You destroy all the mechanisms you see before you as you move forth. It's possible that Karl is here, but what would he be doing in this place?

8301742.name: Meeting Legato
8301742.desc: A steely-eyed villain is prepared to bring our heroes to the brink of despair. Will you succumb?

1404.name: Meeting the Maidens
1404.desc: The neigh of a Pegasus reaches your ears, a pure sound ill-fitted for this ghost town. A battle with the maidens awaits ahead.

100652.name: Mega Jewel Parade
100652.desc: Are the gods that capricious?! A parade where only Jewel Gods or stronger Units are found is finally here!

100614.name: Mega Metal Parade
100614.desc: By popular demand, a celebration with only Metal Gods or stronger Units is here! It's a parade unlike you've never seen before!

25003.name: Messages Left Behind
25003.desc: You thought you knew everything about Elgaia, but it seems this journey will be as hard as the rest. Get ready to face a formidable foe.

10163.name: Messenger of Despair
10163.desc: You may have beaten a disciple, but its presence is not completely gone. Countless disciple-like demons come after you, but you're only halfway there.

100600.name: Metal Parade!
100600.desc: Take part in this grand parade and capture some of these metal type monsters, bursting full of fusion experience!!

22032.name: Mighty Swarms
22032.desc: You doubt that the enemy will risk harming Suzune, but you're not sure. You have to escape this castle as soon as possible!

8301771.name: Millions Knives
8301771.desc: The final challenge is before you! But you might have met your match! Time to see where you stand!

25570014.name: Mint Green Melodies
25570014.desc: A refreshing take for a cooling afternoon.

8301221.name: Miracle Star Song
8301221.desc: When she heard of the beautiful cherry blossoms in Grand Gaia, Senbonzakura Miku knew she had to see them for herself. Her journey's just begun...!

107501.name: Misasagi Quest
107501.desc: A challenging Quest designed by Mr. Misasagi, a legitimate Brave Frontier player. Could an experienced player make for a good developer as well?!

540.name: Mischief and Malice
540.desc: Karl and Seria, will those two be able to fight their way out of this predicament? There's no time to worry as a monster with a taste for mischief appears before you.

10912.name: Misdeeds Draw Near
10912.desc: As you progress through the capital, Ark's demeanor seems to grow more serious. Perhaps he senses something waiting ahead.

8312010.name: Misty Fields
8312010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields turn humid from emergence of Water Bulbs, wet and soggy.

150010.name: Modest Swordswoman
150010.desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 1 - Continuing to reject taking on the responsibility of head of the Savat people, she ventures out to slay monsters.

10731.name: Moment of Insight
10731.desc: A single path extends toward the mechanical gate. It seems you will have to fight Shusui here after all. Prepare yourself.

82.name: Monsters of the Corridor
82.desc: This tower reaches amazingly high into the sky. Fearsome monsters await with blood-soaked claws.

11.name: Monsters of the Prairie
11.desc: The calm grasslands keep on going.The monsters here are just right for a beginner.Keep moving forward.

8314999.name: Moonlight Dance Lv. 3
8314999.desc: Mesmerized and enthralled by the bright yet silent moon, curious creatures begin dancing to the mystical feeling in the air.

8301264.name: Moonlight Valediction
8301264.desc: With little time left, QiuTong asks for a final game with her. Send her off with a smile that is as bright as the full moon!

63.name: Moonlit Battle
63.desc: A warrior of light lies in wait in the depths of these ruins, testing adventurers before they're allowed to pass.

8312999.name: Moonlit Path Lv. 1
8312999.desc: As night falls, the shine of the moon lights up the darkness, enticing curious creatures to come out to play.

25520001.name: Moor Haunter
25520001.desc: There are plenty of opportunities for a resourceful assassin to track his mark.

83016101.name: Moot Mushrooms, Too!
83016101.desc: Fuu is at it again! Will she find water for Mugen after all, or will she actually strike gold this time?

83016100.name: Moot Mushrooms
83016100.desc: Fuu has gone off by herself in search of water, but can she resist the allure of the "jewels of the mountain"?

8301232.name: More Eggs for All
8301232.desc: Oooh, hi! Are you having fun? That's great, 'coz everyone's going to have a great time--even if they don't know it! So hop on in!

25570002.name: More Untold
25570002.desc: The great stag spirit Glaes is peering at Maeri curiously.

8313010.name: Moss Fields
8313010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Earth Bulbs, lush and green.

1123.name: Mother Forest
1123.desc: Though Lugina warned you not to overthink things, you can't help but get lost in thought. Something just isn't right.

1160.name: Mother Nature's Song
1160.desc: Entering the hall, you're surrounded by enemies. You must defeat them before moving forward, as exhausted as you may be.

8301234.name: Mother of Frogs
8301234.desc: Wait, what is that? It's the Mother of Frogs! And a big one too! Betcha can't get to it first! I'll race you to it!

310.name: Mountain Snowstorm
310.desc: You've emerged from the base of a mountain. Now it's intensely cold, and it seems to be taking its toll on Tilith.

10031.name: Mushroom Bed
10031.desc: The light cannot reach the depths of this dark forest. Instead, you let yourself be guided through these soft lands by luminous mushrooms.

8301551.name: Mysteries of the Gods
8301551.desc: Neferet's journey to the ancient land of the gods to beseech their aid comes to an end as a decrepit shrine looms before her.

102900.name: Mysterious Paradise
102900.desc: Entry to the Mysterious Paradise is only granted once a day. Croaking voices can be heard echoing in the distance.

22080.name: Mysterious Temple
22080.desc: Suzune has asked you to investigate a monster with Kagenui. Sakunoshin also came along for some reason. Will that cause problems?

23061.name: Mysterious Vortex
23061.desc: The atmosphere is solemn, and you can feel tension building with each step you take. It's definitely connected to whatever lies ahead.

24090.name: Myth's End
24090.desc: You didn't expect to come up against Alza Masta again... Could this be the fated outcome of gaining Karna Masta's power...?

8301700.name: Myth Paradise
8301700.desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

151300.name: Mythic Disciples
151300.desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 1 - Mythic Kulyuk treats all living things equally. Many races have gathered around him as disciples...

21073.name: Name the Reaper
21073.desc: The frequency of enemy attacks has changed... You have a bad feeling about this. You could be wrong, but it feels like you're being chased somewhere.

1265.name: Narrow Stairs
1265.desc: After a fierce battle, you climb your way up through some narrow stairs. On your way to the top an enemy shows itself, but there's no going back now!

25570008.name: Nasty Nightmares
25570008.desc: Nastiest among the nasties of the dream world are the nightmares, who now come in force.

8301432.name: Natural Disaster
8301432.desc: Hyshka catches up with Feora before she can wreak more havoc in the woods, but as they say, there's always a bigger one...

1533.name: Nature's Breath
1533.desc: Humans don't fully understand the concept of a god yet. However, looking at Tilith you can't help but to feel there's not much of a difference.

10032.name: Nature's Roots
10032.desc: You run into something hard while walking. Surprisingly it seems to be the root of a great tree, but you don't remember seeing any trees around...

8331000.name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 1
8331000.desc: She doesn't have the slightest clue about her past, but she knows one thing well and clear. She needs to get stronger.

8332000.name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 2
8332000.desc: The mountains are more dangerous than they look, but nothing will stop her from sharpening her senses as well as her claws.

8333000.name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 3
8333000.desc: "Never underestimate a cat," she always warns, and those who cross her only realize it when they feel her claws dig in.

450.name: Never Ending Rain
450.desc: According to Karl and Seria, Graham has already left this place. However, you should still be cautious as you proceed.

20100.name: New First Steps
20100.desc: Now you can't rely on anything else but your own physical power. And although Tilith may be helping, you should stay alert.

1405.name: Night Draws Near
1405.desc: You can feel many more enemies obstructing your way now. If you're lucky enough, defeating the last hoard of them might be your ticket out of here.

8301550.name: Night Falls
8301550.desc: As masks come off and loyalties grow murky, night begins to fall upon the gods and the Vessel of Horus…

25530001.name: Night in the Capital
25530001.desc: Harakhte conducts his nightly survey of the Nameless Capital, but finds something amiss this evening.

10033.name: Night of Spore Rain
10033.desc: The aroma of many types of mushrooms mixes in the air. So do their spores. You hope these spores aren't bad for your body, but Paris knows better.

83014224.name: Night of the Moon
83014224.desc: Ambush Orochi Iori in the woods.

10442.name: Nightless Castle
10442.desc: Could the demon ruling this land be an entirely different being? So far it doesn't seem interested in a fight.

1334.name: No Surrender
1334.desc: The continuous roaring of the thunder has made your ears feel funny. You wouldn't survive an ambush in this state, so you best be cautious.

563.name: No Turning Back
563.desc: Your enemies' aggression continues to grow, but as long as your comrades are behind you there's no choice but to fight your way forth.

10642.name: Noble City
10642.desc: You leave the plaza and find yourself on the main street. Across the bridge ahead is the gate to the outskirts of town. Liomerg is probably there.

10054.name: Noble Light
10054.desc: You're making your way down the tower and will be outside soon. However, the enemies seem to be getting stronger now. Proceed with caution.

1323.name: Noble Monarch
1323.desc: You get the feeling that something is inviting you deep into the sea of trees. You can't help thinking you're being led to a den full of enemies.

922.name: Noble Roar
922.desc: You cannot rely on Lugina against Mare's tricks. Though you want to preserve your energy for your solo fight, the enemies' attacks just get fiercer.

534.name: Noble War Hero
534.desc: In this harshly windblown wasteland exists a lone warrior whose solitary lifestyle aptly befits their surroundings.

24001.name: Noon Shooting Stars
24001.desc: Bertz and the Abel Faction's objective is unclear, but as Karl says, one strategy may be to give priority to crushing their plans.

20000200.name: North Hall: Foyer
20000200.desc: The North Hall is noticeably more opulent than the rest of the tomb.

20000201.name: North Hall: Inner Chamber
20000201.desc: Deeper into the North Hall, the bounty of a lifetime awaits...

10632.name: Obstructing the Path
10632.desc: Formidable foes lie in wait at key points. As you fight an unpleasant thought crosses your mind, and you wonder if Karl sent them there.

10073.name: Obstructing Wall
10073.desc: No matter how you think of it, what Shusui says makes little sense. Why is he testing you? You can't read the demon's mind at all.

25550003.name: Ocean's Roar
25550003.desc: There is definitely something in the caves, and it doesn't seem happy.

8310061.name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 1
8310061.desc: A piece of the ancient lands of Athensphere still drifts in the Vortex, burning in fire and smoke.

8310062.name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 2
8310062.desc: An endless destruction continues in the fiery lands, while a destructive weapon reaps chaos throughout the land.

8310063.name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 3
8310063.desc: Can anyone stop the fiery destruction once and for all, and restore what remains of the Athensphere?

403.name: Of Thunder and Flames
403.desc: When lightning strikes it sometimes ignites the earth where it hits. The force that controls the lightning and flames has set their aim on you.

24060.name: Ominous Constellation
24060.desc: No one could hide their surprise at Owen taking a severe wound. He's been treated now, but you can't help but feel the scope of Rahnas's power.

8301151.name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 1
8301151.desc: Battle monsters and gain treasures for evolving your units! To the brave go the spoils!

8301152.name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 2
8301152.desc: Many have delved deep into these halls and never returned. Can you handle the monsters within? Reap the rewards with every victory!

8301153.name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 3
8301153.desc: Can you succeed where others have failed? Gain vital items for empowering your units and show them who's boss!

23004.name: On the High Plains
23004.desc: There's more rubble at your feet now, and you can see a building somewhere far off. Dangerous enemies are often found lurking in areas like this...

8301361.name: On the Road Again
8301361.desc: Nick and Silvie have arrived in the outskirts of the town. Will they find what they seek here?

821.name: One Day in the Woods
821.desc: It's hot and humid in this dark forest. It's not as hot here as it was in that steamy cavern, but you're already beginning to sweat.

532.name: One Eyed Giant
532.desc: You look below to see a horrifyingly deep ravine. A thunderous roar can be heard from deep beneath. A single massive eye peeks at you.

8301243.name: One More Match
8301243.desc: Two heroes for the price of one! Are you ready for this battle at the Unforseen Simulation Joint? Let's go!

10631.name: Open Road Ahead
10631.desc: Apparently, this massive dam also functions as a fortress. The interior is maze-like, and it won't be easy to get through.

20403.name: Operational Status
20403.desc: There are some mechanical experts and actual machines among those you can Summon, but are any of them connected to this world?

10020.name: Opposite of Beauty
10020.desc: You come across some beautiful ponds and cascades which resemble sets of stairs. According to Paris, this water is like acid. Don't go for a dip.

10840.name: Oracle and Prayer
10840.desc: Ark will attack with everything he has. Remain steadfast as you face him, and convince him to aid your cause.

25570013.name: Orange Overtures
25570013.desc: Cheerful overtures in the distance match the dawning skies.

24070.name: Order's Past
24070.desc: The power left behind after the Holy Emperor battled Ark in Ishgria lies deep within this place. You don't feel any aggression yet, but...

20600.name: Order and Disorder
20600.desc: You probably shouldn't be surprised, but it seems Bertz made it to this world first. Reda doesn't even need to tell you that you have to hurry.

83013714.name: Orebus Paradise
83013714.desc: This gateway to Orebus only opens once a day. A symphony of the frogs can be heard beyond the portal.

10613.name: Origin of Resistance
10613.desc: Even if Karna Masta weren't a threat, you would need to eliminate the demon threat in order to free Tilith.

5200000.name: Otherworldly Visitors
5200000.desc: Under Lucius's orders, Tilith, Karl, and Seria travel to another world to defeat a demon, but they're somehow unable to return. Grahdens believes this is connected to the demon which appeared right after they had crossed over, so he sends the Summoner, Lugina, and Paris after it. However, they unexpectedly run into three otherworldly beings on the way...

25570003.name: Out of the Wood
25570003.desc: Glaes tries to lead Maeri out of the wood.

900000.name: Out the Window Lv. 2
900000.desc:
The strange musician and the girl who listened to him.
It seems their songs are helping the tree to grow.

900001.name: Out the Window Lv. 3
900001.desc:
The tree grows as if it was being fed by the instruments.
Could its branches reach to where the girl came from?

900002.name: Out the Window Lv. 4
900002.desc: A light shines on the stairs within a closed room. What truth awaits the amnesiac girl who is slowly recovering her memory...?

150302.name: Outcome of Battle
150302.desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 3 - Michele's dear friends are defeated by Melchio's unbelievable power. That's when she...

10411.name: Outrageous Torrent
10411.desc: Luminous water flows freely around you. Could the speckles of light in it be bugs? Even the flowers growing around the basin seem to glow.

22051.name: Over the Wall
22051.desc: You dash through the chaotic melee, crushing autumn leaves as you go. Get into the castle while the begging monk keeps Kagenui busy!

10342.name: Overflowing Light
10342.desc: That demon seems to have been Lucius's old disciple, but you've heard nothing of the sort before. Would Ark know about him?

1111.name: Overflowing Power
1111.desc: You can see to the bottom of the beautifully flowing river. Remembering Zurg's words, you search for a path to Vriksha.

8301395.name: Overriding Protocol
8301395.desc: Having rejected her fate, Galene tries to break out of confinement. A certain young techpunk on her mind gives her courage.

10303.name: Overwhelming Fire
10303.desc: The inside of the structure is as hot as a furnace. A minute longer inside, and you'll be cooked alive. Hurry towards the giant flowers.

920.name: Overwhelming Green
920.desc: Mare the demon is a master of deception. Her last words may be a ruse. However, her next attack could be imminent.

10050.name: Overwhelming Light
10050.desc: Lots of preparations are probably being made back home in Elgaia. If possible you want to rescue Tilith before war breaks out, but...

1214.name: Overwhelming Power
1214.desc: The cliff in the distance you were headed towards begins to move. It was actually your enemy, and you have no choice but to defeat it to move forward.

25530006.name: Palace Infiltration
25530006.desc: The worst crimes are carried out in the shadow of the God-King's palace. See to it that evil is justly punished.

22061.name: Palace of Bloodshed
22061.desc: The castle doesn't seem to be that big inside. That makes it easy to explore, but the low ceilings make it hard to swing heavy weapons.

9010001.name: Panache
9010001.desc: The mercenaries have prepared well for invasions. Be ready for the enemy to strike first and counter them with style!

9000002.name: Pandemic - Ground Zero
9000002.desc: Just what is this virus made of? Even inorganic constructs fall prey to it.

9000001.name: Pandemic - Secure
9000001.desc: No one knows what Noel does in his lab. Thus, one feels no surprise when told that an infectous virus threatens to turn into a full outbreak.

8301480.name: Pangs of the Past
8301480.desc: Some of the Vessels are more concerned with why they were chosen for their new powers, instead of how.

8001721.name: Parallel Festivals
8001721.desc: Two worlds collide as a happy celebration brings adventure to some lucky souls! Who are they? Find out!

500062.name: Parameters Training Lv.3
500062.desc: A battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Defeat all foes standing in your way and go beyond your own limits!

500060.name: Parameters Training Lv. 1
500060.desc: A special battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Destroy all foes before you and allow your true talents to shine!

500061.name: Parameters Training Lv. 2
500061.desc: A special battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Crush all foes after you and watch yourself grow in the process!

410.name: Party On Board
410.desc: Monsters snarl in unison as they scheme to make you their main dish at this ghost ship party.

10644.name: Past Death's Door
10644.desc: Liomerg stands before the gate. You don't see Karl, but he's probably watching. You can't embarrass yourself now.

10134.name: Past Giant Bones
10134.desc: The small electrified crystals have gotten much bigger, and the dragon's bones are almost invisible now. The Ruins can't be far from here.

10160.name: Past the Bridge
10160.desc: The demon Mora finally reveals her true identity. She says that if you wish to know Karl's whereabouts, you must defeat her first. Can you trust her?

8301242.name: Path of a Hero
8301242.desc: The fight's just getting started! Can you take Izuku Midoriya head-on, or will you break under his assault?

8320119.name: Path of Broken Promises
8320119.desc: A wandering figure tries to make sense of a chaotic world while a lone sentinel continues to find corpses. Who will find who first?

20400.name: Path of Extinction
20400.desc: Hatch and Tull, you've picked up some unexpected companions on your journey. More importantly, these automatons seem oddly human.

150501.name: Path of Light
150501.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 2 - Sodis's younger brother, Alyut, joins the Guardians. His talents begin to blossom with the support of his comrades.

1264.name: Path of No Return
1264.desc: You go upstairs, open the doors, and find another large room. After just one step, the doors close and a strong enemy is summoned. Just a bit more.

8301171.name: Path to Possession
8301171.desc: Flickering lights dart through the murky fog above the path, struggling to escape from the darkness…

1240.name: Peaceful Garden
1240.desc: No matter how true Zurg's words may be, helping him to destroy humans is not an option. Of course, you wouldn't betray the Goddess anyway.

1051.name: Penetrate the Impenetrable Darkness
1051.desc: At time there are cracks in the darkness that appear to bones. Your ears pick up on what sounds like the woeful cries of long dead soldiers.

22030.name: Pent-up Winds
22030.desc: Sakunoshin is unconscious, but you can't leave him behind. For now, try to focus your attacks on the enemy leader and make an opening!

25600004.name: Perfect Data
25600004.desc: Vikki makes Lleva and Buck a deal they can't possibly refuse.

774.name: Period of Mortality
774.desc: What floor is this? Suddenly looking outside, the once massive bridge now looks relatively small. The top is near, prepare yourself and move forth.

8300812.name: Persegguted
8300812.desc: Although it seemed as if Cotton was after Carrol, it was actually after the eggs she's been collecting. Will she just hand them over?

10250.name: Persistent Attacks
10250.desc: If you climb this set of strange-looking stairs, you will reach the old castle. However, climbing all these stairs is slightly depressing.

10700.name: Persistent Flame
10700.desc: Mora states her goal is to unify the world and end all conflict. But she is a demon, too. For that reason alone she won't avoid friction.

100103.name: Phantom Pots
100103.desc: It is said that those with good taste hold lavish parties to display their favorite pots. It is rumored that these pots are also very rare evolution materials...

20043.name: Phoenix and the Sea Monster
20043.desc: Nothing poses a greater threat to Summoners than monsters of opposite elements cooperating to launch a combination attack. Fire and water, for instance...

304.name: Phoenix of the Volcano
304.desc: Just as you were about to escape the volcano, it seems an undead beast is blocking your path...

10661.name: Piercing Dragon Horn
10661.desc: You head for the summit, defeating one enemy after another. You start to wonder if demons are only capable of understanding others through combat.

1254.name: Piercing Power
1254.desc: A young woman awaits outside the rear gate of the castle. It would seem she's holding a sword in her right hand, and concentrated magic on the other.

22062.name: Pillar of the Nation
22062.desc: You rush up the steps for a higher floor. The creaking of the stairways informs you that the castle is made of wood.

960.name: Pillars of Green
960.desc: You must properly thank Lugina later for securing Karl's safety. Being Mare's prisoner must not have been a cakewalk.

211.name: Pirate of the Shallow Waters
211.desc: A huge ship is anchored on the beach. It's a pirate ship, and it seems there's no easy way past...

52.name: Pirate of the Wetlands
52.desc: Seems there are bandits around here, too. They used to call the skies their own, but what strength that must've taken...

24062.name: Pitch Black Whisper
24062.desc: You've let your mind wander again, and that won't do. Clear your head and fix your attention on the battle happening right in front of you.

220.name: Pitch Dark Forests
220.desc: Your eyes haven't adjusted to the dark since coming in from the coast. Are Karl and the others OK?

25002.name: Plains of Doom
25002.desc: This is a complete wasteland. It looks as though some massive power once shattered the land. The damage doesn't seem that old, though...

742.name: Plan for Eternity
742.desc: The trees here seem able to withstand exposure to lightning. However, in noticing this it seems you have become lost.

8301293.name: Playroom
8301293.desc: Eerie muttering emanates from what appears to be a child's playroom. The shadowy figure seems be pacing around in there…

10641.name: Plaza of Worship
10641.desc: If Karl is still uncertain, you know what you need to do. Eliminate the threats of the demons and Karna Masta, and save Tilith.

1514.name: Plea of the Goddess
1514.desc: You feel a presence. There's no doubt that Tilith is near. You want to avoid a fight with her, but how will it all turn out...?

10311.name: Poison-Filled Lake
10311.desc: The stench makes you frown as you stumble about. If you spend too long here, your insides may just get poisoned.

1230.name: Poisonous Swamp
1230.desc: Though Paris is hostile towards the Summoners' Hall, there's a particular antagonism in the air when she looks at Grahdens. It must mean something.

21022.name: Polar Life
21022.desc: According to Liana, it's not especially cold right now. This is the normal weather all year. Elgaia might seem like a paradise next to this world.

10313.name: Polluted Water
10313.desc: A section of the lake seems to be boiling. However, it's not water springing forth, nor is the water really boiling. It's the effect of pollution.

1542.name: Pompous Thunder King
1542.desc: Thunder clouds roar within the walls of the tower. Did you set off a trap, or could this be the enemy's power? Either way, you must push through.

10461.name: Pouring Rain
10461.desc: Not only can this device control the weather, but it can also cause disasters automatically. Such dangerous technology must be used with caution.

8301442.name: Power
8301442.desc: This scream-soaked journey has come to its end. Hope you're hungry, because it's time to eat.

1562.name: Power and Shadows
1562.desc: The rocks' tough exterior seems to want to keep people away, but it may be testing if you have enough strength to finish the dreaded climb.

10072.name: Power Barrier
10072.desc: Every enemy awaiting you only seems to get stronger by the minute. You're only halfway through the tower, so there's no time to rest yet.

1150.name: Power in the Darkness
1150.desc: Tilith seems to be acting strange. On top of that, even Paris isn't her normal cool self. What's going on?

1204.name: Power of Survival
1204.desc: A gigantic shadow blocks your path at the top of the mountain. It seems there is no way to pass through the volcano without a confrontation.

1152.name: Power of the Abyss
1152.desc: As the enemy's attack reaches a whole new level, you sense a powerful force coming from deep inside the cave. Surely, a strong foe awaits.

22022.name: Prayer and Repose
22022.desc: Sakunoshin said that people who dress and cover their faces like the one you just passed are called begging monks. They dress very suspiciously.

1061.name: Prayer at Dawn
1061.desc: Sunlight pours into the tower, as if cheering you on. But you must have no time for such thoughts and must head upward toward your enemy.

10543.name: Praying to the Light
10543.desc: From this high up in the castle, you are able to see the giant's face directly. Once again, you are amazed at its unimaginable size.

151500.name: Prediction of Strife
151500.desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.1 - Princess Mariela possesses special powers and predicts that otherworldly demons will come for her in an invasion...

402.name: Presence of Flames
402.desc: You can feel the flames growing stronger. This might be a sign that something dangerous is waiting ahead.

1022.name: Pretty Little Flowers
1022.desc: All of a sudden, sunshine bathes you as the old growth gives way to young foliage. The fresh flowers are a pleasure to your senses.

24013.name: Primal Strength
24013.desc: If you lack focus, you'll risk falling into a grave of scorching flames. Forget about the conversation a moment ago and concentrate on the battle.

214.name: Princess of the Icy Blade
214.desc: You've finally reached the coast's end. A dark forest is visible ahead, but surely something is lurking near...

423.name: Princess of the Pond
423.desc: Nearing a pond at the edge of the prairie, some Water Nymphs stand in your way as if they're protecting something. What could it be?

1013.name: Princess of the Snowscape
1013.desc: You sense a sudden drop in temperature around you. Judging from experience, this means danger is not far off.

755.name: Proof of a Hero
755.desc: Paris said there should be a shrine dedicated to the God of Light around here. A great force stands before you as if to protect the souls of those betrayed by the gods.

3000100.name: Proof of Power
3000100.desc: A new training program to test your abilities. Find an opening to strike your opponents and break their impregnable defenses!

8310301.name: Prosperity Fields Lv. 1
8310301.desc: As the seasons change, the winds of fate swoosh over the lands welcoming a brand new year.

102100.name: Protected by the Sky Lv. 3
102100.desc: This sparkling shrine was once the pride of the Six Sisters. Now, without a master, rampant monsters lurk in alongside the souls of the sibyls of destruction.

102101.name: Protected by the Sky Lv. 4
102101.desc: The sibyl who had the kindness and mercy to forgive all sins, yet she couldn't save those closest to her. What might she reveal to a Summoner able to capture her?

1042.name: Protection at All Costs
1042.desc: The sea breeze feels comfortable against your skin, as does the sunlight coming from your left. But do not let your guard down.

1053.name: Protector, Destructor
1053.desc: Judging by the dismal state of the town, the people kept fighting even after the surrounding walls were destroyed. Their determination is to be respected.

20051.name: Protector of Nature
20051.desc: Spots of nature continue to exist even in this most man-made of environments. Unfortunately, nature isn’t always man’s ally...

5000001.name: Proud Soldier's Feast
5000001.desc:
After the crisis in Cordelica, the Summoner and Karl run into Lugina, who has a special request from Summoners' Hall.
He says they are to survey a great forest where the treasure of an empress is hidden.
The Summoner and Lugina take different routes to reach the same forest, but end up running into each other on a third route where they spot Paris...

932.name: Pulverizing Combo
932.desc: The enemies' vicious attacks are taking their toll. However, this is hardly the place to catch your breath, for Karl's life is in your hands.

24053.name: Pulverizing Roar
24053.desc: Rahnas was an even stronger opponent than you imagined. However, Owen's strength seemed to be slightly superior. If you fight now, you might win.

41.name: Puppeteer of the Trees
41.desc: This monster-packed forest just goes on forever. Everything's the same, seems like you're walking in circles...

23041.name: Pure Guts
23041.desc: You advance carefully along the narrowing red cliff route. Reda sometimes takes stone samples from the cliff walls; maybe they're unique to Rokkzalm?

453.name: Pure Magic Barrier
453.desc: You pick up an item while advancing through the destroyed city. It's a powerful magic barrier, the likes of which have never been seen.

25570015.name: Purple Pianissimo
25570015.desc: Dusky twilight accompanied by soft music?a perfect ending.

1452.name: Pursuing Wisdom
1452.desc: You can see a fountain amidst the flower beds. The water sparkles as it flows from a beautifully carved pedestal. What a great spectacle to behold.

8301172.name: Queens of the Night
8301172.desc: With the night as their escort, they strolled through the darkened land. Beware, those who would cross their path…

1512.name: Quelling Supreme Fire
1512.desc: It is only normal to feel hot in a desert, but you've never felt this degree of heat before. It's a premonition of the enemies who want to stop you.

10560.name: Quiet Skies
10560.desc: You never dreamed that a demon would call you chaotic. Maybe you should be more aware of the things you've done so far.

8301262.name: Rabbit Chase!
8301262.desc: As you approach deeper into the moonlit forest, a herd of rabbits coaxes you over towards a brightly lit sanctum. Follow them to uncover their secrets!

631.name: Race Through the City
631.desc: Tilith injured herself investigating how to get to the Spirit World. You must repay her by making your way to Cardes!

1555.name: Radiance of Wisdom
1555.desc: The history left behind is only a small portion of the history that has actually taken place. What new knowledge could be awaiting in the future?

8315010.name: Radiant Fields
8315010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Light Bulbs, bright and luminous.

442.name: Radiant Helix
442.desc: The sunlight shining on the sanctuary is as pleasant as Tilith said it would be, but who is this coming in to bathe in the light the same as she would have...

1343.name: Radiant Strike
1343.desc: How long have you advanced? Now you can really see the castle Afla Dilith has assimilated with. Is that what you will face in the future?

23003.name: Radiant Wings
23003.desc: A gentle breeze stirs the grass at your feet. The birds in the sky seem like they're enjoying it, too. Wait... Are those really birds?

601.name: Raging Heat Wave
601.desc: You've arrived at the increadibly hot Dejour Ruins. Monsters trapped in the red hot winds block your way forth.

23013.name: Raging Shadows
23013.desc: You've been discovered by the magical puppets. Judging by their response, they don't mean to let you get away. It looks like you'll have to fight.

10302.name: Rain of Fire
10302.desc: Speckles of fire keep falling like rain. What could have happened to this place that is now burning? The mystery only deepens.

1311.name: Rainbow Bubble
1311.desc: The sun shines through an ice wall and though no light is lit within the temple, it's bright inside. The light suddenly refracts, creating a rainbow.

2000014.name: Rainbow Goddess
2000014.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

740.name: Raining Flashes
740.desc: Deep black storm clouds fill the sky. Lightning falls in endless waves upon the forest below. There's no way anything could live here.

10101.name: Rakshasa & Disaster
10101.desc: If you don't watch your step, you may end up stepping in the hot lava. Sticking your foot in there does not look like a good idea.

864.name: Rallying Spirits
864.desc: The enemy's attacks have gotten stronger. Perhaps you're nearing the top. With this much resistance, it must mean that Karl is ahead!

20066.name: Rampage of the Giants
20066.desc: The source of the strange sensation is revealed in a legendary giants with powers rivaling those of the gods. Do you run, or stay and fight?

21060.name: Random Encounter
21060.desc: You can't let sudden meetings and attacks confuse you. They attacked after determining you were a Summoner of the Summoners' Hall, which must mean...

8301100.name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 1
8301100.desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

8301200.name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 2
8301200.desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

8301300.name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 3
8301300.desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

8301400.name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 4
8301400.desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

23033.name: Reach Out
23033.desc: Your almost-submerged waterfall climb is finally at an end. It's a major accomplishment, but you feel like there had to have been an easier route.

8301251.name: Ready Hoppity Go
8301251.desc: Jump around with Tsuyu Asui in our opening matchup! Will you succeed in this sticky situation?

10553.name: Realm of Darkness
10553.desc: Even while untouched by decay, the giant's corpse somehow makes you starkly aware of death. Are you over-thinking things?

107800.name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.1
107800.desc: Beyond the Vortex lay a luxurious court. Knights rush forward to kill the Summoner, as the punishment is death for those who dare attempt regicide.

107801.name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.2
107801.desc: The young king appears with a sword covered in lightning. He says "It is the sword that asks what lies within a warrior's breast," and a fight erupts.

107802.name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.3
107802.desc: There are things that can only be told through a duel to the death. One's position, one's feelings. And thus, their swords clashed in "danger time."

10123.name: Rebelling Soldier
10123.desc: Pushing your way through an animal trail, you reach a small thicket. Hearing a rustle coming from the bushes, you ready yourself. It was an animal.

3000300.name: Recalling Bondage
3000300.desc: A trial program made for Ishgria adventurers. Fight foe after foe until you reach the strongest opponent awaiting you!

3000301.name: Recalling Bondage - End
3000301.desc: A trial program made for Ishgria adventurers. Fight foe after foe until you reach the strongest opponent awaiting you!

3000290.name: Recalling Order
3000290.desc: A trial program made for Grand Gaia adventurers. Fight foe after foe until you reach the strongest opponent awaiting you!

3000291.name: Recalling Order - End
3000291.desc: A trial program made for Grand Gaia adventurers. Fight foe after foe until you reach the strongest opponent awaiting you!

1213.name: Recital of  Waves
1213.desc: You reach the sand after the rocky area. A hero with an ambition as great as the sea, and another with a will of ice, ambush you upon arrival.

10211.name: Red Tide
10211.desc: Though the sea has a red tint to it, its smell is not strange at all. This disparity makes you uncomfortable and highly confuses you.

1521.name: Red Waves
1521.desc: What could be awaiting you? You are not completely sure, but watching the crimson waves makes you all the more uneasy.

25570010.name: Red Wisps
25570010.desc: These wispy red clouds seem to be left by some denizen of the sky.

10743.name: Reflected Light
10743.desc: You emerged into a spacious cavern. The refracted light is concentrated here, and some of the ice is melted. It's also a bit warm, thankfully.

10902.name: Rejecting Seal
10902.desc: There are those who came to this place of their own will, to face the past. But the "Rejecting Seal" gives them second thoughts.

1363.name: Rejecting Sublation
1363.desc: As you proceed further in, the sounds of battle coming from the entrance disappear. You can still feel Tilith's barrier protecting you, though.

953.name: Released by Shadows
953.desc: The stench of death that fills the cave twists your imagination in an ominous way. However, you pray that Lugina is able to rescue Karl.

1324.name: Relentless Blade
1324.desc: The space between the trees has widened. The end of the forest may be near. This can only mean that enemies more powerful than before await you.

3000340.name: Relentless Practice
3000340.desc: A training program that tests the number of Sparks before you defeat a specified foe. Test the limits of your Units' Spark ability!

22090.name: Relentless Training
22090.desc: Myoukei gave you a letter. When you had Sakunoshin read it, it said to come to this field. What does this have to do with you?

10340.name: Remaining Light
10340.desc: Karl said he still has his doubts, and those words echo in your head. However, the enemy could care less and attacks you.

8321001.name: Reminiscence
8321001.desc: Xenon & Estia revisit their past of wandering the wilderness together, after escaping from their burning kingdom in search of allies to recruit...

105200.name: Replicants Lv. 1
105200.desc: In a meadow in another world, the Summoner runs into a young woman who is looking for someone. Suddenly, however, a person identical to her attacks.

105201.name: Replicants Lv. 2
105201.desc: The young woman claims to have lost her memory. The only things she seems to remember clearly are her abilities in battle, and her intended purpose.

105202.name: Replicants Lv. 3
105202.desc: The two identical women draw their swords at each other. Their mission: to destroy copies of themselves according to the Culling code of their world.

20300.name: Rescue Operation
20300.desc: You've won the trust of a strange automaton. Your goal keeps moving further away. You've got to fight through swarming enemies to get there.

10920.name: Resolve and Right
10920.desc: Waiting in the floating castle was a black mass of residual energy and the wandering souls of heroes. Ark steps forward alone for this fated battle!

25570020.name: Restless in Pieces
25570020.desc: The boisterous half-beast seems unable to stay still for long - for good reason, he says.

150402.name: Retaliating Spirits
150402.desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 3 - A group that fights against the gods with their own hopes in mind. They had been hidden from them before, but no longer.

10571.name: Retribution Demon
10571.desc: You sense serenity in Mirfah's expression, unlike before. Sometimes, fighting just to see who's strongest feels good.

8301541.name: Return of the Goddess
8301541.desc: A radiant and omniscient light lies beyond the gate. Could it be the Rainbow Goddess? As you move forth, you're enveloped in a familiar warmth....

25600003.name: Return to Paskua
25600003.desc: The crew regroups and comes up with what could only be described as a harebrained scheme.

1560.name: Reverence of Darkness
1560.desc: It seems a fight against Lucius is imminent now. If only you could convince Tilith otherwise...

1453.name: Revering the Heavens
1453.desc: Small birds flutter about, chirping a song. One flees suddenly, and when you follow it with your eyes, you see a great shadow dropping from the sky...

150021.name: Revival of the World Tree
150021.desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 2 - Led by his demon pike, Lance headed for the World Tree. However, something was waiting for him there.

25520003.name: Revolution
25520003.desc: Baelfyr, a young, ambitious man, puts the first phase of his plan to overthrow the city's oppressive lords into motion.

21032.name: Rippling Waters
21032.desc: The problem with this world is the enemies that hide in the snow and leap out at you. If you get thrown into the lake, you might even die of the cold.

83015913.name: Rising Dawn
83015913.desc: The darkness rises forth in a massive black shape, its foul jaws poised to devour dawn now and forever. Bring the light back!

1413.name: Rising Heat Shimmer
1413.desc: As the sunshine gets hotter, heat haze begins to rise from beneath. Beyond the shaky mirage in front of you, you spy the creeping shadow of the enemy.

10312.name: Rising Miasma
10312.desc: The atmosphere is terrible. It must be hard for the demons to live here, but impossible for humans to do the same. It weakens the spirit.

23063.name: Ritual's Key
23063.desc: You lost a lot of time fighting Mel and Garrett and now you have to hurry. Rahnas may have already reached the Sealed God's core.

22041.name: River Crossing
22041.desc: You're fascinated by this culture so unlike that of Elgaia, but you need to hurry to Suzune's rescue. You'll have time for sightseeing later.

150602.name: Road to Elgaia
150602.desc: Leaders of the Escape Vol. 2 - As the people try to flee, Reed and Eru butt heads with each other. The promised land is almost at their reach, but...

22031.name: Roadblock Checkpoint
22031.desc: You got free thanks to the begging monk. If he's helping you, he's probably an ally of Suzune's. Trust him for now and focus on escaping.

1513.name: Roaring Flames
1513.desc: The scorching desert is draining your energy. It doesn't seem like Tilith will appear here, but if you meet her again, you should try talking to her.

10203.name: Roaring Pyre
10203.desc: The sound of the lava flow is unexpectedly pleasant, until you suddenly hear a deafening roar. It might be smart to prepare for battle.

10130.name: Roaring Thunder Lands
10130.desc: Paris can't seem to hide her fascination for the ancient dragon. However, you should hurry forward if you want to make sure everyone's okay.

20056.name: Rondo of Nightmares
20056.desc: A faint light glimmers at the end of what seemed like never-ending darkness. Standing before it, a nightmarish monster rears its head, revealing a bewitching smile.

733.name: Rooted to the Earth
733.desc: Suddenly, the miasma from the bog disappears. The air which was once difficult to breath is now fresh and clean. This is likely cause for concern.

734.name: Roots in Nirvana
734.desc: You've made it a long way down the muddy path. The end of the marsh is near, but a remarkably large tree stands in front of you. Surely it isn't an ordinary tree.

10324.name: Rotting Body
10324.desc: You encounter a revolting creature. If you don't get out of here now, your body will suffer irreparable damage.

10212.name: Rouge Sea
10212.desc: You've seen the sea dyed by the colors of the sunset before, but you're sure this water's hue is something entirely different. You start feeling sick.

600000.name: Round No. 001
600000.desc: Here you will face a monster from Raid Battle. Rumor has it Noel is behind its enhanced power...

600010.name: Round No. 002
600010.desc: A fight against an Elder Summoner who has watched over you since the very beginning. It would seem he wants to test how far you have come.

600020.name: Round No. 003
600020.desc: A battle with a demon that has thrown itself into an endless whirlwind of war. Keep elements in mind as you fight or victory will elude you.

600030.name: Round No. 004
600030.desc: Behold the divine creatures summoned to seal an incredible power. They will be the judges of your true abilities as a Summoner.

8301791.name: Routine Bounty
8301791.desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

23021.name: Rubble and Mud
23021.desc: Once you get through the building with water up to your waist, you find yourself walking on muddy ground. You don't want to spend very long here.

25580001.name: Ruined Again
25580001.desc: Renatus finds himself at the entrance of another ruin...this time with Nimrah in tow.

10434.name: Ruins Full of Power
10434.desc: A thunderous roar makes the metal scraps come crashing down. This beast's underground cry resonates in the air. A powerful enemy must await ahead.

100311.name: Ruins of Dark
100311.desc: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100306.name: Ruins of Dark Lv. 3
100306.desc: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100302.name: Ruins of Earth Lv. 3
100302.desc: The Temple of Earth, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100300.name: Ruins of Fire Lv. 3
100300.desc: The Temple of Fire, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100310.name: Ruins of Light
100310.desc: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100305.name: Ruins of Light Lv. 3
100305.desc: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100304.name: Ruins of Miracles Lv. 4
100304.desc: This temple is devoted to a god who's said to have the power to draw out one's ultimate power. The power to defeat gods awaits you deep within.

100303.name: Ruins of Thunder Lv. 3
100303.desc: The Temple of Thunder, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

100301.name: Ruins of Water Lv. 3
100301.desc: The Temple of Water, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

313.name: Ruler of the Water
313.desc: Around the summit, stones are stacked in a alter-like pattern. Is this proof that the mountain was a place of worship?

10431.name: Rumbling Earthquake
10431.desc: Independence from the gods. This is a story you have heard a few times before. However, you must press forward for Tilith's sake.

104410.name: Running the Clock Lv. 1
104410.desc: A mysterious swordsman has been roaming the Valhalla Plains. Some say he came from another world, and that he uses unique skills never seen before.

104401.name: Running the Clock Lv. 2
104401.desc: A mysterious swordsman has been frequenting the Valhalla Plains. He is said to shock his foes not only with his skills, but also with his decorum.

104402.name: Running the Clock Lv. 3
104402.desc: The enigmatic swordsman wandering the Valhalla Plains is said to be in search of the evil people who attacked his home and killed his parents.

83016604.name: Running Water
83016604.desc: The river here is still flowing with vigor in spite of winter's grasp?like the pulse of the forest itself.

20031.name: Rushing the Enemy
20031.desc: Scores of monsters block your path forward, but there’s no turning back now. Show them who’s boss by attacking them head-on.

1201.name: Sacred Bird of Flame
1201.desc: Though the temperature is rising, the morale of your party never wanes. Combine your powers and aim for the last Fallen God together.

100000.name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 1
100000.desc: The sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up some of the overflowing Karma.

100001.name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 2
100001.desc: Further within the sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up even more of the overflowing Karma.

100002.name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 3
100002.desc: A hidden domain in the sanctuary that watches over all living things. Now's your chance to get more Karma than you could ever imagine!

60.name: Sacred Ruins
60.desc: These ancient ruins have a solemn, holy air. It's much better than where you were before, but it's still ominous.

363.name: Saint and Devil
363.desc: You've entered the castle's banquet hall. The sacred walls reek of wickedness, but you mustn't hesitate. Advance, for Tilith!

20001203.name: Salvation in War
20001203.desc: Protect the wounded and hold off the enemy until help arrives!

100325.name: Sanctum of Dark Lv. 6
100325.desc: A Dark pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

100322.name: Sanctum of Earth Lv. 6
100322.desc: An Earth pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

100320.name: Sanctum of Fire Lv. 6
100320.desc: A Fire pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

100324.name: Sanctum of Light Lv. 6
100324.desc: A Light pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

100323.name: Sanctum of Thunder Lv. 6
100323.desc: A Thunder pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

100321.name: Sanctum of Water Lv. 6
100321.desc: A Water pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

8330061.name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 1
8330061.desc: As Athensphere crumbles, its peaceful sanctums where the first demi-gods were once created plunge into chaos.

8330062.name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 2
8330062.desc: Will the holy relics of the past lying within the holy grounds be destroyed in the fire of destruction, or be salvaged by the brave?

8330063.name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 3
8330063.desc: As the skirmishes in the sanctuary carry on, a determined soul vows to rid the holy grounds of this invasive rampage.

10813.name: Scalding Spray
10813.desc: Rock crumbles underfoot, unleashing a jet of scalding water and nearly sending you sprawling. The slightest misstep could cost your life.

23051.name: Scaling the Peak
23051.desc: Supposedly this world itself is a Sealed God, and apparently this temple is its center. You approach with caution as you seek the Sealed God's heart.

24012.name: Scarlet Battlefield
24012.desc: You make your way along a fire lit path. The power a Summoner needs to subdue the Pious Emperor Alza Masta...naturally you can't hide your shock.

10210.name: Scarlet Seashore
10210.desc: Very impactful scenery suddenly comes into view. A deep red sea spreads before your eyes. Its hue makes you realize anew you're in another world.

150201.name: Scarlet Stage
150201.desc: Kikuri - A young woman from another world. She means to redecorate the new stage of Grand Gaia by dying it crimson as she dances!

8301420.name: Scars
8301420.desc: A mysterious world of ghouls and humans exists, and in this world human flesh is food for ghouls. Yet not all ghouls are enemies of man...

650.name: Scars from the Great War
650.desc: This place once hosted a battle between humans and the gods. Even after many years, it still bears the scars of those days.

1153.name: Scattered Death
1153.desc: Exhausted by all the fighting, you stop for a quick break. However, upon moving forward a chill runs down your spine. Something wicked lies ahead...

10433.name: Scattered Past
10433.desc: Could these metal scraps have been part of a failed experiment to revive otherworldly techniques? In that case, this place could be a treasure trove.

10322.name: Scattered Pollen
10322.desc: You begin to feel dizzy. The miasma is starting to take its toll. Cover your mouth with some cloth, and try not to breathe it all in.

10740.name: Scattering Light
10740.desc: You are finally free of the cold. Truthfully, it's cold here too, but still so much warmer than you have been for a while. You feel alive again.

8301106.name: Scintillating Darkness
8301106.desc: Learn to harness the energy of Light and Dark with a sparring match against Athena and Iori! Care to wager on your odds?

83014211.name: Scion of the Flame Lv. 1
83014211.desc: Assist the Kusanagi family to gain dominance.

83014212.name: Scion of the Flame Lv. 2
83014212.desc: Assist the Kusanagi family to gain dominance.

10833.name: Scorched Heart
10833.desc: The broken ground makes for treacherous footing, but just brushing the surroundings with your hand could blast you with electricity. Be cautious.

1000.name: Scorching Roars
1000.desc: A world of inferno awaits you as you proceed further into the dark cave. The molten lava glows brightly, but behind it lies a sinister darkness.

300.name: Scorching Trails
300.desc: You're now in Maxwell's stronghold, St. Lamia. Many tall mountains are visible in the distance. The land looks rugged.

10363.name: Scorn & Envy
10363.desc: As you go deeper into the castle, a familiar stench hits your nostrils. Melord seems to be near, so hurry towards him.

105800.name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 1
105800.desc: As you become lost in a strange forest, eerie silence surrounds you. The moment you hear a noise in the bushes, a girl jumps straight at you.

105801.name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 2
105801.desc: The girl resembles a wildcat and her movements are incredibly fast. The minute she sees an opening, she may just trick you by sneaking in from behind.

105802.name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 3
105802.desc: She is half-human, half Sea Breeze Tribe. The reason why her pranks don't stop even in the heat of battle, is because she's found beloved friends.

25550002.name: Sea Cave Spelunking
25550002.desc: Meanwhile, Tilith, Chryssa, and Faelan set off on some spelunking fun along the sea caves…

10110.name: Sea of Steel
10110.desc: The goddess Mora suddenly appears before you. When she mentions she once served Lord Lucius, you can't help but to remember Tilith.

3000332.name: Sea of Trees
3000332.desc: A trial program where you fight to the end using only Water and Earth type Units. Test your limits under these demanding restrictions!

550.name: Sea of Wicked Thoughts
550.desc: You feel the ominous presence of countless lost souls wandering about the area. What could this evil force be amidst the sorrowful howls?

106900.name: Sealed God's Apostle Lv. 6
106900.desc: This Elgaian priestess was a devout believer of the Sealed God Lucius. In her mind, justice was found only in the teachings of her infallible god.

106901.name: Sealed God's Apostle Lv. 7
106901.desc: Betrayed, only one purpose remained to her: "Destroy the enemies of our god." Even in death, could her spirit ever find peace?

10370.name: Sealed God's Disciple
10370.desc: You find Melord in a graveyard of rotting ships. Now the disciple of the Sealed God comes after you to do the bidding of his master!

10900.name: Sealed Soul
10900.desc: The Summoners arrive in Mildran, where Karna Masta's soul is imprisoned. Who could be waiting for them in these lands?

21054.name: Searching for Exits
21054.desc: The air has shifted. There must be an exit nearby. The sisters say that it's still quite a ways to the polar regions even after you leave this cave.

83016001.name: Searching with Strangers
83016001.desc: Calm and collected, the bespectacled samurai Jin has his own way of searching for a certain girl in a pink kimono.

10452.name: Secret in the Dark
10452.desc: You can't help but wonder how people would be able to live underground in this place if it were truly a possibility.

831.name: Secret of the Blade
831.desc: The ruins are quite old, but magic still illuminates the area. What's strange, however, is that it isn't fire, but the power of thunder magic which is being used.

107502.name: Secret Quest
107502.desc: A mystical hidden Quest to celebrate our 3rd Anniversary. It is rumored that only the bravest of Summoners are able to clear it...

21053.name: Secret Signposts
21053.desc: Enemies attack frequently, but at least it warms you up a bit. It might be nice to fight for yourself under these circumstances.

10353.name: Secretive Demon
10353.desc: The enemies here are stronger than those outside. Could it be the work of the crystals? Be careful not to get possessed by them.

20502.name: Seek the Truth
20502.desc: There's probably a device you can get information from on the top floor, but before that a powerful enemy you must fight awaits.

106500.name: Seeker of Flame Lv. 6
106500.desc: An Elgaian martial artist who served during the foundation of Akras Summoners' Hall. Even in death, his soul seeks worthy opponents to battle.

106501.name: Seeker of Flame Lv. 7
106501.desc: The martial artist only ever truly felt alive during a battle. He still longs to feel the thrill of a duel with another demon.

1541.name: Seeking the Oracle
1541.desc: The enemy is strong. However, you won't just stop fighting. Your ability to stop the Four Fallen Gods was no hoax, but Ark is well aware of that.

83015914.name: Sentinel of Flame
83015914.desc: While Armaiti busies herself with the eternal flame, you spend some quality time with Vohu patrolling the roads.

910.name: Serenade in the Waves
910.desc: The beach is peppered with Lugina's footprints. He warned you not to follow him, but you have no choice. You proceed along the shoreline.

9104200.name: Setting up the Plan Lv. 1
9104200.desc: Using his machines and dark rites, Merlin is attempting to bring back something, or someone, to his world... He had better not be disturbed!

9104201.name: Setting up the Plan Lv. 2
9104201.desc: Using his machines and dark rites, Merlin is attempting to bring back something, or someone, to his world... He had better not be disturbed!

8316010.name: Shadow Fields
8316010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affects the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields emanate a purple glow from the emergence of Dark Bulbs, morbid and desolate.

10253.name: Shadow of Coercion
10253.desc: Due to the nature of this place, you can't avoid any fights. On top of that, enemies keep attacking you from high places, so you're in a tough spot.

20002101.name: Shadow of Memories
20002101.desc: Shortly after the destruction of Athensphere, a lost memory comes to the fore.

25580004.name: Shadow of the Self
25580004.desc: Nabris awaits in the ritual room.

8301553.name: Shadowed Sun
