8301553.desc: Ptah is unwilling to save humans from their hubris, but Thoth argues in their favor. Just then, a familiar face appears…

21023.name: Shadowed Woods
21023.desc: The snow on the trees sometimes falls to the ground noisily. How did the people of this world survive in such a cold land?

264.name: Shadowless Creatures
264.desc: The Stairway to the Heavens has narrowed. You can no longer hear the shouts from the base. You're almost there.

40.name: Shadowy Forests
40.desc: Beyond the snow lie the forests that the sun doesn't reach. Beware, there are signs of monsters are all around.

83016008.name: Shadowy Suspicions
83016008.desc: An unnatural gloom falling over the forest rouses your suspicions - the stench of evil clings heavily in the air.

1313.name: Shelf of Ice Crystals
1313.desc: Could this temple also be the work of the gods? Or is it the masterpiece of a person with otherworldly powers? It piques your curiosity.

25580007.name: Shelf Wear
25580007.desc: There has to be something of interest or use among the shelves...

10623.name: Sheltered Crossroads
10623.desc: Suddenly, you remember Mora's words. You can't imagine her becoming an ally, but if possible, you'd rather not have her as an enemy.

10224.name: Shield & Lance
10224.desc: You're almost out of the laboratory, but Lugina and Paris are still nowhere to be seen. Seria's also taken her own path, so just keep moving forward.

21033.name: Shining Ice
21033.desc: You're almost to the site of one of the shrines. However, you're well aware from experience that "almost there" is a dangerous place to be.

10364.name: Shining Lamp
10364.desc: The slime on the walls is still fresh. You hear something that sounds like Owen on a rampage. You have to keep moving forward.

10412.name: Shining Ripples
10412.desc: Is this glowing water safe to drink? You spot a Squirty playing in it and can't help but wonder if this is the source of its larger evolutions.

21043.name: Shining Snowscapes
21043.desc: You're close to the border between the snowfields and the ice lake. Powerful enemies often lie in wait in places like this. Keep your wits about you.

103600.name: Shining Stage Lv. 1
103600.desc: A curious stage has been found deep within ancient ruins. And with it, a young songstress singing atop it. What could her message to the Summoners be?

103601.name: Shining Stage Lv. 2
103601.desc: A diva found on the odd stage in the ruins. Her angelic voice continues to charm all Summoners. However, a certain one among them would change her...

103602.name: Shining Stage Lv. 3
103602.desc: A diva found on the odd stage in the ruins. With a voice that once charmed the gods themselves, its sound makes humans forget the passage of time.

10542.name: Shining White Light
10542.desc: Despite its formidable exterior, inside the castle is refined and sophisticated. It's said that Amu Yunos has always ruled this land, but...

10014.name: Shining Wings of Fire
10014.desc: You can finally see the exit, but an incredibly hot wind blows from its direction. Apparently its heat source differs from that of the lava below.

1132.name: Shocking Courage
1132.desc: Doubt grows within you. The Four Fallen Gods should have been fighting together. What difference is there in the disputes between gods and humans?

25550001.name: Shoreside Shell Hunt
25550001.desc: Sennie and Nyami invite you along for a promising day of seashell hunting.

1024.name: Showdown under the Flowers
1024.desc: Further into the ocean of trees you see some covered in exquisite flowers. Their petals rain down as the armored princess and gunner from another world approach.

22072.name: Showers of Blades
22072.desc: You've made it far enough to see Raka, but you face more foes than ever. Seria's eyes tell you that she'll handle it, so you keep heading up.

10401.name: Sickening Heat
10401.desc: Owen advances even farther. The cowardly enemies that have avoided his path now come after you in return.

900010.name: Sight of Sound Lv. 2
900010.desc: The moon shines beautifully in the night as you feel a strange sort of magic about you. Two beings wrapped in cherry blossoms await you atop a bridge.

900011.name: Sight of Sound Lv. 3
900011.desc: The two seemingly possessed beings continue to battle under the blooming evening blossoms. Could their iron will be hiding something more within?

900012.name: Sight of Sound Lv. 4
900012.desc: As the battle rages on, the two beings' ornate garments turn as red as the evening blossoms. A hint of innocence can be seen behind their gloomy eyes.

10042.name: Signs of Collapse
10042.desc: Storms of lightning rage above you, hitting the crystals from time to time. The electricity helps carve stairs and roads on the crystals' surface.

10821.name: Silent Ruins
10821.desc: All around you lie mercilessly crushed ruins, now covered with young forest. The foreboding silence tempts the mind to wander.

10723.name: Silent White Woods
10723.desc: The white snow and dark trees deceive your eyes. Deep snowdrifts entangle your legs. Protracted fighting here is harder than you imagined.

21041.name: Silver Waltz
21041.desc: These snowfields seem to be filled with lurking enemies, but with Hatch scouting ahead you should still be able to avoid most fights.

25590003.name: Site of Slaughter
25590003.desc: Miell and Phaedra come face to face with Man's folly...and regret.

10921.name: Six Heroes' Will
10921.desc: Ark has reconfirmed his strength after defeating the Six Heroes. Along with the Summoner, he moves forward towards his goal anew.

3000240.name: Six Stars' Assault
3000240.desc: A trial program exclusive to Units of 6-star rarity or below. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

3000241.name: Six Stars' Assault - End
3000241.desc: A trial program exclusive to Units of 6-star rarity or below. Use the Units at your disposal to face off against powerful opponents!

21040.name: Sky Phantoms
21040.desc: There's a fantastical scene unfolding in the sky. You want to observe closely, but there's no time if you intend to catch up to Luciana.

25530005.name: Sky Vigilante
25530005.desc: The Nameless Capital teems with unsavory characters, but as a falcon catches mice, so too will they face judgement.

150506.name: Sliver of Pride
150506.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods (Extra) - Years pass since the Guardians' last battle. The only two survivors foresee the war between mankind and the gods.

25030.name: Slowly-Sinking Light
25030.desc: According to Bertz, Mel is an artificially-created human. Yet you can't help but treat her as a person, and Tilith seems to approve.

10170.name: Smiling Trickster
10170.desc: The demon Mora suddenly appears before you again. What is a demon's shadow? And just what could be going on in Ishgria?

10102.name: Smoke of Treason
10102.desc: You get an uneasy, yet familiar feeling, and remember the fear of facing a disciple. There's no doubt that a strong enemy awaits ahead.

10704.name: Smokey Battle
10704.desc: Clouds of black, poisonous smoke stand in your way. You want to hurry ahead to the snowy plains after Mora, but the enemies in your way come first.

1301.name: Smoldering Sun
1301.desc: The footprints of Lugina and the others who had gone ahead have vanished. Strong gusts of wind hit the sand dunes, continuously changing their shape.

8301391.name: Sneaking Suspicions
8301391.desc: You arrive in New Cravich, a high-tech city that has recently announced a public "restructuring" of its sentient androids.

21001.name: Snow-Swept Dawn
21001.desc: You can see the castle more clearly as you approach, and it really does seem similar to some ruins you've seen before.

21031.name: Snowbound Advance
21031.desc: There was no snow in Tull's world, so advancing through it is a real struggle. You have to walk ahead and pack down the snow.

1011.name: Snowbound Waypoints
1011.desc: You take a peek in all directions and are met with stark whiteness. Try not to lose your sense of direction. Follow the sparse trees and the sun's movements.

8301351.name: Snowy Sojourn
8301351.desc: After hearing from the town guard, Linlin, Bjorn, and an unenthused Kitsu begin their search for the missing children. Will they pick up the trail?

10714.name: Snowy Welcome
10714.desc: All you can do is focus on advancing as you push through deep snowdrifts. Suddenly a fierce wind springs up, and the blizzard intensifies.

20001007.name: So Near yet so Far
20001007.desc: Of course it goes mad. This one looks tougher than the last. Be on your guard!

940.name: Soaring through the Sky
940.desc: Perhaps Mare is afraid of the power some humans wield. That would explain her incessant attempts to wear you down.

644.name: Solemn Grounds
644.desc: The atmosphere is ominously heavy in this solemn seminary. Maintain focus and keep moving forward.

10414.name: Solemn River of Light
10414.desc: The smell of the coast wafts in, though there is no ocean in sight. It's safer to assume that a powerful enemy is behind it instead.

10333.name: Someone Draws Near
10333.desc: Treading carefully, you cross the bridge with extreme caution. Touching it could lead to an electric shock, so you don't want to fight here, but...

1370.name: Song from the Seabed
1370.desc: After visiting the temple a second time, you think you hear the voice of a young girl singing. Her song made the rough waves vanish like the sea foam.

100050.name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 1
100050.desc: It is said this is where souls come to be forged. Here is your chance to gain experience as a Summoner as well as some Karma.

100051.name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 2
100051.desc: You are deep within the area where it's said souls come to be forged. Now's your chance to obtain lots of experience as a Summoner as well as Karma.

100052.name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 3
100052.desc: You're at the far end of the area where it's said souls come to be forged. Now's your chance to obtain heaps of experience as a Summoner and Karma.

100053.name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 4
100053.desc: A secret area where visitors are said to train their souls to the limit. You may just obtain more experience and Karma than you could ever imagine.

20402.name: Soulless City
20402.desc: According to Hatch and Tull, humans vanished from this world long ago. Yet the city seems to be perfectly preserved...

930.name: Sound of Destruction
930.desc: Dark clouds drape the sky above, punctuated by incessant lightning that racks your nerves. You must sneak past carefully, ready for Mare's next attack.

20000220.name: South Hall: Cellar
20000220.desc: In the South Hall, Renatus stumbles upon an underground cellar hiding its own little secret.

10843.name: Sparkling Castle
10843.desc: This must have once been a very important location. Some massive power lingers here, throwing off dazzling flashes of light.

10133.name: Sparkling Lightning
10133.desc: You climb over the great ancient dragon's claws. You don't want to fight an opponent this gigantic, but you may have to in the future...

10144.name: Sparkling Rainbow Sky
10144.desc: Things are happening so suddenly, there is no time to react. What could Mora be thinking? There's no time to ponder about that either.

24063.name: Speak the Future
24063.desc: You've only just now noticed the beauty of this cave. With so much on your mind you're beginning to get tunnel vision. Stay alert.

10650.name: Spider's Web
10650.desc: This isn't your first fight with Lugina. But he says he'll show you a new power he had kept hidden, so this won't go like the last time.

10766.name: Spiritual Heir
10766.desc: Postpone your happiness for reuniting with Tilith and defeat Mora! Now is your chance, while her power is out of control!

25600006.name: Spit and Shine
25600006.desc: Bonnie is in search of parts to upgrade her trust cannon, but who knows what stirs in the abandoned laboratory?

10534.name: Splendid Thunderclaps
10534.desc: You made your way close to the castle. Now you need to climb a trail up the cliffs, but you'll have to fight difficult foes here as well.

8800012.name: Spring Paradise
8800012.desc: You can only enter Spring Paradise once a day. There you will find the legendary guardians protecting their precious tablets...

10321.name: Sprinkling Miasma
10321.desc: Could the flowers' miasma be pollen? The miasma that fills the air is even more hazardous to one's health than the lake's pollution.

1580.name: Squirming Beings
1580.desc: You have reached the depths of this territory sealed by the gods. Within it lies the results of an experiment that offends their divinity...

25023.name: Stable Foundations
25023.desc: How many years will it be until this region is habitable once again? You must stop the demon's resurrection, at any cost.

10310.name: Stagnant Water
10310.desc: You reach a lifeless lake housing water that is clearly not meant for drinking. The miasma that has settled in the place makes your stay unbearable.

22060.name: Stagnant Winds
22060.desc: You're surprised that the floors are soft. It seems like all of the flooring is made of woven leaves. You notice that Sakunoshin is going barefoot.

772.name: Stairway to Extinction
772.desc: It's a long way to the top, and on top of that there are even more enemies here than outside. What Paris said now stirs uneasiness within you.

261.name: Stairway to the Heavens
261.desc: This tower is like a gigantic fortress. The spiral stairs that surround its vast outer walls are the only way up...

811.name: Standing in the Snow
811.desc: Before you notice, your once wet hair and clothes are frozen. Surely you'll catch a cold in this radically changing weather. Brush away the frost and hurry ahead.

10243.name: Star Lane
10243.desc: When you turn on a corner of the main road, you see that a group of enemies has been waiting for you. Could these be the protectors of this old city?

10142.name: Star of Ruin
10142.desc: A bad feeling overcomes you. A sharp, blood thirsty will made of pure evil draws near. There's nowhere to run, so prepare a good counterattack.

10.name: Start of Adventure
10.desc: Your journey as a Summoner traveling across Grand Gaia has begun! Go forth, and don't forget what Tilith taught you!

8314010.name: Static Fields
8314010.desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Thunder Bulbs, flashing with electric rhythm.

8310302.name: Status Brawl Lv. 2
8310302.desc: Auspicious creatures come out to play, challenge and brawl.

20702.name: Steady Movements
20702.desc: Hatch and Tull seem to have told the truth about lacking combat abilities. Maybe this would have been easier if they could fight with you...

20701.name: Still Moving
20701.desc: Massive numbers of machines are attacking. It's exhausting and there's no end in sight. Reda appears to be sick of it, too.

1124.name: Stonewall Defender
1124.desc: You're nearly out of the forest, but you must defeat the legendary guardian before you. Prepare yourself as you face off with the stone-like guardian.

8301275.name: Storage
8301275.desc: Attached to the kitchen is a storage, though any food has long since rotted. There might be something tucked away here.

744.name: Stormy Surprise Attack
744.desc: The sky has become brighter. It seems you might soon be able to escape this strange weather. Is Lugina waiting ahead like he said he'd be?

10234.name: Strong Wind Dynamics
10234.desc: Though the windmill seems pretty old, it is still in very good condition, and even mobile. Could this have been the energy source for the lab?

150601.name: Struggle to Escape
150601.desc: Leaders of the Escape Vol. 1 - After the defeat of the Six Heroes, all regions fall into chaos. Leaders must step up to guide the people anew.

10213.name: Struggle to the Death
10213.desc: The "Six Armors" that Mora mentioned, which rival demonic powers, start to bug you. You may have to fight them in the future.

25580002.name: Strung Along
25580002.desc: The mistress of the tower has quite a yarn to spin regarding the rogue dolls.

10754.name: Sub-zero Cliffs
10754.desc: You've gotten close to the top. If you lose your footing here you're finished, yet your enemies fight without concern for the location. Be careful.

10362.name: Submissive Power
10362.desc: Grahdens mentioned that someone in Ishgria resents the Summoners of Old. However, the existence of such a creature is surprising in itself.

83012830.name: Summer Paradise
83012830.desc: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day in the summer. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside…

6000000.name: Summoners' Training Ground
6000000.desc: A place where Summoners can train for battle by setting certain settings and conditions.

500022.name: Summoning Arts Training Lv.3
500022.desc: A battle simulator designed to hone your Summoning skills. Defeat all foes standing in your way to hone your techniques!

500020.name: Summoning Arts Training Lv. 1
500020.desc: A special battle simulator designed to hone the Summoning Arts. Defeat all foes in your way to grow more proficient!

500021.name: Summoning Arts Training Lv. 2
500021.desc: A special battle simulator designed to hone the Summoning Arts. Exterminate all foes heading towards you to hone your techniques!

10610.name: Sunken City
10610.desc: Karl seems dead set on fighting no matter what. You're not done trying to talk him down yet, but you may need to face him in combat.

100651.name: Super Jewel Parade
100651.desc: Here comes a mystical parade full of high class jewel monsters. Now's your chance to get super rich with Kings and higher guaranteed!

100601.name: Super Metal Parade!
100601.desc: A grand procession featuring only Metal Units that are Super Rare and above! Metal Kings and above guaranteed, don't miss this great chance!

1565.name: Suppressing Evil
1565.desc: As you make your climb down the steep cliff, demons come after you. Only a little bit more until you reach the Grand Gaia Crater where Lucius awaits.

10451.name: Suppressive Corruption
10451.desc: The world above was magnificent, but the world below leaves much to be desired. Why would demons come all the way down here looking for shelter?

150002.name: Supreme God of Fire
150002.desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 3 - The violent battle with the gods. Fighting alongside his comrades as well as rivals, this is where the fire hero's legend began.

1424.name: Surging Bay Breeze
1424.desc: A strong wind blows. The water's surface ripples, and then crashes in a big splash. It may be a sign of the road up ahead, which makes you nervous.

24051.name: Surging Spirit
24051.desc: The temple has comparatively little damage and is well maintained. Maybe those two gods you encountered in this world are taking care of it?

10703.name: Surging Vigor
10703.desc: Some of the oil that is pumped up is burned to remove impurities. That is why this facility belches forth flames endlessly.

150801.name: Surpassing the Gods
150801.desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 2 - The disciples of the Divine Ten draw their weapons against their masters. They all have their reasons for fighting.

1561.name: Suspended in the Dark
1561.desc: This place is said to have been where people received divine commands from the gods. It must be a special place for the Oracle Knight Ark.

8301233.name: Sweet Harlequin
8301233.desc: Look, it's me, Ellie! And just in time too! We're going to have a hoppening time together, I know it! See what I did there? Tee-hee!

8301223.name: Sweet Spring Encore
8301223.desc: As the two singers' voices resonate in unison, the snow begins to make way for a new spring. Whose voice shall echo for all eternity?

8301525.name: Sweet Tooth
8301525.desc: Can't get enough of that sugar rush? Indulge yourself!

803.name: Swift Blowing Flames
803.desc: Pushing aside the steamy air, a scorching hot wind blows in. The parched air instantly dries your once sweat covered body.

10114.name: Swirling Scales
10114.desc: There's a faint aroma of sea breeze in the moist air.  This change can only mean that the end of the Wetlands is near.

8301142.name: Swish Swash
8301142.desc: Down the river you go! Gazolina's ready to make a splash--in style! Can you handle the heat?

1004.name: Sword of Fire
1004.desc: A hero wielding a sword of fire waits ahead. You must somehow sneak past the mix of holy and unholy flames and make it out of the cave.

244.name: Sword of Lightning Speed
244.desc: You reached the temple's innermost area. A mighty swordsman awaits you, and you can surely expect a fierce battle...

751.name: Sword of Protection
751.desc: You notice elaborate carvings in the pieces of stone around your feet. The powderized remains of buildings speak of the violent battle that took place here.

1165.name: Symphony of Thunder
1165.desc: You exit onto the castle's roof. The god Zurg spoke of should be at the top of the tower ahead. However, a hero of lightning blocks your way.

1140.name: Talented War Maiden
1140.desc: Though it now lies in ruins, the town remains lit by a glass-sided, gravestone-like tower. The scene is quite mysterious.

8301149.name: Tartaros
8301149.desc: The shadowy figure near the gate turns out to be Mard Geer, from the same world as Fairy Tail. Will your efforts be enough to stop him?

8301587.name: Teasing Thunder
8301587.desc: The sound of thunder reverberates around you in an almost playful manner.

10121.name: Tempered Demon Rocks
10121.desc: Paris warns that the thick and overgrown plants here are different from the ones in Grand Gaia. Some of them may be poisonous, so be careful.

10241.name: Temple Ruins
10241.desc: While looking at the landscape you realize that both demons and humans must have lived here long ago. Could humans really have inhabited Ishgria?

5000010.name: Ten-Winged Tormentor
5000010.desc: Not long before the great war with the gods, a young lady from the La Veda Republic called Michele witnessed a strange dark object fall from the sky. After meeting Duel-GX and learning that it has come from another world chasing the winged armor "Melchio," which had been destroying neighboring towns, Michele begins her journey to destroy Melchio...

10441.name: Ten Thousand Lights
10441.desc: Could developed metropolises such as this one exist in other worlds? Perhaps Randall will come to resemble it someday .

1034.name: Terminal Thunderstorm
1034.desc: You reach the opposite end of the marsh. It doesn't seem like Grahdens is being held anywhere around here. Proceed to the sea.

24044.name: Terra Firma Fury
24044.desc: While walking through the forest, you recall your adventures so far and become lost in thought. You need to focus on the battle awaiting you.

83015900.name: Test of Strength
83015900.desc: Armaiti would like you to indulge her curiosity about your powers. A few games could pass the time.

83015911.name: Test of Wits
83015911.desc: Vohu appraises you with a discerning eye, inviting you to an impromptu competition against the creatures.

10075.name: Tested Power
10075.desc: An entirely different enemy than any of the ones the fallen heroes before you ever faced is expecting you at the top of the tower. Shusui awaits.

832.name: That Which Haunts the Ruins
832.desc: As rough as the inside of the ruins is, they still seem to be intact. There also don't appear to be any traps to protect from intruders, but still...

20070.name: The Amorphus Being
20070.desc: There's a cavern just behind the Ignia Falls. A mysterious beast has awaken deep inside, seemingly disturbed by your battle with the giants. What could it be?

822.name: The Ancient Forest's Guardian
822.desc: Various strange flowers bloom proudly around you. Their mixing smells produce a strange aroma. It's almost...intoxicating...

710.name: The Ash-Covered Pass
710.desc: Entering the mountains the sky grows dark. Could it be because of the smoke rising up from the volcanic ash? Dead trees line the path ahead.

500.name: The Ash Covered Hill
500.desc: Encervis, the second island in the Palmyna Archipelago. You first come across its scorching hot volcanic ash covered hills.

20002.name: The Bandits’ Feast
20002.desc: You’ve stumbled into a thriving monster habitat. Judging by the hungry glint in their eyes, you’re probably the first human they’ve seen in centuries.

20022.name: The Bandits’ Trap
20022.desc: Even after the world has been reduced to rubble, the souls of bandits continue to exist deep within the forest. They target travelers’ valuables, just like when they were alive.

303.name: The Banished Fire Dragon
303.desc: You finally made it through the pass. The intense heat hasn't gone, but at least it's all downhill from here. Hurry on ahead.

20014.name: The Battleaxe Descends
20014.desc: Just as you’re about to exit on the other side of Ignia Falls, a watery monarch emerges from behind the waterfall. He’s come to expel the intruders in his domain...

2100001.name: The Beast God
2100001.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

232.name: The Bewitching Tactician
232.desc: You're nearing the center of the wastelands. Did Karl and his team successfully bring down the demon they were chasing?

1503.name: The Birds' Invitation
1503.desc: The dim forest is full of silence. The moment you think your ears have grown accustomed to it, a flock of birds suddenly lets out a shrilling cry.

965.name: The Black Candelabrum
965.desc: You have reached the innermost area of the shrine. You will have to defeat the remaining enemies here before you flush Mare out, but do not worry: you are not alone.

504.name: The Black Flame Warrior
504.desc: As you cross over the ash stained hills, a figure blanketed in black flames appears before you. A smile comes across your face, delighted to have come across such a warrior.

8301320.name: The Black Wizard
8301320.desc: The Black Wizard Zeref does not appear to harbor any ill will towards you… However, an eerie force suddenly attacks you when you approach him!

151100.name: The Blade Burns Anew
151100.desc: After having lost his memory in battle, Avant comes across a blade of flames. What awaits him after having overcome the loss of his son?

23.name: The Blazing Beast
23.desc: Looks like you'll be able to leave this cave soon, but there seems to be something sinister awaiting you at the end.

10801.name: The Blazing Gate
10801.desc: The blazing gate opens, scorching the very air. Under cover of billowing smoke, countless enemies have poured forth. Don't let them slow you down.

1014.name: The Blizzard Begins
1014.desc: A wielder of ice magic carrying a terrifying axe stands in your way. A fierce battle is about to start, but make it quick. The snowfield's exit is near.

83014220.name: The Blood of Iori
83014220.desc: As an ancient curse causes a familiar face to twist into a maddened visage, the battle to reclaim his sanity has begun. Ready to choose your path? Go!

963.name: The Blue Hallway
963.desc: Rescuing Karl surely threw a wrench into Mare's plans. If you can attack her head-on and avoid her trickery, you have quite a fighting chance.

100200.name: The Box of Desires Lv. 1
100200.desc: A dangerous cave full of traps to ensnare those who dare enter. Despite its dangers, many still venture after its treasures.

100201.name: The Box of Desires Lv. 2
100201.desc: Further into the dangerous, trap-filled cave. Mountains of treasure or oceans of despair, who knows what awaits!

100202.name: The Box of Desires Lv. 3
100202.desc: There are many secrets in this trap-filled cave. Do you fear getting trapped in despair, or are you hopeful to find riches!?

760.name: The Bridge to Ruin
760.desc: Now that you stand near the bridge it looks a lot bigger than it seamed from far away. You can see an ominous tower far in the distance, but could that be the end?

721.name: The Bullet in the Ice
721.desc: It is dry here as well, but for a different reason than it was up in the mountains. It's impossible to stand still in this cold. Could Lugina really be waiting here?

25590004.name: The Burned
25590004.desc: Phaedra tracks Angahl into a desecrated, dilapidated clearing.

200.name: The Burning Desert
200.desc: Your journey through Morgan begins in a huge desert. The scorching haze indicates the fierce battle to come.

1065.name: The Burning Hero
1065.desc: Everybody knows of the hero from Agni clad in flames. His reputation precedes him, like the sinister air that fills the passageway in front of you.

311.name: The Captivated Water Sprite
311.desc: Unlike the Volcano Eldent, this blizzard-covered sacred mountain has many steep cliffs. Watch your step.

520.name: The Castle Gates Open
520.desc: Now knowing how dangerous the Sky Fort really is, you must put all you have into taking it down per Elder Grah's request.

2000008.name: The Cobalt Impact
2000008.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

851.name: The Coiling Shadows
851.desc: Why was Karl kidnapped? Mare said she wished to show him the truth, but still...Karl is your closest friend. You must save him.

564.name: The Commander's Pets
564.desc: You're reached the deepest reaches of the Sky Fort. Zebra is close at hand, but your way is blocked by what were some of the greatest warriors to have ever lived.

460.name: The Commander's Power
460.desc: Amdahl Castle, where vengeful ghosts of the past are said to reside. Through here is the only way to get to Palmyna, the land sealed away by Cardes the Malevolent.

461.name: The Commander's Skill
461.desc: According to Elder Grah, a vengeful ghost that resents humans lives here. Still, you mustn't lose your way, even if only to prevent yourself from becoming a ghost as well.

1002.name: The Commander of Fire
1002.desc: This land is said to inspire the spirit of warfare in its inhabitants. Judging from the enemies standing in your way, this seems to be true.

603.name: The Commander of Flames
603.desc: Thirst and hunger line the scorching path ahead. In the steamy distance awaits a chef unmoved by the heat. What ingredients could she be looking for?

776.name: The Corpse Producing Machine
776.desc: You can hear a ghastly noise coming from the roof. It's the final gate protecting Lizeria's hidden power. Muster your courage and go forth.

5000012.name: The Correct Path
5000012.desc: Just before the great war with the gods, the Guardians of Meirith receive new orders. They travel to Ishgria in order to defeat the demon Ragruvord, who is attempting to invade Grand Gaia. However, before they can confront him, a messenger appears from the gods. They hear that someone is after Karna Masta, and are ordered to return to Grand Gaia immediately.

2100004.name: The Creation God
2100004.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

5000003.name: The Crimson God's Cry
5000003.desc: After defeating Maxwell, the Summoner receives an urgent request from Akras Summoners' Hall. The Demon Algmos has been spotted and a squad has been sent to slay him, but Seria ignored orders and went to seek him out alone. The Hall wants you to bring her back safely.It seems Algmos's decimation of a squad Seria had led in the past started it all...

2000006.name: The Crimson Terror
2000006.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

1262.name: The Crooked Slope
1262.desc: The curved hallway spirals upwards and upwards. If you stumble when you lose in battle, you may end up tumbling all the way down...

630.name: The Crumbling City
630.desc: Grandelt was once the most vibrant city in Palmyna, but it has since turned into a ghost town. Lined with abandoned buildings, it now stands in ruins.

714.name: The Crumbling God
714.desc: The air is dry as always, but it's getting harder and harder to breath. After a short break, an intense roar echoes from afar.

8301640.name: The Curse Master
8301640.desc: An otherworldly visitor carrying the chill winds of death has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

72.name: The Cursed Snake
72.desc: A monster with snakes for arms has appeared. Beware, it seems many adventurers have been subdued by its strength.

354.name: The Death-beckoning Devil
354.desc: You seem to have finally figured your way out of the cave, but all of the sudden an unsettling evil presence descends upon you...

1421.name: The Deep Riverbed
1421.desc: At times, the river fish jump high up. Surprised by the sound, you finally see the enemy closing in. You realize now the fish were trying to warn you.

150020.name: The Demon Pike's Seed
150020.desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 1 - Lance and his demon pike. Continuing his fateful journey, many a powerful foe appeared before him.

1505.name: The Demons' Feast
1505.desc: You're almost out of the forest. You want to meet Tilith as soon as possible to talk to her, but the demonic miasma around you refuses to allow it.

1104.name: The Disasterous Beast
1104.desc: An overwhelming force stands in your way. Prepare yourself, as it seems the last Fallen God has sent forth the legendary Disastrous Beast.

1066.name: The Divine Emperor
1066.desc: You have made it to the top of the tower after defeating the burning hero. But now you must do what the gods couldn't and defeat the Fallen God Zevalhua!

531.name: The Divine Wind Blows
531.desc: As a stiff wind blows down on you from the ravine making it difficult to even stand, in an instant the sky grows dark. You look up to see something hovering above you...

10861.name: The Domain of Despair
10861.desc: Parting the thick mist, you search for any sign of Ilia. You feel the overpowering aura of a mighty god, but can find no trace of the Oracle Maiden.

8301491.name: The Doom of Love
8301491.desc: Logic and hope war within Aesys, as she begins to suspect that her husband has not come back as himself. Yet it is so much easier to cling onto blind denial...

150900.name: The Dragon Awakens
150900.desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 1 -  Priscilla and Arus chase after a rampaging ancient dragon. However, a demon seems to lie behind it all...

33.name: The Dragon Hunting Ice Knight
33.desc: The end of this cold snow field has come into view at last. However, it seems one of Maxwell's knights is waiting just ahead.

1500.name: The Dragons' Welcome
1500.desc: As you approach the heart of the gloomy forest, you think you hear the cry of the ancient dragon rumored to be sealed within it.

224.name: The Earth Shattering Spear
224.desc: The darkness has lightened. The exit should be close, but there's tension in the air. Surely, the sign of a formidable foe.

5008010.name: The Echoing Void
5008010.desc: The birth of Kranus brought a change in the Void. Mysterious forces are now actively shaping events in the infinite worlds littered throughout the cosmos. Back in Randall, Noel ponders the age old question: "Was our will ever our own?"

5000016.name: The End of an Empire
5000016.desc: During the final stages of the war against the gods, the Bariura Empire is surrounded by the God Army. As the capital crumbles before their eyes, Sirius and the first princess Selvia decide to act to protect the imperial family's legacy. However, their plan could result in national unrest, which drives Sirius to question whether he should go forth with it...

1052.name: The Endless Blackout
1052.desc: The festering miasma in this town is not simply the remnants of warfare. You are certain that forbidden curses were used in these parts.

1121.name: The Endless Forest
1121.desc: Though the way has been spotted with ruins, there are now none in sight. This area has likely been a simple forest since long ago.

1261.name: The Endless Hallway
1261.desc: You cannot find the staircase that leads upstairs, so you take the only way available deep inside. The path seems slanted, slowly curving upwards.

210.name: The Endless Shores
210.desc: You've reached the shore, escaping the desert. A calm, beautiful beach awaits you, but you must still be cautious.

654.name: The Endless Struggle
654.desc: You come across an unending battle, where man and brute fight over who gets to lay claim to the other's soul.

552.name: The Endlessly Dying Witch
552.desc: Monsters rush at you as if under some sort of spell. This appears to be a challenge from one who possesses power that transcends even death.

265.name: The Eroding Barricade
265.desc: You've reached the top at last. Continue on and defeat Abaddon and Graham, you can't let Karl and the others down!

25010001.name: The Fighting Nun
25010001.desc: Can you prevail against the Fighting Nun's shotguns of justice?

1354.name: The Final Hour
1354.desc: The castle is within a stone's throw, and the god's powerful presence grows stronger. However, it's no time to buckle under pressure. Step inside.

20000905.name: The Final Push
20000905.desc: The final wave has arrived, and with it, the promise of victory.

10300.name: The First Summoner
10300.desc: Owen says one shouldn't have overly positive expectations. Let your guard down for a second, and you will be defeated. Better prepare yourself well.

8301552.name: The First Truth
8301552.desc: Pleased with her prowess, the mysterious woman reveals herself, and the truths to come…

501.name: The Flames that Rule
501.desc: As you head toward Cardes, your way is blocked by nymphs and dragons that command the power of fire. Their presence is like that of an overwhelming pillar of flames.

341.name: The Flourishing Garden
341.desc: This area is obviously sacred, bathed in light and covered in green, but being so close to St. Lamia Palace surely strong foes await.

20010.name: The Foot of the Rainbow
20010.desc: You exit the infernal cave and come upon a huge waterfall spanned by a breathtaking rainbow. Finally, some beautiful scenery to soothe your weary soul.

841.name: The Foreboding Gunshot
841.desc: Could this path also be part of the ruins? The moss covered path and crumbling statues show show the passage of time. Still, this is no time to relax.

1431.name: The Forest's Fountain
1431.desc: You arrive at a place in the forest where a small spring bubbles. You consider taking a rest, but enemies start appearing one by one. Break's over.

622.name: The Forest's Savior
622.desc: It's been countless years since the last of the humans died out, but still the forest doesn't sleep. It seems it has thrived in their absence.

150022.name: The Forest's Sublimation
150022.desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 3 - The gods' invasion had at last begun. Inspired by the demon pike, this is where the earth hero's legend began.

820.name: The Forest's Uneasy Peace
820.desc: Plants that you've never seen before flourish everywhere. Smash your way through this overflowingly vibrant forest just as Seria would expect you to.

85.name: The Forged Gigantor
85.desc: You're almost at the top. A mechanical deity, likely Maxwell's creation, awaits. The final battle for Mistral begins.

364.name: The Fourfold Pillar
364.desc: You can feel the fallen god's presence grow stronger as you proceed. However, surely she has set up a powerful defensive line before her.

1112.name: The Frozen Palace
1112.desc: A gorgeous palace stands in the center of town. However, the fountain in its courtyard stands frozen. Soon an ice wielding hero is upon you.

723.name: The Frozen Surface
723.desc: A chilling wind blows across the lake. Attempting to shrug off the piercing cold, the temperature around you drops unnaturally. What could it be?

1253.name: The Fury of Darkness
1253.desc: The ill wills of revenge and madness prevent you from stepping any further. The hero waiting ahead looks powerful, so prepare yourself.

424.name: The Gallant Earth God
424.desc: On your way from the prairie, someone has been sent to block your path. Carefully proceed forward.

8301274.name: The Gallery
8301274.desc: Amateur paintings, mostly of flowers and skeletons, hang on the wall. You can't help but feel that you are being watched.

1450.name: The Garden of Life
1450.desc: After climbing over the mountain, you reach a beautiful garden. However, no people seem to come here, so how has it been kept so well maintained?

361.name: The Gates of Hell
361.desc: This castle once was revered for its majesty. While still impressive, it's surrounded in a sinister atmosphere.

705.name: The Giant's Dream
705.desc: The end of the road is in sight. However, as you advance the monsters only grow in numbers. You must maintain focus as you move ahead.

20067.name: The Giant God Awakes
20067.desc: After defeating the giants, you now face the toughest challenge of all in their king, Grantos. The final showdown to determine the fate of Cordelica is about to begin.

1540.name: The Gigantic Tower
1540.desc: What could Ark's real motives be? Why is he attempting to test the Summoners' power? Or could he be trying to end it all here?

1551.name: The Glory of Victory
1551.desc: When Ark removed his mask, his determination was written all over his face. Will you be able to hear any more important information from him again?

150052.name: The God Eater
150052.desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 3 - Eliminating all enemies from his path the ever angry and resentful Magress has finally attained the power of the gods!

1366.name: The God of Truth
1366.desc: The time for the real final fight with the last Fallen God, the Beast God Afla Dilith, has come... Defeat him and return to your friends!

343.name: The Goddess of War
343.desc: Seems even a holy goddess has been called on to block your path. However, you must defeat her and press on if you're to save Tilith.

1242.name: The Gods' Martial Art
1242.desc: A fighting goddess forbids you from moving forward, as if she cannot forgive those who disturb her garden. However, there's no stopping now.

962.name: The Golden Hall
962.desc: The shrine at the bottom of the ocean has a confusing, unearthly aura. The fact that Lugina was able to find Karl here is impressive.

1063.name: The Golden Halo
1063.desc: As you climb up the stairs, you see a tremendous enemy blocking the sunlight. Make the heroes before you proud and trounce this ten-winged tormentor!

421.name: The Graceful Figure
421.desc: On your way toward Amdahl Castle, an incredibly graceful figure appears before you. Vanquish it and move ahead.

1221.name: The Great Tree's Life
1221.desc: The forest capital of Vriksha. Seeing how much it truly differs from the Vriksha of yore, you can't help but wonder what happened to this country.

602.name: The Great Wall
602.desc: A man-eating demon and an ancient dragon wrapped in flames block the path toward Obselion Castle where Tilith awaits you.

2000004.name: The Green Menace
2000004.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

10614.name: The Guide of Eras
10614.desc: Regardless of whatever the demon Barion thought, you can't be sure without actually meeting it. Time to get moving.

1154.name: The Half-Demon Girl
1154.desc: Feeling the wind, you realize you might soon be out of the cave. But before proceeding, you must first defeat a legendary demon.

8382130.name: The Haunted Lands
8382130.desc: The lands fall into what seem like an eternal nightfall. From the twilight, demons and monsters emerge...

70.name: The Heinous Chamber
70.desc: This spine-chillingly eerie mansion reeks of an evil presence. Here you'll need the power to oppose darkness.

8301690.name: The Herald of Yggdrasil
8301690.desc: A dark and evil force that once overwhelmed the fabled realm of Valhalla has begun its corruption of Grand Gaia. Can you defeat the Herald of Yggdrasil?

1322.name: The Hive's Den
1322.desc: Along with a shrilling cry, a flock of birds flies off frightened. A loud roar follows after. It's the sound of an otherworldly machine at work!

2100007.name: The Holy Emperor
2100007.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

8351000.name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 1
8351000.desc: While others struggle on the ground, she soars through the sky to wherever the light reaches, and fights for those who seek freedom.

8352000.name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 2
8352000.desc: If death can't stop her, nothing will. As long as there is a ray of light, she'll trace it down, even to Gaia's end.

8353000.name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 3
8353000.desc: Stronger, higher, faster. Whoever said the sky's the limit obviously never met Vanila. To this airborne warrior, the sky is but the starting line.

8300811.name: The Hunt Begins
8300811.desc: It seems a strange creature from Paskua has come to Grand Gaia in search of something. What could it be after, and why?

222.name: The Hunter of Time
222.desc: The discomfort you felt in the forests of Mistral is back, but this time it's worse. Could this be the work of a time mage?

513.name: The Ice Cold Warrior
513.desc: You proceed alongside the lake, headed toward the Sky Fort. Alongside the light of the sun being reflected off the lake is the reflection of a single icy blade.

610.name: The Ice Covered Castle
610.desc: The royal family of Palmyna once resided in this magnificent castle. It's beautifully frozen corridors now give off a feeling of sadness.

914.name: The Ice that Binds
914.desc: As you approach the end of the beach, the sand turns to mud. If experience has taught you anything, something formidable should be waiting ahead.

8301710.name: The Illusionist
8301710.desc: An otherworldly visitor bearing the likeliness of a jester has appeared on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

970.name: The Imprisoned Tyrant
970.desc: It is said a ghastly spirit is sealed away deep within this gloomy dungeon home to dark secrets left from the Agni Empire.

861.name: The Indestructible Formation
861.desc: There's a sturdy tower intricately built from white stones. From its appearance, it looks like it was built as a military fortress, but it feels creepy.

101100.name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 1
101100.desc: A boxer who set out on an epic journey to discover her origins. Her fists make mincemeat out of any who dare to approach her.

101101.name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 2
101101.desc: She has sworn to continue traveling until she finds the answers she’s looking for. A world of hurt awaits any who stand in her way.

101102.name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 3
101102.desc: None exist who haven’t heard of this true brawling legend. She respects only those who understand the true meaning of destruction.

101103.name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 4
101103.desc: A martial artist at her very peak, a master of brute destruction. Pride is her only weakness.

83510001.name: The Keymaster's Eclipse Lv. 1
83510001.desc: A strange eclipse, an unfamiliar silhouette. He who holds the key has tapped into a long lost power, a hypnotic force that is spread across Grand Gaia.

83520001.name: The Keymaster's Eclipse Lv. 2
83520001.desc: Dark and light, good and evil... Can you maintain balance, or will you give in to the Keymaster's magic? The force of the eclipse is growing...

1243.name: The Knight's Guidance
1243.desc: You reach the castle at the heart of the garden. When you set foot there, a hero wielding a holy blade and a knight with a great sword appear.

903.name: The Knight in Crimson
903.desc: You are still surprised that Lugina is cooperating in Karl's rescue. Though his words suggest otherwise, he isn't such a bad person.

512.name: The Lake's Allure
512.desc: While gazing upon the beautiful lake, you hear a lovely singing voice. However you mustn't be seduced by it, because the being it's coming from surely isn't human.

511.name: The Lakeside Master
511.desc: As you're searching the lakeside, you suddenly see a great shadow on the surface of the water. It's likely the ruler of Lake Aldela.

23064.name: The Land's Center
23064.desc: It won't be easy to face Rahnas unless you can fully defeat the enchanted puppet. It's a powerful foe, but you can beat anything if you try!

250.name: The Land Devoured by Monsters
250.desc: You see ruins as you escape from the temple. It seems that whatever existed here before was destroyed by a great power.

1141.name: The Last Defender
1141.desc: Could scenes like this be commonplace in the otherworld? Also, what happened to the god who was supposed to have destroyed this town?

8301414.name: The Last Judgment
8301414.desc: Help Auberi to solve the puzzle and summon the Rainbow Crystal!

150701.name: The Last Stand
150701.desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 2 - A fierce battle erupts when those after the demon Vishra finally meet their target.

1350.name: The Lifeless Snake
1350.desc: You are overwhelmed by the gigantic stature of the castle-like Afla Dilith. However, everyone is counting on you, so there's no time to waste.

943.name: The Light that Vanquishes Evil
943.desc: Continuing this solo battle is both physically and emotionally taxing. Try not to worry about Karl, or you'll play right into Mare's hands.

912.name: The Limits of Wisdom and Courage
912.desc: Though walking along the shore reminds you of your time with Tilith back at Morgan, there is no time for reminiscing. Brace yourself and press ahead.

150030.name: The Lone Bounty Hunter
150030.desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 1 - Eze, in his younger days as a demon bounty hunter. Experience the fateful meeting that changed his life forever.

100700.name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 1
100700.desc: A traveler on the first steps of her journey. Her inexperience clouds her ability to see the value in friendship.

100701.name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 2
100701.desc: A traveler who has come to be known throughout the land. She's realized the value of having someone to train with.

100702.name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 3
100702.desc: A valiant traveler who commands praise wherever she goes. She continues her journey, always on the look out for worthy allies.

100703.name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 4
100703.desc: A celebrated traveler who is almost unmatched in her swordsmanship. Her skills had brought her to be able to match herself to fight against the gods' invasion.

1041.name: The Long Shot
1041.desc: Mare's abduction of Karl was an act of suicide. But why would Zevalhua take Grahdens captive?

25590002.name: The Long Way
25590002.desc: Deeper into the Vale lies more marks of human sin.

251.name: The Lusting Snake
251.desc: As you proceed, you realize the ruins cover a large area. It must have been a large city before.

565.name: The Mad God Descends
565.desc: Powerful enough to surpass even a goddess, the demonic Zebra is waiting just ahead. Strengthen your will as preparedness may become a vital weapon in the end.

241.name: The Magnificent Pegasus
241.desc: You continue even deeper into the massive temple. You can make out the solemn silhouettes of pegasi standing about.

1023.name: The Majestic Trees
1023.desc: You happen upon an old tree that manages to stand out in the ocean of its peers. Though not much taller than the others, it is far wider. You must make your way around it.

2100003.name: The Malevolent God
2100003.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

8301102.name: The Maw of Darkness
8301102.desc: As you explore the building, blood is thick in the air. Everyone around you seems to be fighting each other!  What is going on?

541.name: The Meaning of Holiness
541.desc: There is a solemn atmosphere in the mausoleum where the natives pray to their god of light. However, there isn't enough time to investigate this supposed god any further...

20065.name: The Meaning of Irate Souls
20065.desc: Continuing deeper into the ruins in search of the strange sensation’s source, you come across souls driven mad mad by anger. What could have done this?

353.name: The Midnight Aristocrat
353.desc: It seems you've reached the dark, damp reaches of this hellish cave. Follow the wind to find your way out.

642.name: The Mischievous Goddess
642.desc: Lorand, one of the Heroes of Old. The place where he once taught as a professor has now been overtaken by dangerous monsters.

73.name: The Monster Slaying Blade
73.desc: A grotesque swordsman awaits you, and you must overcome him in order to reach the Tower of Mistral.

20030.name: The Moonlit Fortress
20030.desc: Do as Lugina says and defeat the hordes of monsters dwelling within the fortress. You’ll be able to continue with your investigation afterwards.

314.name: The Mountain-dwelling Devil
314.desc: The summit is in sight, and you've spotted the altar. The end is near, but there are signs of a beast nearby...

10734.name: The Name Shusui
10734.desc: Is Shusui covered in wounds from his battle with Owen? Or was it one of Mora's traps? Either way, you can't hold back against him.

260.name: The Never-Ending Tower
260.desc: Don't let Karl and Seria's wishes go to waste. Ascend the tower quickly and track down Abaddon and Graham!

514.name: The Ocean Master
514.desc: The path toward the old castle is open before you on the other side of the lake. However before you waits a sea god, wearing a fearless smile.

5000004.name: The Old Dawn General
5000004.desc: After facing Lucius, the Summoner receives a request from Elder Grahdens.He wants the Summoner to defeat the Demon Mashreed as a training exercise. However, Mashreed is not the only demon in the area, as there are many others in the mix.Grahdens is ready to wipe the floor with these demons, but it seems he has some particular expectations in mind.

8301472.name: The Old Gods' Legacies
8301472.desc: Hetepheres learns about the origins of the Vessels' powers from Aesys, who reveals herself to be one of the Old Gods.

666.name: The Open Seal
666.desc: The path to Cardes is now open. Now's your chance to put an end to him, and once again show your power over the gods!

151000.name: The Oracle Knight
151000.desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 1 - The Oracle Knight lives to serve the god Lucius. Amongst the many to bear that title, one went by the name of Ark...

8301147.name: The Origin of Darkness
8301147.desc: A disturbance has appeared in Ishgria--a mysterious door has opened to a Dark realm. What could be going on?

1113.name: The Parting Waters
1113.desc: Leaving the palace alongside the river, the surface of the water suddenly explodes. The water freezes above as bullets of ice are shot your way.

700.name: The Path Begins
700.desc: A new investigation has begun into the land of Lizeria. The path to the once thriving La Veda Republic lies open, covered in weeds as it may be.

613.name: The Path Forward
613.desc: You couldn't find Tilith, but just as Grahdens said, you must put your faith in her and move forth. Your goal is to defeat Cardes.

8380130.name: The Path Less Travelled
8380130.desc: The lands begin to darken, covered in shadows. A mysterious aura draws the curious and the timid alike.

1575.name: The Path to Freedom
1575.desc: You wonder if Karl and the others are unharmed. They must have crossed many a powerful enemy on the way here. Quickly, you must reach Lucius!

1342.name: The Path You Trust
1342.desc: This road offers a clear view of the surroundings, so there's no fear of an ambush. However, there's nothing you can use to deflect aerial attacks.

254.name: The Peculiar Black Knight
254.desc: You reached the ruins' end. The majestic Tower of Morgan stands before you. However, a knight in thick armor awaits...

840.name: The Pegasus Maiden
840.desc: A wind gently blows through the soft sunlight. Exiting the ruins, you seem to be on the side of a mountain. The sky is clear and the weather is pleasant.

362.name: The Phony Paradise
362.desc: As expected, Maxwell has filled her base with incredibly powerful beings. Liberating them is going to be difficult.

84.name: The Pillars of Force
84.desc: Masters of each of the four elements stand in wait as the final barrier in the path to the lord of the tower.

2100006.name: The Pious Emperor
2100006.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

32.name: The Pirate on Ice
32.desc: You've reached the center of the icy field. Beware, apparently there are pirates about on the ice...

1244.name: The Power of Guidance
1244.desc: You can see the gate that marks the exit of the Sky Palace. However, in front of it stands a shiny and pale king of beasts. It's time for battle.

8301141.name: The Power of the Sky
8301141.desc: Time to take a drive on the wild side! Put that pedal to the metal--Crash Belt's here for some high-impact adventure!

204.name: The Power Seeking Swordsman
204.desc: The end of the desert is in view, and the wind now smells of the sea. However, a giant silhouette stands blocks your path...

923.name: The Power that Protects
923.desc: You worry about Karl's safety in the hands of Mare. However, now is the time to hurry ahead, not to think ominous thoughts about your friend.

202.name: The Precarious Beast Master
202.desc: A summoned being known as the king of beasts is rampaging in the desert. A fierce battle with him is unavoidable.

8301691.name: The Prescient Goddess, Frigg
8301691.desc: One of the most respected goddesses of Valhalla has descended upon Grand Gaia! Dare you challenge Frigg and prove your mettle against her powers of prescience?

780.name: The Presence Under the Surface
780.desc: You can feel the immense energy coming from the depths of the lake. But for what purpose does it continue to radiate the surface?

462.name: The Princess' Ball
462.desc: The beautifully decorated interior of the castle suggests that at one time many an extravagant banquet was held here. But all relics aside, it's time to head further inside.

1352.name: The Putrid Tome
1352.desc: The sound of your allies fighting behind you grows louder. Head towards the castle while everyone else draws the enemies' attention.

10111.name: The Queen & Ice Tower
10111.desc: You've seen many a spectacular scenery in Ishgria, so now that you're at the Wetlands, you can truly appreciate their bizarre beauty.

334.name: The Raged Beast of Destruction
334.desc: You can make out St. Lamia Palace in the distance, but the roar of a beast from the foothills nearby are concerning...

1064.name: The Rainbow Battlefield
1064.desc: You have never felt air this thick with tension and signs of enemies nearby. Prepare yourself, for the next battle may be your last.

812.name: The Rainbow Crowned Queen
812.desc: The sprawling snowscape before you is gorgeous, but as much as you'd like to stare this isn't the time to get distracted. You must catch up to Karl.

151401.name: The Randall Guard
151401.desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 2 - The Randall Guard has finally been formed, but its members seem rather peculiar...

10832.name: The Ravaged Land
10832.desc: This place has been so utterly ravaged that its original purpose is a mystery. Such is the power of the Holy Emperor...

961.name: The Red Gate
961.desc: Your exhaustion from the journey to rescue Karl has worn off. Perhaps the strong human bond between you that Mare loves to mock has its benefits.

8313002.name: The Reign Over Agni
8313002.desc: As he finally claimed the territory of the ruined Agni Empire, Leon faced officials, angry gods, and Summoners charging up his doorstep. Believing in equality among men, the thief of justice faced all odds with his cunning and wits.

151302.name: The Resistance
151302.desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 3 - Kulyuk's disciples spring into action, each acting on their own beliefs, but an even harsher fate awaits them...

20002201.name: The Righteous Sheriff
20002201.desc: Sheriff Gilbert's ready to take on a strapping challenger in his town!

333.name: The Riotous Thunderbird
333.desc: The Thunderbird circles above, letting out a piercing cry. You've no choice but to confront it and take it down.

823.name: The Roar in the Forest
823.desc: From far away you thought you saw a large tree, but now it seems to be coming toward you. Is this an illusion, or is the tree really moving?

866.name: The Roar of Triumph
866.desc: The top level of the white tower. The dragon slowly turns its gaze to you, and lets out a deafening roar. You have to defeat it and save Karl!

20023.name: The Roaring Warrior
20023.desc: The bandits tell of a dragon who protects all the trees in the forest. Could that be where this distant roar is coming from?

430.name: The Rotting Bridge
430.desc: After parting with Karl and Seria you proceed through the mines. Making your way through the monster infested tunnels, you come across a decaying bridge.

942.name: The Royal Bodyguard
942.desc: Fighting your enemies here makes you feel like a tomb raider. There don't seem to be too many booby-traps set in the tomb, but be careful.

570.name: The Ruins Where the Queen Nests
570.desc: Mysterious ruins were discovered in Encervis. It seems that a fiendish apparition haunts the place...

1473.name: The Sage & the Hero
1473.desc: Lightning flashes in the hall, and a sword that seems to block darkness shimmers brightly. If you want to stop the revolution, focus on the enemy now!

824.name: The Sal Trees
824.desc: As sunlight begins to peek into the forest, it seems you might be able to get out. Karl and Seria are in the ruins ahead. You must hurry to them.

8301560.name: The Savage Lion
8301560.desc: An otherworldly visitor bearing the likeness of a Lion has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

400.name: The Scars of War
400.desc: Amdahl, one of the islands in the Palmyna Archipelago which is ruled over by Cardes the Malevolent. A town can be seen near the entrance, having been devastated by war.

25001.name: The Scent of Death
25001.desc: You meet Lugina and proceed into a barren grassland. You never knew there were parts of Elgaia like this. What happened here?

600.name: The Scorched Pathway
600.desc: Your sights now rest on Cardes, one of the Four Fallen Gods. However the path ahead is scorching hot due to the blistering hot sun above.

20001600.name: The Scorching Blade
20001600.desc: Roy, the Scorching Blade, invites you to a blazing spar!

8301500.name: The Scorpion-Lord
8301500.desc: Fate is cruel, even to gods.

10824.name: The Sea of Trees
10824.desc: Bertz's words seep into your heart like poison. But if you can't shake off something like this, you'll never stand a chance against the Holy Emperor.

663.name: The Seal Breaks
663.desc: Just as Tilith said, the seal is nearly broken. As you wonder how you should deal with it, hordes of crazed monsters are looking to prey on you.

1570.name: The Seal has Broken
1570.desc: The battle has finally begun. Lucius seems to have no intentions of listening to humans. Tilith's words are also cause for concern...

2100005.name: The Sealed God
2100005.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

150100.name: The Search for Allies
150100.desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 1 - After receiving a revelation, Edea sets off on a journey to search for allies to help repel the gods' attack on Palmyna.

151200.name: The Secret of Bariura
151200.desc: The Noble Thief Zelnite's story has yet to be told... Follow our mysterious hero as he uncovers the sinister plot of the Bariura Empire!

621.name: The Shadow in the Trees
621.desc: All manner of beasts try and stand in your way as you work towards the Spirit World, the land where Cardes is sealed away...

8301470.name: The Shards of Power
8301470.desc: The new Vessels each obtained their awesome but terrifying powers abruptly, but they have yet to find out how.

911.name: The Shining Ice Flow
911.desc: The comfortable sea breeze is a perfect complement to the sun's strong rays. But you don't have time to enjoy it and must keep searching for where Karl is being held.

20040.name: The Shining Tower
20040.desc: You arrive at the Tower of Light hot on the heels of Lugina and Paris. Could the mystery of Cordelica really lie within its radiant and lofty walls?

20001500.name: The Silver Knight
20001500.desc: The Silver Knight Joshua has challenged you to a duel.

554.name: The Skies Above
554.desc: You look up to see the Sky Fort! Have faith in Tilith and push your way through this final obstacle!

632.name: The Sky Devouring Bird
632.desc: You're now headed for the Noera Battlegrounds. However, the sky suddenly turns black as you look up to see a massive figure above.

81.name: The Skyhigh Tower
81.desc: You've reached the Tower of Mistral at last. This is Maxwell's base inside Mistral. Hurry your way inside!

150700.name: The So-Called Demon
150700.desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 1 - A scientist with her creation, and a twin sword wielding knight are after the demon Vishra and his cursed existence.

834.name: The Spear of Justice
834.desc: You sense a strong enemy near the exit to the ruins. Zevalhua's disciple Mare was able to read Seria's movements in attacking her. Be careful.

1266.name: The Speech Maker
1266.desc: Finally at the top, there's no doubt that Zurg is waiting. If you defeat the disciple of the last Fallen God, Afla Dilith will be the only enemy left!

660.name: The Spirit World Descends
660.desc: You've all made your way to the Spirit World. Now you must put your heads together to defeat Cardes, and then get back together safely.

20064.name: The Spoiled Fresco
20064.desc: The carvings here are even more ornate than those near the entrance of the ruins. A fresh gash runs horizontally across one of the giant frescoes. What could've done this?

312.name: The Spring of Power
312.desc: This place is also inhabitable. It's doubtful anyone could even last a minute around here. Hurry on ahead.

83.name: The Stairs of Trial
83.desc: Halfway up, a giant flying dragon is defends the tower, attacking anyone who nears. You must avoid it's attacks to advance.

801.name: The Steamy Path
801.desc: It's like a steam bath here, the hot steam making it hard to breathe. It'd be difficult to wear armor travelling through a place like this.

8301310.name: The Strength of Iron
8301310.desc: The mix-up with Wendy was somehow resolved, but now Gajeel the Iron Dragon Slayer has appeared! Can you break through his iron defense?

8301273.name: The Study
8301273.desc: Compared to the rest of the manor, the study is still well-kept. Books on medicine and other disciplines fill the shelves.

83014215.name: The Sun and The Moon Lv. 1
83014215.desc: Join the Yagami family to prove their might.

83014216.name: The Sun and The Moon Lv. 2
83014216.desc: Join the Yagami family to prove their might.

1241.name: The Supreme Dragon
1241.desc: You can't believe that such a beautiful garden floats in midair just like that. What sort of magic could be at work here?

2100002.name: The Supreme God
2100002.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

814.name: The Swift Marksman
814.desc: As you traverse the whitewashed landscape, you're surprised by a firm, icy sound. It's the echo of icy gunfire headed your way!

1412.name: The Sword & Axe Dance
1412.desc: A cloud of sand starts covering your clothes. You swallow the fine pieces of sand the wind picks up as you breathe. Deserts are still not your forte.

330.name: The Tarnished Peaks
330.desc: You're halfway through St. Lamia, and Tilith's deteriorating condition has worsened. It's time to hurry.

22.name: The Thief's Hideout
22.desc: You've come far, but there's still no exit in site. There are supposed to be bandits in this area.

830.name: The Thunder Troupe
830.desc: You must escape the ruins to get to the tower where Karl is being held. Tilith can take care of Seria, so hurry ahead as fast as you can.

230.name: The Thunder Wrecked Land
230.desc: After escaping the pitch black forest, you entered a vast wasteland. The area is being torn apart by lightning.

53.name: The Thundering Strategist
53.desc: At the end of these unpleasant wetlands the way is blocked by a former hero of Grand Gaia who was summoned by Maxwell.

5008001.name: The Tinkerer’s Deceit
5008001.desc: The relics of Athensphere have yielded interesting results. Noel’s thirst for knowledge has the summoner searching for a particular figure in the memory gear…

633.name: The Trembling Earth
633.desc: Escaping between the rows of crumbling buildings, you're jolted by a sudden tremor. Could this be Gaia's rage? Or maybe...

21051.name: The True Target
21051.desc: It seems that the Mystical Wolf was actually this world's sealed god. You need to find a way to win before you fight it again...

25600005.name: The Ultimate Bunny
25600005.desc: Vikki still has a trump card up her enormous sleeve.

150032.name: The Unrivalled Fool
150032.desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 3 - In the violent battle with the gods, he almost loses what matters to him most. Watch, as he unlocks his true power!

20046.name: The Voice of God
20046.desc: An overwhelming presence emanates from the top of the tower. Could it be the legendary power bestowed upon those who’ve heard the voice of the gods?

100400.name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 1
100400.desc: Heroes and spirits from all over gather among these dangerous ruins. Now's your chance to gather hordes of Material Units!

100401.name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 2
100401.desc: Deeper within the dangerous ruins, home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to get some valuable Material Units!

100402.name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 3
100402.desc: The deepest reaches of the dangerous ruins, home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to obtain some rare Material Units!

100403.name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 4
100403.desc: This hidden area is home to dangerous relics from heroes and warriors all over. Now's your chance to get these otherwise hard to get materials!

100404.name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 5
100404.desc: These sealed off ruins are home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to obtain some super rare materials!

8301650.name: The Warmonger
8301650.desc: An otherworldly visitor of an unknown, robotic nature has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

843.name: The Warrior and the Dragon
843.desc: The mountain path slowly turns downhill. As your trip around this beautiful mountain comes to an end you almost feel sad, but you must hurry forward.

964.name: The White Altar
964.desc: The enemy attacks increase further in ferocity. But their primitive, brute force approach is evidence that you are hot on Mare's tail.

62.name: The White Horse of Light
62.desc: A shining, gallant white horse blocks the path. It defends its position, attacking mercilessly.

24003.name: The Wide Sky
24003.desc: Red flickers are visible in the distance. Seems like it's time to say farewell to this hill of falling stars. Look sharp and let's move ahead.

8301190.name: The Will Of Man L1
8301190.desc: You emerged from the gate onto an unexpectedly ordinary plain. Ordinary, aside from the sounds of battle and clashing swords.

8301191.name: The Will Of Man L2
8301191.desc: The gate led you into the heart of a raging battle, and there is no time to do anything but fight the foes that turn to face you.

8301192.name: The Will Of Man L3
8301192.desc: A powerful young knight, with blood stains matching his crimson hair, has mistaken you for the enemy. Defend yourself or be destroyed!

150042.name: The Will of Urias
150042.desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 3 - The invasion of the gods has begun. Though in pain, Atro fights against the God Army for the people and is struck by tragedy.

10450.name: The World Below
10450.desc: You descend into a gloomy underground road completely different from the world above. The walls and floor are dirty, and even the air feels polluted.

653.name: The World in Her Eyes
653.desc: The entrance to the Spirit World is now within view. All that's left is to believe in Tilith's words and move forth, knocking away any who get in your way.

8301205.name: The World Is A Stage
8301205.desc: Great job, Summoner! Now all you have to do is escort our young guest to--wait, where is she going? What is that in the distance?!

324.name: The World Tree
324.desc: You've finally reached the end of the crimson forest. You see a color other than red and race towards it.

2000012.name: The Yellow Flash
2000012.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

704.name: The Young Girl's Guardian
704.desc: The enemies attack quite aggressively. It's as if they're determined to keep anyone from setting foot inside the old capital.

850.name: Thick Darkness
850.desc: Entering the cave from the bright mountain path, your eyes have yet to adjust. Despite the dim light, the cave is considerably dark.

221.name: Thief of the Forest
221.desc: Dark forests like this are usually full of bandits. Is it that they work better in the Dark? Either way, be careful.

409589.name: Third Hour
409589.desc: What kind of nonsense is this? "Survivor Game"? Well, damn if they think I'm going to become another victim.

150703.name: Those Left Behind
150703.desc: Cursed Fire Armor (Extra) - Logan regains his senses after his friend sacrifices his life for him. However, what awaits Reeze and Lilith henceforth?

652.name: Those Who Covet Death
652.desc: These grounds are haunted by those who couldn't be saved. It serves no purpose other than to create further casualties.

5000015.name: Those Who Lead
5000015.desc: In the closing days of the war between gods and humanity, Reed, Lucana, and Aneil attempted to save survivors. They led the people with them as they headed for Mistral, the site of the promised land. The group encountered Rhein, Eru, and Nevsky along the way, and together they managed to make it to where the promised land was just ahead. But Mistral was also home to a threatening presence...

1050.name: Those Who Live by the Sword
1050.desc: These ruins were once the capital of Agni, known as Mirvana. Exposed to the worst of warfare, the city still bears its scars.

1475.name: Thriving Cornerstone
1475.desc: Dual blades dance in the air, and one strike from a hefty lance breaks the floor open. Just a bit more till you face Eriole deep in the castle.

10263.name: Throne of Gears
10263.desc: Beiorg seems to be able to alter his stature and size, but there's no way he'd make the castle a part of his body...is there?

8301144.name: Through Fire and Ice
8301144.desc: Fairy Tail wizards have appeared through an anomaly in the vortex. They seem to think you're with a "Dark Guild." What's going on?!

10552.name: Through the Darkness
10552.desc: The great giant's remains seem to be holding their form without decaying or breaking down. Is this the power of Amu Yunos at work?

10043.name: Thunder's Direct Hit
10043.desc: You find many rooms within the crystal structures. Do demons live here? Humans wouldn't be able to survive in such a place...

1232.name: Thunder Batter
1232.desc: A deafening voice combined with the flash of thunder. A bird soars the skies creating electric shocks as it revolves. But it's not just one bird...

1331.name: Thunder Beast's Clash
1331.desc: The large drops of rain won't stop, striking you as they fall. Your body gets colder, and as you sneeze, the sound of thunder resonates around you.

50.name: Thunder Blasting Wetlands
50.desc: Lightning occasionally roars throughout this damp land. It's quite unpleasant here. Prepare yourself for thunder.

100611.name: Thunder Metal Parade
100611.desc: A grand procession featuring Thunder Metal monsters with loads of Thunder experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

10331.name: Thunder Path
10331.desc: Could crossing this long bridge made entirely of metal be really safe? Lightning won't stop flashing, so you can't seem to calm down...

10044.name: Thunder Rock Garden
10044.desc: You managed to make it through this strange place and resurface to land. However, an opponent seems to be preparing to fight you.

8341999.name: Thunder Turnout Lv. 1
8341999.desc: A storm has been brewing across the vast skies of Grand Gaia, and where there is a storm, thunder is bound to follow.

8342999.name: Thunder Turnout Lv. 2
8342999.desc: Do you hear the thunder? It's coming for you. They're coming for you. Can you thrive above the lightning, or will you kneel to their bolts of power?

10671.name: Thunderbird Awakens
10671.desc: It's been a long time since you fought with Paris. She wants to fight to overcome her doubts. With that in mind, you want to give your all.

22063.name: Thundering Roar
22063.desc: Kagenui has caught up to you from behind, and Genba, the enemy leader, is right ahead. But if you make it through this fight, Suzune will be safe.

83016607.name: Thunderous Cheer
83016607.desc: With raucous laughter and shouts of joy, indulge in an electrifying performance!

533.name: Thunderous Nemeses
533.desc: Two beasts block your path forward through the Gadillian Ravine. One has an enormous body, while the other is a wild and beastly warrior.

24023.name: Thunderous Roar
24023.desc: A rumbling sound fills your ears. It's not thunder, this seems to be a roar. A battle with the owner of that voice may be unavoidable.

10531.name: Thunderous Sky
10531.desc: Since you have a good view and allies with you, you can focus on enemies approaching from ahead. But watch your back just in case.

20001003.name: Time for Plan B
20001003.desc: The golem's gone mad! Who would've thought? But there's always a Plan B…

10566.name: Time to Move
10566.desc: For some reason, you have to face Owen now. If you refuse, Owen will probably flatten you anyway. So your only choice is to take him head on!

934.name: Time to Vanquish
934.desc: The ominous clouds begin to clear, a sign that you may have made it out of your crisis. Yet taking a break now would be most dangerous.

83015904.name: To Partake of Light
83015904.desc: You've received an invitation from a stranger to partake in the annual Zartosht tradition, the Longest Night.

924.name: To Sacrifice One's Body
924.desc: The terrain here is not as rough. Perhaps this is where Mare will strike. Prepare yourself for her attack.

360.name: To the Abominable Castle
360.desc: You've finally reached Maxwell's stronghold. You continue forward, having vowed to Tilith to destroy this depraved god.

320.name: To the Crimson Forests
320.desc: Beyond the sacred mountain lies the Blood Forest. Tilith is acting a bit odd, though, she might be sick...

151001.name: To the Holy Emperor
151001.desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 2 - The Oracle Knight and the Oracle Maiden follow Lucius's orders and head towards the Holy Emperor with their comrades.

1470.name: To the Shiny Palace
1470.desc: The spark of battle has been ignited. Defeat the enemies standing in your way, and head towards the depths of Eriole's castle!

944.name: Tombstone of Light
944.desc: A salty breeze wafts through the tomb, hinting at where it extends. Perhaps Karl is being held there.

24052.name: Torn, Kindred Souls
24052.desc: You didn't expect to come across two Elder Summoners fighting Rahnas! Owen probably won't like it, but back him up as Grahdens instructs.

1102.name: Torrent of Flames
1102.desc: Flames rise from the lava, robbing you of the little oxygen which remains, and the further you run ahead, the more fiery heroes block your path.

10814.name: Torrential Floods
10814.desc: The expanse of countless hazardous geysers finally nears its end. An ominous feeling grows, as you realize it won't continue to be this easy...

23050.name: Toward the Goal
23050.desc: You're concerned about Bertz and Lugina, but you have to get back to the Sealed God mission. The cavernous temple before you is utterly silent.
