8301146.name: Towards Fantasia
8301146.desc: Seems like Fairy Tail isn't backing down from an offensive stance. You've got one shot to help them understand things, so make it count!

10444.name: Towards the Light
10444.desc: There is a great disc shining from above. It looks like it's at the top of a tower. However, there's something odd about it...

20500.name: Tower of Knowledge
20500.desc: You made it to the Information Tower, your present goal. You're able to use Summoning again for whatever reason, so you might as well start climbing.

10611.name: Towering Shadows
10611.desc: You feel you need to defeat Karna Masta. If you don't, humanity will forever live in fear of the god's resurrection.

21010.name: Town Under Attack
21010.desc: You were shocked to learn that humans fled to places other than Elgaia during the war with the gods. Are there other cases of this, as well?

83016004.name: Track and Trail
83016004.desc: Jin follows a trail of broken branches deeper into the forest and finds a memento of Fuu's lying on the ground...

10612.name: Tragic Destiny
10612.desc: You really want to believe in Karl. Despite this, you don't think the demon menace will go away even if Ishgria is unified.

21052.name: Trail of Frozen Blood
21052.desc: The cold, dry air makes your nose hurt. Reda seems to be freezing, too, but Luciana and Liana appear used to it.

409581.name: Training Grounds
409581.desc: Even the king of Elysia has to keep in fighting shape while conducting an assessment of his troops.

150503.name: Traitors
150503.desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 4 - A mission calls for the execution of the traitor Sodis, but each of the Guardians begins to follow their own path.

1543.name: Traitors of Humanity
1543.desc: You're close to the top of the tower. As you continue forth, you feel a strong presence. Could the beings Ark mentioned be waiting ahead?

107650.name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 1
107650.desc: You see a great arena before you past the gate to another world. A young man with flowing long black hair awaits with sword in hand.

107651.name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 2
107651.desc: Amidst all the commotion in this new world, you meet a young man with black hair that excels in swordsmanship. There is nowhere to run now.

107652.name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 3
107652.desc: The deep claw marks and gashes left upon the structure of the arena are a testament of the vicious battles that continuously take place here.

8350061.name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 1
8350061.desc: As the cries of war creep nearer, peace is broken, and the tranquillity of the lands is disturbed.

8350062.name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 2
8350062.desc: A battle breaks out on the Faithlorn Fields of Athensphere. Neither the old nor young shall be spared.

8350063.name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 3
8350063.desc: Gentle souls begin rising up in desperation to bring back order to the lands.

22011.name: Tranquil Winds
22011.desc: Seria's decision caught you off guard. She must be growing up. You can't let her show you up, though.

10721.name: Transparent Heart
10721.desc: It feels as though time itself has frozen in the silence of these woods. You let out a deep sigh, and continue to advance steadily.

24071.name: Traveled So Far
24071.desc: You've stopped the Sealed Gods from going berserk on many other worlds. Here that journey will likely come to an end. Just focus on what you must do.

1134.name: Treacherous Angel
1134.desc: A fight awaits you at Danrard's final gate. You're greeted by an angel who once took to the sky in search of freedom.

10453.name: Treacherous Heart
10453.desc: Underneath the city of light there is a place the light cannot touch. Even if technology fixed this in the future, society wouldn't probably allow it.

720.name: Treading on Thin Ice
720.desc: Before you lies a frozen lake. It seems the only way to get to the beach on the other side is to cross over it. Be careful as you proceed forth.

25530007.name: Treasure Keeper
25530007.desc: Watching over the priceless treasures of the Land of the Dead is but one of Horus's many tasks from his father, Osiris.

83018000.name: Treasure Paradise
83018000.desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

1321.name: Treetops of Illusion
1321.desc: A strange feeling overcomes you. You've sensed this atmosphere in many of the forests you have passed through so far. No doubt spirits are near.

10522.name: Trembling Forest
10522.desc: The ancient cobblestones are so overgrown with moss that they are hardly recognizable. This seems like a nice place for a walk, a rarity in Ishgria.

23060.name: Tremor's Epicenter
23060.desc: You felt someone watching you as you stepped into the temple's heart. Is this world itself watching you?

966.name: Trespasser into the Mind
966.desc: At last you have found Mare in a room at the back of the altar. Show her that she is no match for the human bond you share with your friends.

8380000.name: Trial 01 - Burning Desire
8380000.desc: The gods thus granted this spirit with the burning desire to triumph in battle, making it the strongest of its kind.

8381000.name: Trial 02 - Destructive Force
8381000.desc: An ancient destructive force reanimated and energized to its very limit.

8382000.name: Trial 03 - Ultimate Defense
8382000.desc: The gods gave this demon the spirit of ultimate defense, strengthened its power, and sharpened its claws.

8383000.name: Trial 04 - Fiery Barrier
8383000.desc: It was rumored that the beast acquired the mysterious power of a fiery barrier.

8384000.name: Trial 05 - Rage of God
8384000.desc: And the gods said to her, all you need to do is get even angrier.

8385000.name: Trial 06 - Companion Vigor
8385000.desc: The gods granted a powerful companion to the most unlikely of all creatures..

150001.name: Trial by Fire
150001.desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 2 - The days he ventured in search of strength. His countless fierce battles gave birth to the "Hero of the Fierce Flame."

1031.name: Trial by Firestorm
1031.desc: Rain pours down with incessant lightning. Just as you start to suspect that enemies lurk here, an ambush strikes from above!

2000000.name: Trial No. 001
2000000.desc: You think you have what it takes to defeat my mock Units? You should be really familiar with your opponent this time! I wonder how long you'll last?

2000001.name: Trial No. 002
2000001.desc: Hmm, you're better than I expected. However, if you think you can beat my next Unit, you're wrong! I doubt you'll even be able to survive the first blow!

2000002.name: Trial No. 003
2000002.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

2000003.name: Trial No. 004
2000003.desc:
I used entirely different materials to make
this new mock Unit, you know!
You'll get quite the surprise when
you start fighting against it.

2000005.name: Trial No. 005
2000005.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

2000007.name: Trial No. 006
2000007.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

2000009.name: Trial No. 007
2000009.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

2000011.name: Trial No. 008
2000011.desc: These mock Units are made of something completely different. You're in for a shock once you start fighting them!

8360021.name: Trial No. X1
8360021.desc:
I... I opened a portal to the Dark Tower and I couldn't control the accursed.
Keep it under control and you shall be rewarded.

8300031.name: Trial No. X2
8300031.desc: A group of maidens barged in here and demanded to use my sacred lab to test each other's strength!! Get in there and appease them so I can return to my experiments!

8360041.name: Trial No. X3
8360041.desc: This mock unit was supposedly widely feared and known far throughout the East. Are you up for the challenge?

8360051.name: Trial No. X4
8360051.desc: I’ve finally done it!! My research has led me to this man of great importance. There is much I would like to ask him but first, would you like a challenge?

25530004.name: Trial of the Falcon
25530004.desc: Harakhte wishes to test the mettle of his new Vessel, Neferet.

1021.name: Trials in the Forest
1021.desc: Unlike the tundra, the forest is full of what looks like landmarks. But they are starting to lead you astray as you trip over the thick grass.

10511.name: Trio of Brilliant Ice
10511.desc: A metallic scent unlike the rusted iron smell of the red sea tickles your nose. It seems that Elgaian common sense doesn't apply to Ishgria.

10771.name: True Dragon's Power
10771.desc: Barion shows his true power and form. Face him alongside Karl, whose demonic powers have awakened! The answer Karl seeks must lie ahead.

151303.name: True Equality
151303.desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 4 - Kulyuk vanished suddenly after being called by the Holy Emperor. What could have happened to him?

24050.name: Truth's Existence
24050.desc: Once you've passed through the forest, a majestic temple-like structure appears before you. Could it be something that the gods of Grand Gaia created?

10165.name: Truth and Falsehood
10165.desc: After defeating Shusui anew, you head towards the end of the bridge. However, you feel that demonic presence again. You know which demon awaits now.

106800.name: Tumultuous Hunter Lv. 6
106800.desc: A tribe of tenacious hunters once lived on Elgaia's frontier. When tragedy struck, only one lived on to avenge their catastrophic downfall.

106801.name: Tumultuous Hunter Lv. 7
106801.desc: After taking revenge, the lone hunter wanted no more than to return to his people's traditions of living and dying by the hunt of powerful fiends.

1362.name: Turning the Tide
1362.desc: You can hear Tilith fighting from the entrance. Inspired by her courage, your feet rush forward at full speed!

1544.name: Twilight of Heroes
1544.desc: What could have those enemies been? Many seemed to have been related to Ark somehow. That must mean that the next enemy is...

103500.name: Twilight Pride Lv. 5
103500.desc: A knight from the Bariura Empire who defied the emperor and led his people to Elgaia. Bearing great pride, his soul has descended to Elgaia once more.

103501.name: Twilight Pride Lv. 6
103501.desc: Though you seek peace for Grand Gaia, the ire he once held during the duel with his knight companion over their plan of escape is now directed at you!

8301107.name: Two Enter, Only One Leaves
8301107.desc: Time to put your skills on the line in a royal rumble fit for legends! Embrace the elements and let them guide you to victory!

409597.name: Two to Tango
409597.desc: Hah. She can't be serious, can she? Fine. I'll just have to give her the beating of her life.

10112.name: Tyrannical Foam
10112.desc: You feel anxious knowing a presence near you holds terrible power. The humidity of the wetlands clings to your skin, making you really uncomfortable.

102840.name: Ultimate Paradise
102840.desc: Entry to the Ultimate Paradise is only granted once a day. Not only are there croaking voices, something can be seen sparkling from inside.

25012.name: Unbending Ideals
25012.desc: The area around you is devastated. Lugina said it wasn't due to the demons of Ishgria. But if it wasn't demons, what was it?

10561.name: Uncertain Moon
10561.desc: You defeated the Four Fallen Gods and Lucius, and now demons fall before you wherever you go. Will you also take out Karna Masta in the future?

1000011.name: Uncharted Frontier - End
1000011.desc: You're nearing the end of the mysterious area that appeared beyond the Vortex Gate. Mad beasts far more powerful than those you've come across before await you.

8312002.name: Undaunted Uprising
8312002.desc: As the band grew stronger and larger, Leon now had an army that reaped through the regions stamping down on the corrupt rich and powerful, making himself their number one enemy within the Agni Empire.

25042.name: Under the Banners
25042.desc: You have to stop Garrett's plan no matter what. Countless people will be harmed if the demon awakens. You have to prevent that no matter what.

950.name: Undying Wish
950.desc: Seria is as reckless as always. You worry about her wounds but can't stop now. You thank her for her impeccable timing and proceed onward.

8300813.name: Uneggspected Friend
8300813.desc: Carrol and Cotton face off in a battle for the mystical eggs. However, kindness is one of Carrol's most admirable traits...

150800.name: Unexpected Battle
150800.desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 1 - The great gods known as the Divine Ten once had powerful disciples who would eventually turn against them.

10702.name: Unfailing Light
10702.desc: It seems this facility pumps up oil from beneath the sea floor. A lot of devices made with otherworldly technologies use this oil.

1314.name: Unforgettable Heart
1314.desc: Everything is gradually turning brighter. The exit may be close, but things will probably not be as simple as you think.

1345.name: Unforgiving Light
1345.desc: The end of the road is near. A strong power can be felt coming from it. The enemy lurking there will most likely be your last obstacle here.

8301001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 1-10
8301001.desc: You have arrived at the tower where the formidable monster is rumored to be dwelling. It's dark and the cold, still air sends a chill up your spine.

8302001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 11-20
8302001.desc: Now that you've met the guardian of the tower, you start to feel less confident about this mission. What else lurks in the darkness?

8303001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 21-30
8303001.desc: So far so good, nothing you can't handle as of yet. But the spooky howls coming from the higher levels of the tower are something you can't ignore...

8304001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 31-40
8304001.desc: What's that?! A dark shadow just flashed past you. Or was it just your imagination? Stay alert, Summoner.

8305001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 41-50
8305001.desc: How many floors has it been? It's getting darker and the rain isn't stopping. Gleaming eyes are watching you from behind the shadows...

8306001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 51-60
8306001.desc: Watch out for the beasts and monsters, they haven't had a decent meal in ages... Let your guard down and you might not live to see the sun rise again.

8307001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 61-70
8307001.desc: Your breathing seems heavier than before. Are you getting tired from the climb, or is the guardian of the tower pushing you to your limits?

8308001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 71-80
8308001.desc: He is hot on your heels, catching you at every turn and landing. You need to hurry! The ominous aura filling the air is getting thicker by the minute.

8309001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 81-90
8309001.desc: You can't let him get in your way now! You've come so far, the truth waiting to be unraveled is just a reach away...

8310001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 91-100
8310001.desc: You've reached the top of the tower! Or...have you? It's too dark to see, but you can clearly sense a strong power beckoning in the darkness...

8311001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 101-110
8311001.desc: Wait... What the cursed knight has been fighting to guard wasn't the tower? What he was trying to protect was... Wh-What's that?!

8312001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 111-120
8312001.desc: It only took the monster a single strike to take down the knight you fought so hard against?! Are you sure you can take on the monster?

8313001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 121-130
8313001.desc: Now that Xenon is injured, you're the only one who can contain the monster. Hurry, before it escapes the tower!

8314001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 131-140
8314001.desc: Oh no! You lost sight of the monster! Where is it? There's no time to waste... You need to track it down before it can ambush you!

8315001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 141-150
8315001.desc: The darkness is putting you at a great disadvantage, but you can hear the monster's heartbeat from a distance. Wait, was that your own heartbeat instead?

8316001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 151-160
8316001.desc: The continuous climb and seemingly endless battles have taken a toll on you, but your mission is not over. Xenon is pinning his hopes on you, Summoner.

8317001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 161-170
8317001.desc: Is that the best you can do? You need to muster more energy and power to complete this mission! Pull yourself together and charge forth!

8318001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 171-180
8318001.desc: The monster seems to be getting stronger and stronger. Can you keep up? If you give up now, it's not going to leave a nice impression on your record...

8319001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 181-190
8319001.desc: There's no time to rest! The monster must be getting exhausted too, this is your chance to attack! Did you lose sight of it again?

8320001.name: Unholy Tower Floor 191-200
8320001.desc: It has been a long, tough fight. You're so close to completing your mission! You're not going to give up now, are you?

1476.name: Unification Pillar
1476.desc: The shadow overhead is just as strong as the light. The world is being distorted, probably tearing at the seams. You're just steps away from Eriole!

20054.name: Unifier of Demons
20054.desc: An evil air pervades the pitch-blackness of the mine’s innermost reaches. Exhausted by their travails, despair nibbles at the heart of any weary traveler on this road.

20401.name: Uninhabited Tower
20401.desc: You proceed into the tower made of geometric crystal and metal. It looks like it was built for people to live in, but there's no sign of anyone.

1364.name: Universal Equality
1364.desc: You've made your way through a big portion of the fortress. Past this corridor lies its center. The real body of the Fallen God is probably there.

10862.name: Unknowable Power
10862.desc: You must buy time while Ark awakens Ilia's power. You may be in over your head...but you know you can count on your companions.

1574.name: Unknown Wisdom
1574.desc: Lucius doesn't speak much. Did he fool everyone? Or did humans selfishly come up with their own expectations of him?

1234.name: Unleashed Power
1234.desc: The rain has ceased and light trickles through the clouds. As if on a staircase of light, an angel descends. Defeat her and proceed to the Sky Palace.

25580003.name: Unmend and Unmake
25580003.desc: Guinne is determined to put an end to Nabris's mischievous machinations.

22073.name: Unnatural Might
22073.desc: You don't have time to wait on Seria, so you'll be facing Raka alone. It seems she won't use her Phoenix Strike, but she's too strong to take lightly.

1572.name: Unreachable Solution
1572.desc: You were victorious against all Four Fallen Gods. However, now you fully understand that Lucius's power surpasses that of any previously defeated god.

83015901.name: Unsettling Flickers
83015901.desc: As you wait out the long night with Armaiti, you can't help but focus on the unsettling atmosphere.

24073.name: Unshakable
24073.desc: Rahnas has gained Karna Masta's power and it's formidable! But remember your battles in Grand Gaia and Ishgria, and seize victory once again!

853.name: Unshakeable Fear
853.desc: The stench of death wafts through the air from the deep darkness. Where could this cave lead? This darkness is really unsettling.

1571.name: Unsolvable Riddle
1571.desc: If Lucius is defeated, only Tilith will be able to control the gate. You must think of a countermeasure to deal with the sealed calamities within.

1573.name: Unspoken Things
1573.desc: Gods and humans seem to be looking at things quite differently. However, if they mean to destroy humanity, you've no choice but to stop them.

10713.name: Unwavering
10713.desc: You can barely keep to the path due to the blizzard. But you won't lose sight of your goal. Advance without wavering, so you can rescue Tilith.

913.name: Unwavering Slash
913.desc: Unlike the weather, the sandy terrain is less than ideal for combat. Walking so far from the city has also exhausted you.

10602.name: Uphill Invasion
10602.desc: The flames form first a firestorm, then spin into towering fire whirls. Who knows what happens if you get close to them. Be careful as you advance!

21071.name: Utmost Extremity
21071.desc: Although you're fairly used to it by now, things are still harder when your Summoning is restricted. You have to get stronger.

351.name: Vagabond of the Monster's Den
351.desc: This cave not only looks horrid, but is also full to the brim with fearsome beings. You mustn't lose focus here or else.

8301731.name: Vash the Stampede
8301731.desc: Take on the Humanoid Typhoon in this challenge dungeon! Will you be blown away?

10023.name: Vast Region
10023.desc: When you feel something strange on your shoe, you look down to find it has begun to disintegrate. You should watch your step here.

1410.name: Vast Sea of Sand
1410.desc: You can see a vast desert in front of you. There seems to be no end to it, but you must take this cruel path in order to move forward.

411.name: Venture Inside
411.desc: What could be waiting unbeknownst to history in this ship that appeared so long ago? You can't deny your curiosity.

1532.name: Verdant Ruin's Fate
1532.desc: The greenery around you has grown louder. It could all be in your head, but is it possible that the insects are trying to warn you? The enemy's here!

10850.name: Vexing Worldscape
10850.desc: You emerge in a place defying description. It must be the ruins of a city...but nothing makes sense. So this is how this other world looks.

10562.name: Viewing the Galaxy
10562.desc: Mora said that eight of them sealed Karna Masta, which means there are two other demons besides Amu Yunos.

551.name: Vile Dreams Come True
551.desc: A devilish presence stands before you as a hazardous obstacle in your path. Be careful not to get seduced into a vulnerable state.

83016601.name: Village Jaunt
83016601.desc: The village is abuzz with excitement over the coming feast. Take a jaunt and look around!

83016006.name: Village Vandals
83016006.desc: Mugen investigates a village just outside the forest for witnesses, but finds more than he bargained for...

10834.name: Violet Lightning
10834.desc: Some of the surrounding wreckage is relatively intact. You marvel at the unfamiliar materials and workmanship. Could these be otherworldly relics?

5000006.name: Virtual Garden
5000006.desc: Having defeated Lucius, Paris takes a moment to herself in the Imperial Library when Noel appears. He says there is a place where she can find her true self, and thus she sets off on a journey there. While on her way, she runs into the Summoner who's in the area, though she decides to continue on her own. However, another sudden meeting turns the tables...

23022.name: Vital Wetlands
23022.desc: The ruins are a jumble, and there are several paths through them. Maybe one of them was easy to use once. You just want dry ground to walk on.

83016821.name: Voice from the Void
83016821.desc: You find yourself drawn into an interminable wasteland in the void of your own mind. Someone has called you here.

1576.name: Void of Ignorance
1576.desc: Grand Gaia's Crater... Is this the place where countless calamities lie sealed within? No, now is not the time for distractions.

25570006.name: Waking the Dragon
25570006.desc: Vyrr doesn't seem happy to be awoken in the dead of winter.

23042.name: Wall of Attackers
23042.desc: As you face off against the Abel Faction, more enchanted puppets suddenly enter the fray. You'll have to handle them if you're going after Rahnas!

10752.name: Wall of Darkness
10752.desc: You climb the path that juts out from the ice wall. At each crossroads you come across you must choose the safest-looking one from many options.

10822.name: Waltz of Impatience
10822.desc: Moment by moment, the final battle draws near. How can you hope to overcome the might of the Holy Emperor, who overshadowed even the Summoners of Old?

10911.name: Wanderer in the Ruins
10911.desc: Wordlessly you progress through the lonely scene. What areas of this capital would most interest Paris if she were here?

10970.name: Wandering Hermit
10970.desc: With Karna Masta totally defeated, Ark is free to be with Ilia, now released from her seal. Yet, his worries haven't dissipated...

20060.name: Wandering the Ruins
20060.desc: You come to some vast and ancient ruins, cloaked in an air of solemnity. The time of Cordelica’s reckoning is soon at hand. Prepare yourself for the battle ahead.

10164.name: War Ravages Anew
10164.desc: It's battle after battle, but while caught up in them you feel a new,  yet strange power approaching. It feels familiar somehow though...

5000007.name: Warped Reflection
5000007.desc: Moments after defeating the sealed god Lucius, Noel sends the Summoner on a mission along with Lugina. However, the demon they are after has the ability to reflect the souls of its opponents, unexpectedly drawing Lugina into a fierce battle with his doppelganger. Meanwhile, Karl is on a mission in the area under orders from Grahdens, but...

83016007.name: Wasabi Warrior
83016007.desc: Coming across an abundance of wasabi roots strewn along the path to the village, Mugen suspects something is off.

10024.name: Wasted Sea Rocks
10024.desc: You have finally reached the end of the cascades to find yourself in a dark valley of sorts. However, you must defeat a strong enemy to move forward.

23001.name: Watch Your Step
23001.desc: It seems you're on a vast, flat grassland, but there are stones scattered across the plains. You'll trip if you don't watch your step.

301.name: Watchdog From Hell
301.desc: Magma is gushing out all over, and it's scorching hot as far as the eye can see. Nothing could possibly live here.

1441.name: Watcher at the Summit
1441.desc: As you climb an electrified cliff, you pass peaks as sharp as needles. You can't help but feel like this road is a premonition of the future to come.

10670.name: Watchful Guide
10670.desc: You have to face the demon Kalon's Shadow alongside Lugina. The true seal on Karna Masta should break soon as well. The time to fight draws near.

1524.name: Water's Reflection
1524.desc: The reflection of the light on the water makes the river sparkle. Its color made you uncomfortable before, but it may make for a beautiful view now.

100609.name: Water Metal Parade
100609.desc: A grand procession featuring Water Metal monsters with loads of Water experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

20000902.name: Wave of Terror
20000902.desc: The void creatures continue their assault upon this ascended paradise.

661.name: Wavering Ambition
661.desc: The air is ominous where a Fallen God was once sealed away. You can feel the presence of enemies exponentially more powerful than any you've seen before.

10214.name: Waves of Blood
10214.desc: Are all of Ishgria's oceans red? While thinking that to yourself, a horde of enemies shows up. This is no time to take it easy.

8321000.name: Waves of Fury Lv. 1
8321000.desc: Cool and dignified, she bows to no one but her trusty Gatling gun which she has entrusted her life to.

8322000.name: Waves of Fury Lv. 2
8322000.desc: Known as the Gun Lady, she never lets her guard or her gun down. When it comes to the quick draw, she is second to none.

8323000.name: Waves of Fury Lv. 3
8323000.desc: It's no longer a matter of winning or losing. She wants revenge and she wants it fast. She has no time for those who can't keep up.

8301431.name: Way Off Base
8301431.desc: The strange man, Hyshka, investigates the woods with a moody teenager and finds something far more disturbing…

500042.name: Weapon Training Lv.3
500042.desc: A battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Defeat all foes standing in your way and seize further power!

500040.name: Weapon Training Lv. 1
500040.desc: A special battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Vanquish all incoming enemies to develop your skills!

500041.name: Weapon Training Lv. 2
500041.desc: A special battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Destroy any enemies on the field to test your weapons' limits!

10141.name: Weapons & Radiance
10141.desc: You head towards the Ruins in search of Seria and Lugina. Now that Paris is not around, walking behind the silent Mora doesn't feel right.

20201.name: Weapons Loaded
20201.desc: Machines are everywhere you look. There's no sign of any people. Could this be related to the collapse Reda spoke of?

863.name: Wedging Deep
863.desc: Is Karl all right? Just as Tilith said, there must be a reason why Karl is being kept alive, so his life shouldn't be in danger, but still...

20001000.name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 1
20001000.desc: Defend the golem. That's all you need to do. How hard could it be?

20001001.name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 2
20001001.desc: These natives aren't very strong, hold your ground. This won't take long.

20001002.name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 3
20001002.desc: Almost there! The golem is almost fully charged!

10640.name: Welcoming Gate
10640.desc: It seems that Karl wasn't able to fully awaken the demonic power within himself. Perhaps he still has some doubts...

20000230.name: West Hall: Rotunda
20000230.desc: With the tome at full strength, Renatus and Nimrah must contend with its "missing" owner...

101200.name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 1
101200.desc: A fighter who seeks great power to protect the one he loves. He pays attention only to those who exude the kind of power he desires.

101201.name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 2
101201.desc: A fighter who travels the world in search of the one he loves. The encounters and experiences he absorbs along the way add to his burgeoning strength.

101202.name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 3
101202.desc: A fighter with a kick powerful enough to crush even gods. Known as "Thunder Kick," he only has time for those who he thinks demonstrate enough power themselves.

101203.name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 4
101203.desc: A fighter who has honed his abilities beyond godlike, every smiting kick he delivers smashes with lightning electrocution.

701.name: Where Empires Meet
701.desc: The crumbling paved road stretches forth, though there are no signs that humans ever lived in this area. Be cautious as you proceed.

24014.name: Where Flames Go
24014.desc: You have come close to the foot of a mountain that emits lightning. You turn to the Dragon's Flame Tomb and feel a strong heat approaching...

641.name: Where Light Falls
641.desc: Many students with bright futures ahead of them once studied here. The presence awaiting you in this sacred place is one clad in light.

20053.name: Where Lightning Strikes
20053.desc: You emerge from what you thought was a never-ending tunnel to be greeted by a bright light, only to find out the light was actually a flash of lightning.

1344.name: Where Loyalty Lies
1344.desc: A road for pilgrims. Long ago, pilgrims passed through here to pray to the gods. Ironically, you're taking this road in order to defeat a god.

1460.name: Where Souls Sleep
1460.desc: Having passed the gorgeous garden, you reach a gloomy cemetery. Among the expressionless tombstones standing, a voice calls from within the silence.

10930.name: Where Souls Slumber
10930.desc: The story of a hero toyed with by the gods to bring back a loved one. In the end will he find hope, or despair...?

941.name: Where the Light Points
941.desc: The air wafting through the tomb seems fresh and clean. Judging by the inscriptions on the wall, this place dates back to the Agni Empire.

544.name: Where the Light Shines
544.desc: What could that knight be thinking? How could anyone who fought and died for humanity's sake find themselves fighting for the gods!?

432.name: Where Thunder Pulses
432.desc: Continuing through the mines, you occasionally hear the sound of thunder. Whether it's natural or the roar of some thunder beast, surely you'll find out soon.

1101.name: Whirling Vapors
1101.desc: The hot air burns to the touch. This is all too familiar, though, surely the fire wielding hero waits ahead.

22052.name: Whispering Fortress
22052.desc: You've finally gotten through the maze-like castle walls to the main building. Now you can charge the entrance that Sakunoshin mentioned.

8301352.name: Whispers in the Cave
8301352.desc: Meanwhile, a cheerful girl named Annette lends her aid to the effort! This ought to be a blast!

22023.name: Whispers of Death
22023.desc: Apparently there's a checkpoint and a city once you get past Calamity Plains. Maybe you should dress like you're from this world to get through it?

10724.name: White Continent
10724.desc: The trees have thinned out. You are almost out of the woods, and you miss warmer lands. Hopefully somewhere more sheltered is coming up next.

553.name: Wicked Hostility
553.desc: Resentment is one of the strongest emotions people have. Though it can sometimes be used as a motivating force to accomplish a goal, there are few who desire it.

21.name: Wielder of the Fire
21.desc: Continue deeper into the Cave of Flames. Beings who control fire are waiting ahead.

61.name: Wielder of the Light
61.desc: It appears that a sage with the power of light is in the ruins. A guardian, perhaps?

901.name: Wild Bravery
901.desc: Every building in the city looks plain yet sturdy. The fact that they've survived the ravages of war is testament to their expert craftsmanship.

83014222.name: Wild Rampage - "Dusk"
83014222.desc: Wait until sunset to subdue Orochi Iori.

10533.name: Wild Thunder Valley
10533.desc: You heard a cliff collapsing over the thunder. Something large is approaching, shaking the earth as it does. You won't get away without fighting.

22070.name: Wild Winds
22070.desc: Sakunoshin saved your life. That Phoenix Strike is terrifying, but it won't be so easy to use with Sakunoshin around.

20800.name: Wildfire Lotus
20800.desc: You've arrived at the building Reda discovered and was set on exploring. This place is clearly different from the other buildings on Bectas.

10143.name: Will of Justice
10143.desc: Just how far did Paris go? You can't pick up any presences around you, but whatever you encounter will not be weak. It would be good to regroup.

8301584.name: Willful Water
8301584.desc: Water droplets flick out at you from every corner in defiant playfulness.

1444.name: Wind Blows to Heaven
1444.desc: You can see Paris at the bottom of the cliff. It seems she followed you here. You were told to talk to her, but what exactly do you have in mind?

1456.name: Wind of Beginnings
1456.desc: Small flowers sway in the wind, butterflies flutter about, and the birds fly high in the sky. A wind of new beginnings is leaving the old age behind.

1466.name: Winding Down
1466.desc: Not even the wind seems to reach this place, and your movements start to feel sluggish. The smell of moss and mold lingers in the air.

22050.name: Winds in Darkness
22050.desc: There are too many enemies to count! They did know you were coming, so it's not shocking. All you can do is fight your way through.

22020.name: Winds of Corruption
22020.desc: You've seen many signs of wartime destruction already, but this is the first time you've seen the site of a battle that was only days old...

22040.name: Winds Over Water
22040.desc: There's a river down the hill and past the checkpoint. The large bridge over it that seems to lead to a city, and the castle lies just beyond.

420.name: Windswept Prairie
420.desc: You stop in a field, surprised by a mysterious man who now blocks your path. There's no time to loiter, you need to shake your fear and push ahead.

150401.name: Wings of Freedom
150401.desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 2 - An angel meets a beast and confronts the will hiding deep within her heart. Her desire for freedom has been liberated.

302.name: Wings of the Flaming Skies
302.desc: It's getting hotter and hotter as you near the mouth of the volcano. It's getting hard to even move...

8301523.name: Winner Takes All
8301523.desc: Hot on the trail of the flaming spirit, Lydia and Yin-Yin are drawn into an event of their unlifetime.

83016606.name: Winter's Hearth
83016606.desc: A prime spot for gathering fallen branches and choice kindling for the village's blazing hearth.

83013420.name: Winter Paradise
83013420.desc: This gateway to the heavens only opens once a day in the winter season. A symphony of the frogs can be heard above the snow covered fields...

10262.name: Wired Hall
10262.desc: You keep destroying all the equipment you lay your eyes upon, but nothing seems to happen. What is the purpose of all these gadgets anyway?

1403.name: Within the Commotion
1403.desc: There are too many enemies. What could've led them here? As you think that to yourself, a piercing and thunderous sound resonates around you.

10354.name: Within the Darkness
10354.desc: You know you're almost out of the cave when you feel a draft. The old castle where the demon Melord awaits shouldn't be too far now.

10334.name: Within the Electricity
10334.desc: You had no idea of what to do when Shusui attacked you on such a narrow bridge, but you somehow survived the encounter. Just a little further now.

10344.name: Within the Flashes
10344.desc: As you go deeper within the lair, you feel a cold chill about you. Could there be something at the bottom? You should go take a look.

10410.name: Within the Light
10410.desc: Paris was concerned about the large number of liquid-type monsters, but it seems those creatures can adapt to the habitat of any world.

10403.name: Within the Melting Point
10403.desc: Apparently, what's flowing around is not lava, but molten metal. Is someone trying to build something with all this material?

10314.name: Within the Mud
10314.desc: Could this lake and the burning city have been in their current state since the beginning? Or is there a reason behind their extreme conditions?

10304.name: Within the Smoke
10304.desc: As you pass the city, the fire is not as intense, but the amount of smoke is overwhelming. Breathing it in could be dangerous, so hurry along.

10323.name: Within the Stench
10323.desc: Why would these dangerous plants settle in the city ruins? Do they not affect the demons as well? That seems improbable somehow...

24032.name: World-Wide Shudder
24032.desc: It's quiet, peaceful...you calm down more than necessary. This won't do. You need to stay alert in case of an enemy attack.

523.name: World Tree and the Savior
523.desc: Among the many remaining legendary epics, there is a tale of a young boy who saved the World Tree. Could this be what has shown itself just now?

25530003.name: Worth of His Words
25530003.desc: The Prince of the Skies confronts the royal scions and their dark ambitions in a daring attempt at heroism.

10653.name: Woven Power
10653.desc: Lugina's fighting spirit... That feeling you get when you face a formidable foe... You need to get serious, before Lugina summons his true strength.

22071.name: Wrathful Skies
22071.desc: You proceed over a roof made of bizarre tiles. You're so high up you couldn't help but look down. There's no coming back if you fall.

83016009.name: Wrathful Wind
83016009.desc: A sudden wind cutting through the forest damages all in its wake, but leaves no wounds. Something is amiss.

1530.name: Wreckage-Born Plains
1530.desc: You have arrived at a ghost town. It was probably a normal village before it was destroyed. Thick grass grows along the remnants of the streets.

409605.name: Ydra's Mind
409605.desc: One little bird left in the cage...and then, there was...none.

101400.name: Year-End Bonus Day 1
101400.desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

101500.name: Year-End Bonus Day 2
101500.desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

101600.name: Year-End Bonus Day 3
101600.desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

10701.name: Yesterday's Glory
10701.desc: Mora didn't come out and say it, but she wants help. Even so, everyone is resolved. They can't accede to her ambitions.

8301396.name: You In My Sights
8301396.desc: The door unlocks, indicating Vektor's presence. Surprised and overcome with emotion, Galene sets a course to meet him...

150000.name: Young Flames
150000.desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 1 - Vargas, in his younger days. It wasn't long before the proud title he built for himself crumbled before him.

1110.name: Young Lady's Guardian
1110.desc: Zurg... What could the last of the Fallen Gods be plotting. You can't help but wonder as you gaze upon the beautiful aquatic metropolis.

5200003.name: ブレイブしまね
5200003.desc:
秘密結社鷹の爪団の吉田は、ブレフロを征服
すべく新たな作戦を提案する。その名は「ブ
レイブしまね大作戦」。それはレオナルド博
士が作ったしまね化装置を使ってグランガイ
アの一部をしまね化し、自分たちの前線基地
とするというものだった。異変を察知したリ
ムより報告を受けたグラデンスは、まずはカ
ルとセリアを探索に向かわせるのだが……。
